(If either player has less than 5 cards in their Deck, reveal as many as possible.)

4914.name: Banisher of the Light
4914.text: Any card sent to the GY is banished instead.

4915.name: Giant Rat
4915.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 EARTH monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

4916.name: Senju of the Thousand Hands
4916.text: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand.

4917.name: UFO Turtle
4917.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in Attack Position.

4918.name: Flash Assailant
4918.text: Decrease the ATK and DEF of this card by 400 points for each card in your hand.

4919.name: Karate Man
4919.text: You can double the original ATK of this card once per turn. If you used this effect, destroy this card during the End Phase.

4920.name: Dark Zebra
4920.text: If this is the only card in your control during your Standby Phase, it is automatically placed in Defense Position. You cannot change the position of this card during the same turn.

4921.name: Giant Germ
4921.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then you can Special Summon any number of "Giant Germs" from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

4922.name: Nimble Momonga
4922.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Gain 1000 LP, then you can Special Summon any number of "Nimble Momonga" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

4923.name: Spear Cretin
4923.text: FLIP: When this card is sent to the Graveyard after being flipped, each player selects 1 monster from their Graveyard, and Special Summons it in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.

4924.name: Shining Angel
4924.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 LIGHT monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

4925.name: Boar Soldier
4925.text: This card can only be summoned by a Flip Summon. If summoned by a Normal Summon, the card is destroyed. If your opponent has 1 or more monsters under his/her control, the ATK of this card is decreased by 1000 points.

4926.name: Mother Grizzly
4926.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 WATER monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in Attack Position.

4927.name: Flying Kamakiri #1
4927.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 WIND monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

4928.name: Ceremonial Bell
4928.text: Both players must keep their hands revealed.

4929.name: Sonic Bird
4929.text: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

4930.name: Mystic Tomato
4930.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 DARK monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

4931.name: Kotodama
4931.text: If there are face-up monsters with the same name on the field, destroy those monsters. (If a monster is Summoned or flipped-face up that has the same name as a monster that is already face-up on the field, the new face-up monster is destroyed. If they are Summoned or flipped face-up at the same time, they are all destroyed.)

4932.name: Gaia Power
4932.text: Increase the ATK of all EARTH monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

4933.name: Umiiruka
4933.text: Increase the ATK of all WATER monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

4934.name: Molten Destruction
4934.text: Increase the ATK of all FIRE monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

4935.name: Rising Air Current
4935.text: Increase the ATK of all WIND monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

4936.name: Luminous Spark
4936.text: Increase the ATK of all LIGHT monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

4937.name: Mystic Plasma Zone
4937.text: Increase the ATK of all DARK monsters by 500 points and decrease their DEF by 400 points.

4938.name: Messenger of Peace
4938.text: Monsters with 1500 or more ATK cannot declare an attack. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 100 LP or destroy this card.

4939.name: Michizure
4939.text: When a monster is sent from the field to your GY, even during the Damage Step: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

4940.name: Gust
4940.text: You can activate this card when 1 or more of your Spell Cards are destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard by a card effect your opponent controls. Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

4941.name: Driving Snow
4941.text: You can activate this card when 1 or more of your Trap Cards are destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard by a card effect your opponent controls. Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

4942.name: Armored Glass
4942.text: You can activate this card when a monster is equipped with an Equip Card. Negate the effects of all Equip Cards on the field during the turn this card is activated.

4943.name: World Suppression
4943.text: You can activate this card when a Field Spell Card is activated. Negate the Field Spell Card during the turn this card is activated.

4944.name: Mystic Probe
4944.text: You can activate this card when a Continuous Spell Card is activated. Negate all Continuous Spell Cards during the turn this card is activated.

4945.name: Metal Detector
4945.text: You can activate this card when a Continuous Trap Card is activated. Negate all Continuous Trap Cards during the turn this card is activated.

4946.name: Numinous Healer
4946.text: You can only activate this card when you take damage to your Life Points. Increase your Life Points by 1000 points. Also, increase your Life Points by 500 points for each "Numinous Healer" card in your Graveyard.

4947.name: Appropriate
4947.text: Activate only when your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase. After that, each time your opponent draws a card(s) outside of either Draw Phase, immediately draw 2 cards.

4948.name: Forced Requisition
4948.text: You can activate this card when you discard from your hand. After that, each time you discard from your hand, your opponent must also discard the same number of cards from his/her hand.

4949.name: Minor Goblin Official
4949.text: You can only activate this card when your opponent's Life Points are 3000 or less. Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points during each of his/her Standby Phases.

4950.name: Gamble
4950.text: You can only activate this card when your opponent's hand is 6 or more cards and your hand is 2 or less. Toss a coin and call heads or tails. If you call it right, draw until your hand has 5 cards. If you call it wrong, skip your next turn.

4951.name: DNA Surgery
4951.text: Activate this card by declaring 1 Monster Type. All face-up monsters on the field become that Type.

4952.name: The Regulation of Tribe
4952.text: Activate this card by declaring 1 Monster Type. Monsters of that Type cannot declare attacks. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, Tribute 1 monster or destroy this card.

4953.name: Backup Soldier
4953.text: While there are 5 or more monsters in your Graveyard: Target up to 3 non-Effect Monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add them to your hand.

4954.name: Attack and Receive
4954.text: You can only activate this card when you take damage to your Life Points. Inflict 700 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. Also, inflict 300 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each "Attack and Receive" card in your Graveyard.

4955.name: Major Riot
4955.text: If a monster(s) you control returns to your hand by an opponent's card effect: Return as many monsters on the field to the hand as possible, then each player Special Summons monsters from their hand, in face-down Defense Position, equal to the number of Monster Cards that were returned to their hand.

4956.name: Ceasefire
4956.text: If a face-down Defense Position monster or an Effect Monster is on the field: Change all face-down Defense Position monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position (Flip monsters' effects are not activated at this time), also inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each Effect Monster on the field.

4957.name: Light of Intervention
4957.text: While this card is on the field, Monster Cards cannot be Set or flipped face-down. If a Monster Card would be Set, it must be Normal Summoned in face-up Defense Position.

4958.name: Respect Play
4958.text: During their respective turns, each player must show their opponent their hand.

4960.name: Imperial Order
4960.text: Negate all Spell effects on the field. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase, you must pay 700 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed.

4961.name: Skull Invitation
4961.text: Each time a card(s) is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 300 damage to its owner for each card sent.

4962.name: Magical Hats
4962.text: During your opponent's Battle Phase: Choose 2 Spells/Traps from your Deck and 1 monster in your Main Monster Zone. Special Summon them as Normal Monsters (ATK 0/DEF 0) in face-down Defense Position, Set the chosen monster if it is face-up, and shuffle them on the field. The 2 cards chosen from your Deck are destroyed at the end of the Battle Phase, and cannot remain on the field except during this Battle Phase.

4963.name: Nobleman of Crossout
4963.text: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.

4964.name: Nobleman of Extermination
4964.text: Target 1 face-down Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Trap, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that card's name.

4965.name: The Shallow Grave
4965.text: Each player targets 1 monster in their own GY; each player Special Summons the target from their GY in face-down Defense Position.

4966.name: Premature Burial
4966.text: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it in Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

4967.name: Inspection
4967.text: During your opponent's Standby Phase, you can randomly select 1 card in your opponent's hand and look at it at the cost of 500 Life Points.

4968.name: Prohibition
4968.text: Activate by declaring 1 card name. Cards with that name, and their effects, cannot be used. Cards already on the field are not affected (including face-down cards).

4969.name: Morphing Jar #2
4969.text: FLIP: Shuffle all monsters on the field into the Deck. Then, each player excavates cards from the top of their Deck, until they excavate the same number of monsters they shuffled into their Main Deck. Special Summon all excavated Level 4 or lower monsters in face-down Defense Position, also send the remaining cards to the GY.

4970.name: Bubonic Vermin
4970.text: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 "Bubonic Vermin" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position. Then shuffle your Deck.

4971.name: Flame Champion
4971.text: A warrior protected by a flaming shield that nullifies any attack.

4972.name: Twin-Headed Fire Dragon
4972.text: Two dragons fused as one from the effects of the Big Bang.

4973.name: Darkfire Soldier #1
4973.text: An explosive expert from a special elite force.

4974.name: Mr. Volcano
4974.text: This seemingly mild-mannered creature has an extremely volatile temper.

4975.name: Darkfire Soldier #2
4975.text: A warrior who gained immeasurable power from the heart of a volcano.

4976.name: Kiseitai
4976.text: When your opponent's monster attacks this card in face-down Defense Position, this card becomes an Equip Spell Card equipped to the attacking monster (No damage calculation is conducted). During each of your opponent's Standby Phases, increase your Life Points by half of the ATK of the monster equipped with this card.

4977.name: Cyber Falcon
4977.text:
A jet-powered hawk that travels at the speed of sound.

(This card is not treated as a "Cyber" card.)

4978.name: Dark Bat
4978.text: Bats from the netherworld that use their hyper senses to detect their enemies.

4979.name: Flying Kamakiri #2
4979.text: A flying mantis that feeds primarily on insects.

4980.name: Sky Scout
4980.text: With eyes like a hawk and a flying speed exceeding Mach 5, this monster is a master of the sky.

4981.name: Oni Tank T-34
4981.text: An armored tank possessed by a fiend that will pursue enemies until they're crushed.

4982.name: Overdrive
4982.text: An all-terrain armored vehicle armed with a heavy-duty machine gun.

4983.name: Buster Blader
4983.text: Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster your opponent controls or is in their GY.

4984.name: Time Seal
4984.text: Skip the Draw Phase of your opponent's next turn.

4985.name: Graverobber
4985.text: Select 1 Spell Card from your opponent's Graveyard. You can use it as your hand until the end of the turn. If you use it, you take 2000 points of damage.

4986.name: Gift of The Mystical Elf
4986.text: Gain 300 LP for each monster on the field.

4987.name: The Eye of Truth
4987.text: Your opponent must keep their hand revealed. Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase, if they have a Spell(s) in their hand: They gain 1000 LP if they have a Spell(s) in their hand at resolution.

4988.name: Dust Tornado
4988.text: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your hand.

4989.name: Call of the Haunted
4989.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

4991.name: Earthshaker
4991.text: Select 2 Monster Card Attributes. Your opponent then selects 1 of the 2 Attributes and destroys all face-up monsters with that Attribute on the field.

4992.name: Enchanted Javelin
4992.text: Increase your Life Points by the ATK of 1 attacking monster.

4993.name: Mirror Wall
4993.text: Halve the ATK of your opponent's attacking monsters. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 2000 LP or destroy this card.

5003.name: Alligator's Sword Dragon
5003.text: This card can attack your opponent directly if the only face-up monsters they control are EARTH, WATER, or FIRE.

5005.name: Ring of Destruction
5005.text: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to their LP; destroy that face-up monster, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK, then inflict damage to your opponent, equal to the damage you took. You can only activate 1 "Ring of Destruction" per turn.

5012.name: The Legendary Exodia Incarnate
5012.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Forbidden One" monster. Gains 1000 ATK for each "Forbidden One" monster in your GY. Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Add 1 "Forbidden One" monster from your GY to your hand. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can reveal any number of "Forbidden One" monsters in your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card for each.

5016.name: King Tiger Wanghu
5016.text: If a monster(s) with 1400 or less ATK is Normal or Special Summoned while you control this card: Destroy those monsters with 1400 or less ATK. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

5018.name: Wolf Axwielder
5018.text: Once it has started battle, this monster attacks fiercely and cannot stop.

5019.name: The Illusory Gentleman
5019.text: Wearing odd fashions, this gentleman is very fickle. He sometimes saves people and at other times commits crimes.

5020.name: Patrician of Darkness
5020.text: You choose the attack targets for your opponent's attacks.

5021.name: Birdface
5021.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can add 1 "Harpie Lady" from your Deck to your hand.

5022.name: Kryuel
5022.text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

5023.name: Airknight Parshath
5023.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Draw 1 card.

5025.name: Serpentine Princess
5025.text: If this face-up card is shuffled from the field into your Deck: Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower monster from your Deck.

5026.name: Maiden of the Aqua
5026.text: While there is no face-up Field Spell, the field is treated as "Umi".

5027.name: Robotic Knight
5027.text: The Commander of Machine-Types, he serves the Machine King. He is famous for the way he controls his troops.

5028.name: Thunder Nyan Nyan
5028.text: If there is a non-LIGHT monster on your side of the field, destroy this face-up card.

5029.name: Molten Behemoth
5029.text: A giant born from magma, it attacks with a magma punch.

5030.name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
5030.text: During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon this card, but its ATK/DEF become 1000. You can only use this effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.

5031.name: Injection Fairy Lily
5031.text: Once per battle, during damage calculation, if this card battles (Quick Effect): You can pay 2000 LP; this card gains 3000 ATK during that damage calculation only.

5032.name: Woodland Sprite
5032.text: Send 1 Equip Card equipped to this card to the Graveyard. Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5033.name: Arsenal Bug
5033.text: If you control no other Insect-Type monsters, this card's ATK and DEF become 1000.

5035.name: Jowls of Dark Demise
5035.text: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; gain control of it (until the End Phase), and if you do, it can attack your opponent directly this turn.

5038.name: Shapesnatch
5038.text: A bow tie with horrible power, it attacks an opponent by controlling others.

5041.name: Timeater
5041.text: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Your opponent skips their next Main Phase 1.

5042.name: Mucus Yolk
5042.text: This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, increase the ATK of this card by 1000 points during your next Standby Phase. The ATK increase lasts as long as this card remains face-up on the field.

5043.name: Servant of Catabolism
5043.text: This monster may attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

5045.name: Moisture Creature
5045.text: You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way: Destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.

5046.name: Boneheimer
5046.text: This monster wanders the seas, sucking dry any creatures it may encounter.

5048.name: Flame Dancer
5048.text: This monster moves while swinging its burning rope.

5051.name: Soul Scissors
5051.text: If a monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. If this card is Special Summoned from the GY: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "Soul Scissors" once per turn.

5053.name: Sonic Jammer
5053.text: FLIP: Your opponent cannot activate any Spell Cards until the end of the End Phase of the next turn.

5059.name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
5059.text: If either player equips an Equip Card(s) to this card: Destroy that Equip Card(s).

5060.name: Humanoid Slime
5060.text: This slime apparently has some human genes in its genetic makeup.

5061.name: Worm Drake
5061.text: Once this monster wraps itself around a victim, there is no escape.

5063.name: Revival Jam
5063.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can pay 1000 LP; Special Summon it in Defense Position during your next Standby Phase.

5065.name: Flying Fish
5065.text: Three wishes are granted to those fortunate enough to see this monster in flight.

5066.name: Amphibian Beast
5066.text: On land or in the sea, the speed of this monster is unmatchable.

5069.name: The Legendary Fisherman
5069.text: While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

5072.name: Robolady
5072.text: A warrior fully covered with metal. It upgrades by fusing with "Roboyarou".

5073.name: Roboyarou
5073.text: A warrior fully covered with metal. It upgrades by fusing with "Robolady".

5079.name: Lightning Conger
5079.text: This massive eel generates huge charges of electricity and unleashes them as thunderbolts.

5083.name: Light Law Medium
5083.text: At the start of your opponent's Battle Phase: You can target any number of Attack Position monsters your opponent controls; while this card is in your Monster Zone, those monsters must attack this card this turn, if able. Once per turn, when an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's Attack Position monster: You can negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the original ATK of that opponent's monster.

5086.name: Spherous Lady
5086.text: Many have been deceived by the beauty of this vampire.

5090.name: Shining Abyss
5090.text: This monster employs the powers of both Light and Darkness.

5092.name: Gadget Soldier
5092.text: A rust-free machine warrior born to battle.

5093.name: Grand Tiki Elder
5093.text: A masked monster that wields the most deadly of curses.

5094.name: The Masked Beast
5094.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Curse of the Masked Beast".

5095.name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
5095.text: This monster has four different masks for four different attacks.

5096.name: Nuvia the Wicked
5096.text: If this monster is Normal Summoned, destroy this card. If your opponent controls any monster, decrease the ATK of this card by 200 points for each monster on your opponents side of the field.

5101.name: Chosen One
5101.text: Select 1 Monster Card and 2 non-Monster Cards from your hand. Your opponent randomly selects 1 card among them. If it is a Monster Card, it is Special Summoned and send the remaining 2 cards to the Graveyard. If not, send all the cards to the Graveyard.

5102.name: Mask of Weakness
5102.text: Target 1 attacking monster; that target loses 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

5103.name: Curse of the Masked Beast
5103.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "The Masked Beast". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

5104.name: Mask of Dispel
5104.text: Select 1 face-up Spell Card on the field. The controller of the Spell Card takes 500 points of damage during each of your Standby Phases. When the selected card is removed from the field, destroy this card.

5107.name: Mask of the Accursed
5107.text: The equipped monster cannot attack. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 500 damage to the controller of the equipped monster.

5108.name: Mask of Brutality
5108.text: The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK and loses 1000 DEF. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 1000 LP or destroy this card.

5109.name: Return of the Doomed
5109.text: Discard 1 Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard. Return 1 of your monsters destroyed and sent to your Graveyard as a result of battle during this turn to your hand at the end of this turn.

5110.name: Lightning Blade
5110.text: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 800 ATK. All WATER monsters on the field lose 500 ATK.

5111.name: Tornado Wall
5111.text: Activate only if "Umi" is on the field. While "Umi" is on the field, you take no battle damage. If "Umi" is not on the field, destroy this card.

5112.name: Infinite Dismissal
5112.text: Level 3 or lower monsters are destroyed during the End Phase of the turn that they are Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned.

5113.name: Fairy Box
5113.text: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, the attacking monster's ATK becomes 0 until the end of the Battle Phase. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 500 LP, or destroy this card.

5114.name: Torrential Tribute
5114.text: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

5116.name: Multiplication of Ants
5116.text: Tribute 1 Insect monster; Special Summon 2 "Army Ant Tokens" (Insect/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 500/DEF 1200). These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

5118.name: De-Fusion
5118.text: Target 1 Fusion Monster on the field; return that target to the Extra Deck, then, if all the materials that were used for its Fusion Summon are in your GY, you can Special Summon all of them.

5119.name: Jam Breeding Machine
5119.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Special Summon 1 "Slime Token" (Aqua/WATER/Level 1/ATK 500/DEF 500) in Attack Position. You cannot Summon any monsters, except "Slime Tokens" (but you can Set).

5121.name: Infinite Cards
5121.text: There is no limit to the hand size for each player.

5122.name: Jam Defender
5122.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack on a monster you control: You can target 1 "Revival Jam" you control; switch the attack target to that target.

5123.name: Card of Safe Return
5123.text: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card.

5124.name: Magic Cylinder
5124.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

5125.name: Solemn Wishes
5125.text: Each time you draw a card(s), you gain 500 LP.

5126.name: Burning Land
5126.text: When this card is activated: If there are any Field Spell Cards on the field, destroy them. During each player's Standby Phase: The turn player takes 500 damage.

5127.name: Cold Wave
5127.text: This card can only be activated at the start of Main Phase 1. Until your next turn, you and your opponent cannot play or Set any Spell or Trap Cards.

5128.name: Fairy Meteor Crush
5128.text: If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

5129.name: Limiter Removal
5129.text: Double the ATK of all Machine monsters you currently control, until the end of this turn. During the End Phase of this turn, destroy those monsters.

5130.name: Shift
5130.text: When your opponent targets exactly 1 monster you control (and no other cards) for an attack, or with a Spell/Trap effect: Target another monster you control that would be an appropriate target; that attack/Spell/Trap now targets the new target.

5131.name: Insect Imitation
5131.text: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 Insect monster from your Deck whose Level is 1 higher than the Tributed monster had on the field.

5132.name: Dimensionhole
5132.text: Select 1 monster on your side of the field and remove it from play until your next Standby Phase. While the monster is removed from play, the Monster Card Zone of the selected monster cannot be used.

5133.name: Magic Drain
5133.text: When your opponent activates a Spell Card: They can discard 1 Spell to negate this card's effect, otherwise negate the activation of their Spell Card, and if you do, destroy it.

5134.name: Gravity Bind
5134.text: Level 4 or higher monsters cannot attack.

5135.name: Shadow of Eyes
5135.text: When a monster(s) is Set on your opponent's field: Target 1 of those Set monsters; change that Set monster to face-up Attack Position. (Flip Effects are not activated.)

5136.name: Girochin Kuwagata
5136.text: Despite its small size, this monster has powerful jaws that can rip metal to shreds.

5137.name: Hayabusa Knight

5365.text: When an opponent's monster that was Tribute Summoned declares an attack: Destroy as many face-up Attack Position monsters they control as possible, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

5366.name: Agido
5366.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Roll a six-sided die, then you can Special Summon 1 Fairy monster from your GY whose Level is equal to the result. (If the result is 6, you can Special Summon a Level 6 or higher monster.)

5371.name: Fiber Jar
5371.text: FLIP: Each player shuffles all cards from their hand, field, and Graveyard into the Deck, then draws 5 cards.

5372.name: Gradius' Option
5372.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This monster can only be Special Summoned by selecting 1 face-up "Gradius" on your side of the field. The ATK and DEF of this card becomes the same as the ATK and DEF of the selected "Gradius". If the selected "Gradius" is removed from the field, destroy this card.

5373.name: Maharaghi
5373.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, look at 1 card on the top of your Deck during your next Draw Phase (before you draw), and return the card to the top or the bottom of your Deck.

5374.name: Inaba White Rabbit
5374.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. This monster attacks your opponent's Life Points directly.

5375.name: Yata-Garasu
5375.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Skip the Draw Phase of their next turn.

5376.name: Susa Soldier
5376.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. The Battle Damage this card inflicts to your opponent's Life Points is halved.

5377.name: Yamata Dragon
5377.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to its owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn it is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

5378.name: Great Long Nose
5378.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent skips their next Battle Phase.

5379.name: Otohime
5379.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

5380.name: Hino-Kagu-Tsuchi
5380.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: They discard their entire hand during the Draw Phase of the next turn, before the turn player draws.

5381.name: Asura Priest
5381.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. Can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

5382.name: Fushi No Tori
5382.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, increase your Life Points by an amount equal to the Battle Damage.

5383.name: Super Robolady
5383.text: You can Special Summon "Super Roboyarou" by returning this card from the field to the Extra Deck. You cannot use this effect during the same turn this monster is Special Summoned. In addition, increase the ATK of this monster by 1000 points during the Damage Step when this monster inflicts Direct Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5384.name: Super Roboyarou
5384.text: You can Special Summon "Super Robolady" by returning this card from the field to the Extra Deck. You cannot use this effect during the same turn this monster is Special Summoned. In addition, increase the ATK of this monster by 1000 points during the Damage Step when this monster battles with a monster.

5385.name: Fengsheng Mirror
5385.text: Look at your opponent's hand. Select and discard 1 Spirit monster to the Graveyard if Spirit monsters exist in his/her hand.

5386.name: Heart of Clear Water
5386.text: If the equipped monster's ATK is 1300 or higher, this card is destroyed. The monster equipped with this card is not destroyed as a result of battle or by the effect of a card that targets the monster. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)

5387.name: A Legendary Ocean
5387.text:
(This card is always treated as "Umi".)
All WATER monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both players' hands and on the field by 1.

5388.name: Fusion Sword Murasame Blade
5388.text: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 800 ATK. While equipped to a monster, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

5389.name: Smoke Grenade of the Thief
5389.text: When this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped to a monster: Look at your opponent's hand and discard 1 card from their hand.

5390.name: Spiritual Energy Settle Machine
5390.text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, all Spirit monsters remain face-up on the field and do not return to their owners' hands during the End Phase even if they are Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. Discard 1 card from your hand during each of your End Phases. If you do not, destroy this card. When this card is removed from the field, all face-up Spirit monsters return to the owners' hands.

5391.name: Second Coin Toss
5391.text: When a coin toss is performed, you can choose to redo the coin toss. (If the toss involved multiple coin flips, redo all of them.) You can only use the effect of "Second Coin Toss" once per turn.

5392.name: Convulsion of Nature
5392.text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, both players must turn their respective Decks upside down and proceed with the current Duel.

5393.name: The Secret of the Bandit
5393.text: This card can only be activated during Main Phase 1. Select 1 face-up monster on the field. Each time the selected monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points this turn, your opponent discards 1 random card.

5394.name: After the Struggle
5394.text: This card can only be activated during Main Phase 1. All monsters on both sides of the field that have been involved in damage calculation are destroyed during the End Step of the turn.

5395.name: Magic Reflector
5395.text: Select 1 Spell Card that remains face-up on the field and put 1 counter on it. If the selected card would be destroyed, the counter is removed instead.

5396.name: Blast with Chain
5396.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If this card is destroyed by card effect while equipped: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

5397.name: Disappear
5397.text: Remove from play 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard.

5398.name: Bubble Crash
5398.text: This card can only be activated when any player has 6 or more cards on the field and/or in their hand. The player(s) then select and send cards to their respective Graveyards until the amount remaining on the field and in their hand is 5.

5399.name: Royal Oppression
5399.text: Either player can pay 800 Life Points to negate the Special Summon of a monster(s), and/or an effect that Special Summons a monster(s), and destroy those cards.

5400.name: Bottomless Trap Hole
5400.text: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.

5401.name: Ominous Fortunetelling
5401.text: During your Standby Phase, select 1 random card from your opponent's hand. Call the type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap). If you call it right, inflict 700 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points. You can use this effect only once per turn.

5402.name: Spirit's Invitation
5402.text: Each time your Spirit monster returns to your hand, select 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and return it to its owner's hand. Pay 500 Life Points during each of your Standby Phases. If you do not, destroy this card.

5403.name: Nutrient Z
5403.text: During damage calculation, when you are about to take 2000 or more battle damage: Gain 4000 LP first.

5404.name: Drop Off
5404.text: When your opponent draws for their normal draw in their Draw Phase: Your opponent discards 1 card they just drew.

5405.name: Fiend Comedian
5405.text: Toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, all your opponent's cards in the Graveyard are removed from play immediately. If you call it wrong, send a number of cards equal to the cards in your opponent's Graveyard from your Deck to your Graveyard.

5406.name: Last Turn
5406.text: This card can only be activated during your opponent's turn when your Life Points are 1000 or less. Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send all other cards on the field and in their respective owners' hands to their respective Graveyards. After that, your opponent selects and Special Summons 1 monster from their Deck in face-up Attack Position and attacks your selected monster. (Any Battle Damage from this battle is treated as 0.) The player whose monster remains alone on the field at the End Phase of this turn wins the Duel. Any other case results in a DRAW.

5410.name: Vampire Lord
5410.text: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the GY. Once per turn, during your next Standby Phase after this card in your possession was destroyed and sent to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the GY.

5411.name: Gora Turtle
5411.text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, monsters with an ATK equal to 1900 or more cannot declare an attack.

5412.name: Sasuke Samurai
5412.text: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster.

5413.name: Poison Mummy
5413.text: FLIP: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

5414.name: Dark Dust Spirit
5414.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Destroy all other face-up monsters on the field.

5415.name: Royal Keeper
5415.text: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is flipped face-up, it gains 300 ATK and DEF until the end of the turn. (If attacked, this effect resolves after damage calculation.)

5416.name: Wandering Mummy
5416.text: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. After you use this effect, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters in your Main Monster Zones, then return them in face-down Defense Position.

5417.name: Great Dezard
5417.text:
When this monster destroys the following number of monsters as a result of battle, the following effects are activated in order:
One: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them.
Two: You can Special Summon 1 "Fushioh Richie" from your hand or your Deck by Tributing this card during your Main Phase.

5418.name: Swarm of Scarabs
5418.text: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5419.name: Swarm of Locusts
5419.text: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5420.name: Giant Axe Mummy
5420.text: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. If the ATK of a monster on your opponent's side of the field that attacks this card in face-down Defense Position is lower than the DEF of this monster, the attacking monster is destroyed.

5421.name: 8-Claws Scorpion
5421.text: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card attacks an opponent's face-down Defense Position monster, this card's ATK becomes 2400 during damage calculation only.

5422.name: Guardian Sphinx
5422.text: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Return all monsters your opponent controls to the hand.

5423.name: Pyramid Turtle
5423.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster with 2000 or less DEF from your Deck.

5424.name: Dice Jar
5424.text: FLIP: Both players roll a six-sided die. The player with the lower result takes damage equal to their opponent's roll x 500. However, if the winner rolled a 6, the loser takes 6000 damage. If the rolls are the same, both players roll again.

5425.name: Dark Scorpion Burglars
5425.text: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Your opponent sends 1 Spell Card from their Deck to the Graveyard.

5426.name: Don Zaloog

5427.name: Des Lacooda
5427.text: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Draw 1 card.

5428.name: Fushioh Richie
5428.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned from your hand or your Deck by Tributing 1 "Great Dezard" that has fulfilled the condition. You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. As long as this monster remains face-up on the field, negate the activation and effects of all Spell and Trap Cards that target this card and destroy them. When this card is flipped face-up, you can Special Summon 1 Zombie-Type monster from your Graveyard.

5429.name: Cobraman Sakuzy
5429.text: You can flip this card into face-down Defense Position once per turn during your Main Phase. When this card is flipped face-up, look at all Set Spell and Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field and then return them to their original position.

5430.name: Book of Life
5430.text: Target 1 Zombie monster in your GY and 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon the first target, also banish the second target.

5431.name: Book of Taiyou
5431.text: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; change that target to face-up Attack Position.

5432.name: Book of Moon
5432.text: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

5433.name: Mirage of Nightmare
5433.text: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: Draw until you have 4 cards in your hand. If you do, once during your next Standby Phase after that: Randomly discard the same number of cards you drew (or your entire hand, if you do not have enough cards).

5434.name: Secret Pass to the Treasures
5434.text: Select 1 face-up monster with an ATK equal to 1000 points or less on your side of the field. During the turn this card is activated, the selected monster can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

5435.name: Call of the Mummy
5435.text: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

5436.name: Timidity
5436.text: Neither player can destroy Set Spell and Trap Cards on the field until your opponent's next End Phase.

5437.name: Pyramid Energy
5437.text:
You can select and activate 1 of the following effects:
●Increase the ATK of all face-up monsters on your side of the field by 200 points until the End Phase of the turn this card is activated.
●Increase the DEF of all face-up monsters on your side of the field by 500 points until the End Phase of the turn this card is activated.

5438.name: Tutan Mask
5438.text: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated that targets exactly 1 Zombie monster on the field (and no other cards): Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

5439.name: Ordeal of a Traveler
5439.text: Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can activate this effect; Your opponent chooses 1 random card in your hand and calls the card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap), and if they call it wrong, return the attacking monster to the hand.

5440.name: Bottomless Shifting Sand
5440.text: At the end of your opponent's turn, destroy the face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field. During your own Standby Phase, if you have 4 or less cards in your hand, this card is destroyed.

5441.name: Curse of Royal
5441.text: Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that includes the effect of destroying 1 Spell or Trap Card and destroy it.

5442.name: Needle Ceiling
5442.text: If there are 4 or more monsters on the field: Destroy all face-up monsters.

5443.name: Statue of the Wicked
5443.text: If this Set card is destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 "Wicked Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000).

5444.name: Dark Coffin
5444.text:
When this face-down card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, your opponent selects and executes 1 of the following effects:
●Discard 1 random card in their hand.
●Select 1 monster on their side of the field and destroy it.

5445.name: Needle Wall
5445.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Roll a six-sided die. Treat your opponent's Main Monster Zones as numbers 1-5, counting from your right, and destroy the monster that is in the same Main Monster Zone as the result. If the result is 6, roll again.

5446.name: Trap Dustshoot
5446.text: If your opponent has 4 or more cards in their hand: Look at your opponent's hand and choose 1 monster from it to shuffle into the Deck.

5447.name: Pyro Clock of Destiny
5447.text: Move the turn count forward by 1 turn. The turn in which this card is activated continues as normal.

5448.name: Reckless Greed
5448.text: Draw 2 cards and skip your next 2 Draw Phases.

5449.name: Pharaoh's Treasure
5449.text: Shuffle this card face-up into your Deck. If you draw this face-up card that was added to the Deck by this effect: Send it to the GY, then target 1 card in your GY, except this card; add that target to your hand.

5479.name: Card of Sanctity
5479.text: Banish all other cards you control and in your hand (min.1 from each); draw until you have 2 cards in your hand.

5480.name: Dark Designator
5480.text: Declare 1 Monster Card name. If the declared card is in your opponent's Deck, add 1 of that card to your opponent's hand.

5484.name: Newdoria
5484.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

5485.name: Lord Poison
5485.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 Plant monster in your GY, except "Lord Poison"; Special Summon that target.

5489.name: Helpoemer
5489.text: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. At the end of your opponent's Battle Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle: Make your opponent discard 1 random card. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

5492.name: Coffin Seller
5492.text: Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

5494.name: Question
5494.text: When activating this card, your opponent cannot check cards in the Graveyard. Your opponent calls the name of the first monster found at the bottom of your Graveyard. If he/she calls it right, the monster is removed from play. If he/she calls it wrong, the monster is Special Summoned to your side of the field.

5496.name: Lava Golem
5496.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) to your opponent's field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you Special Summon this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

5498.name: Machine Duplication
5498.text: Target 1 Machine monster you control with 500 or less ATK; Special Summon up to 2 monsters from your Deck with the same name as that face-up monster.

5499.name: Dark Jeroid
5499.text: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 800 ATK.

5501.name: Dragon Master Knight
5501.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. This card gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster you control, except this card.

5503.name: Queen's Knight
5503.text: This knight catches her opponents off guard, dominating them with swift yet graceful attacks.

5504.name: X-Head Cannon
5504.text: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.

5505.name: Enemy Controller

5506.name: Master Kyonshee
5506.text: A wandering Kyonshee searching for a strong rival to defeat. They say he was known as the master of all martial arts.

5507.name: Kabazauls
5507.text: A huge monster in the shape of a hippopotamus. The sneezing from his gigantic body is so fierce that people mistake it for a hurricane.

5508.name: Inpachi
5508.text: A log that attacks lost travelers in the forest. Originally a big tree, it was cut down and possessed by a wicked spirit.

5509.name: Gravekeeper's Spy
5509.text: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

5510.name: Gravekeeper's Curse
5510.text: If this card is Summoned: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

5511.name: Gravekeeper's Guard
5511.text: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

5512.name: Gravekeeper's Spear Soldier
5512.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

5513.name: Gravekeeper's Vassal
5513.text: Any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is treated as effect damage instead.

5514.name: Gravekeeper's Watcher
5514.text: During either player's turn, when your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that could make them discard when it resolves: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

5515.name: Gravekeeper's Chief
5515.text: You can only control 1 face-up "Gravekeeper's Chief". Your GY is unaffected by "Necrovalley". When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

5516.name: Gravekeeper's Cannonholder
5516.text: You can Tribute 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster, except "Gravekeeper's Cannonholder"; inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

5517.name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
5517.text: When this card declares an attack while "Necrovalley" is on the field: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

5518.name: A Man with Wdjat
5518.text: When you Normal Summon this card, and during each of your Standby Phases, select 1 Set card on your opponent's side of the field. Pick it up and look at it, then return it to its original position.

5519.name: Mystical Knight of Jackal
5519.text: When this card destroys 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field and sends it to your opponent's Graveyard as a result of battle, you can then return the card to the top of your opponent's Deck.

5520.name: A Cat of Ill Omen
5520.text: FLIP: Choose 1 Trap from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck, or, if "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add that Trap to your hand instead.

5521.name: Yomi Ship
5521.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Destroy the monster that destroyed this card.

5522.name: Winged Sage Falcos
5522.text: When this card destroys an opponent's face-up Attack Position monster by battle and sends it to their Graveyard: You can place that monster on top of their Deck.

5523.name: An Owl of Luck
5523.text: FLIP: Select 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck. If "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add the selected Field Spell Card to your hand instead.

5524.name: Charm of Shabti
5524.text: During either player's turn: You can discard this card; until the End Phase, "Gravekeeper's" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle.

5525.name: Cobra Jar
5525.text: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Poisonous Snake Token" (Reptile-Type/EARTH/Level 3/ATK 1200/DEF 1200). When the "Poisonous Snake Token" is destroyed as a result of battle, inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5526.name: Spirit Reaper
5526.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After resolving a card effect that targets this face-up card, destroy this card. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from their hand.

5527.name: Nightmare Horse
5527.text: This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly even if there is a monster on your opponent's side of the field.

5528.name: Reaper on the Nightmare
5528.text: This card is not destroyed as a result of battle. Destroy this card when it is targeted by the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster. This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly even if there is a monster on your opponent's side of the field. If this card successfully attacks your opponent's Life Points directly, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand.

5529.name: Card Shuffle
5529.text: Pay 300 Life Points to use this card's effect. Shuffle either your or your opponent's Deck. You can only use this effect during your turn, once per turn.

5530.name: Reasoning
5530.text: Your opponent declares a monster Level from 1 to 12. Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, then, if that monster is the same Level as the one declared by your opponent, send all excavated cards to the GY. If not, Special Summon the excavated monster, also send the remaining cards to the GY.

5531.name: Dark Room of Nightmare
5531.text: Each time your opponent takes damage from a card effect, except "Dark Room of Nightmare", inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

5532.name: Different Dimension Capsule
5532.text: Banish 1 card from your Deck face-down. After this card's activation, it remains on the field. Destroy this card during your 2nd Standby Phase after activating this card, and if you do, add the banished card to the hand.

5533.name: Necrovalley
5533.text: All "Gravekeeper's" monsters on the field gain 500 ATK/DEF. Cards in the GY cannot be banished. Negate any card effect that would move a card in the GY to a different place. Negate any card effect that changes Types or Attributes in the GY.

5534.name: Buster Rancher
5534.text: Only a monster with an ATK of 1000 points or less can be equipped with this card. During damage calculation, increase the ATK of the monster equipped with this card by 2500 points if the opponent's monster that battles it is in Attack Position and its ATK is 2500 or more, OR if the opponent's monster that battles it is in Defense Position and its DEF is 2500 or more.

5535.name: Hieroglyph Lithograph
5535.text: Pay 1000 Life Points. During the current Duel, your hand size limit becomes 7.

5536.name: Dark Snake Syndrome
5536.text: During each of your Standby Phases: Inflict damage to both players. This damage begins at 200 and is doubled during each of your following Standby Phases.

5537.name: Terraforming
5537.text: Add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.

5538.name: Banner of Courage
5538.text: All monsters you control gain 200 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

5539.name: Metamorphosis
5539.text: Tribute 1 monster. Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with the same Level as the Tributed monster.

5540.name: Royal Tribute
5540.text: If you control "Necrovalley": Both players discard any monsters in their hands.

5541.name: Reversal Quiz
5541.text: Send all cards in your hand and on your side of the field to the Graveyard. Call the type of card (Spell, Trap, or Monster) on top of your Deck. If you call it right, exchange your current Life Points with your opponent's current ones.

5542.name: Curse of Aging
5542.text: Discard 1 card; all monsters your opponent currently controls lose 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

5543.name: Barrel Behind the Door
5543.text: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that would inflict damage to you: Your opponent takes the damage instead.

5544.name: Raigeki Break
5544.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

5545.name: Narrow Pass
5545.text: This card can only be activated when both players have 2 monsters or less on their respective sides of the field. Both players can only Normal Summon up to 2 additional monsters on their sides of the field.

5546.name: Disturbance Strategy
5546.text: Your opponent shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards.

5547.name: Trap of Board Eraser
5547.text: When an effect that inflicts damage to your Life Points is activated (except Battle Damage), negate the damage to your Life Points. Your opponent then selects 1 card from his/her hand and discards it to his/her Graveyard.

5548.name: Rite of Spirit
5548.text: Target 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. This card's activation and effect are unaffected by "Necrovalley".

5549.name: Non Aggression Area
5549.text: You can only activate this card during your Standby Phase. Discard 1 card from your hand. Your opponent cannot Normal Summon, Set and/or Special Summon during his/her next turn.

5550.name: D. Tribe
5550.text: All monsters on your side of the field are treated as Dragon-Types until the End Phase of this turn.

5552.name: Y-Dragon Head
5552.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 400 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

5553.name: XY-Dragon Cannon
5553.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5555.name: Z-Metal Tank
5555.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "X-Head Cannon" or "Y-Dragon Head" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 600 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

5556.name: XYZ-Dragon Cannon
5556.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5558.name: King's Knight
5558.text: When this card is Normal Summoned while you control "Queen's Knight": You can Special Summon 1 "Jack's Knight" from your Deck.

5559.name: Jack's Knight
5559.text: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

5560.name: Interdimensional Matter Transporter
5560.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; banish that target until the End Phase.

5562.name: Drillago
5562.text: If the only cards your opponent controls are face-up monsters with 1600 or more ATK, this card can attack your opponent directly.

5564.name: Lekunga
5564.text: You can banish 2 WATER monsters from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Lekunga Token" (Plant/WATER/Level 2/ATK 700/DEF 700) in Attack Position.

5575.name: Cost Down
5575.text: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

5578.name: People Running About
5578.text: Although they always suffer in silence, they swear an oath to inevitably revolt.

5579.name: Oppressed People
5579.text: They are oppressed, but believe they will have their freedom someday.

5580.name: United Resistance
5580.text: The people that gather to swear to fight their oppressors. A revolution is coming.

5581.name: Dark Blade
5581.text: They say he is a dragon-manipulating warrior from the dark world. His attack is tremendous, using his great swords with vicious power.

5582.name: Pitch-Dark Dragon
5582.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 400 points. When it attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5583.name: Kiryu
5583.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Dark Blade" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK/DEF of the equipped monster by 900 points, and you can Tribute this card to allow the equipped monster to attack your opponent's Life Points directly this turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5584.name: Decayed Commander
5584.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Zombie Tiger" from your hand. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Discard 1 random card from their hand.

5585.name: Zombie Tiger
5585.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "Decayed Commander" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK/DEF. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Discard 1 random card from their hand. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

5586.name: Giant Orc
5586.text: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. It cannot change its battle position until the end of your next turn.

5587.name: Second Goblin
5587.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Giant Orc" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change the equipped monster's battle position once per turn. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5588.name: Vampiric Orchis (Updated from: Vampire Orchis)
5588.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Des Dendle" from your hand.

5589.name: Des Dendle
5589.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Vampiric Orchis" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster destroys 1 of your opponent's monsters, Special Summon 1 "Wicked Plant Token" (Plant-Type/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 800/DEF 800). (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5590.name: Burning Beast
5590.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Freezing Beast" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 face-up Spell or Trap Card on the field. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5591.name: Freezing Beast
5591.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to your "Burning Beast" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, each time the equipped monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, destroy 1 face-down Spell or Trap Card on the field. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5592.name: Union Rider
5592.text: You can take control of up to 1 Union Monster that is currently a monster on your opponent's side of the field, and equip it to this card. The Union Monster that is equipped to this card cannot be changed back to a monster using its own effect.

5593.name: D.D. Crazy Beast
5593.text: A monster that this card destroys as a result of battle is removed from play.

5594.name: Spell Canceller
5594.text: Spell Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. Negate all Spell effects on the field.

5595.name: Neko Mane King
5595.text: During your opponent's turn, when this card in your possession is sent to your GY by an opponent's card effect: It becomes the End Phase of this turn.

5596.name: Helping Robo for Combat
5596.text: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card, then return 1 card from your hand to the bottom of the Deck.

5597.name: Dimension Jar
5597.text: FLIP: Both players can remove from play up to 3 monsters from their opponent's Graveyard.

5598.name: Great Phantom Thief
5598.text: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card name; look at your opponent's hand, and if you do, discard all cards with that name in their hand.

5599.name: Roulette Barrel
5599.text: Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die twice, choose 1 result, and destroy 1 monster on the field whose Level is equal to that result.

5600.name: Paladin of White Dragon
5600.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "White Dragon Ritual". At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that face-down monster. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand or Deck, but "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" cannot attack for the rest of this turn.

5601.name: White Dragon Ritual
5601.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Paladin of White Dragon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 4 or more.

5602.name: Frontline Base
5602.text: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Union monster from your hand.

5603.name: Demotion
5603.text: Downgrade the monster equipped with this card by 2 Levels.

5604.name: Combination Attack
5604.text: During a Battle Phase, you can use this effect on 1 monster that has attacked this turn and is equipped with a Union Monster. Change the Union Monster back to a monster in face-up Attack or Defense Position. Also, the monster that was equipped with the Union Monster may attack again this turn.

5605.name: Kaiser Colosseum
5605.text: If there is 1 or more monster(s) on the field of the controller of this card, his/her opponent cannot place a monster on the field if his/her number of monsters would exceed the number of monsters that are on the field of this card's controller. The cards that are already on the field before this card's activation are unaffected by this effect.

5606.name: Autonomous Action Unit
5606.text: Pay 1500 LP, then target 1 monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon it to your field in Attack Position, and equip it with this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

5607.name: Poison of the Old Man

5608.name: Ante
5608.text: Each Player reveals 1 card from their hand. If one card is higher Level than the other, the card with the lower Level is sent to the Graveyard, and the player who revealed it takes 1000 damage. (Non-Monster Cards are treated as Level 0.)

5609.name: Dark Core
5609.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; banish that target.

5610.name: Raregold Armor
5610.text: As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot attack other monsters other than the equipped monster.

5611.name: Metalsilver Armor
5611.text: As long as you control the monster equipped with this card, your opponent cannot use the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster that targets 1 monster, except the equipped monster.

5612.name: Kishido Spirit
5612.text: Monsters on your side of the field cannot be destroyed in a battle if the monsters' ATK are equal.

5613.name: Tribute Doll
5613.text: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 Level 7 monster from your hand that can be Normal Summoned/Set. It cannot attack this turn.

5614.name: Wave-Motion Cannon
5614.text: During your Main Phase: You can send this face-up card to the GY; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each of your Standby Phases that have passed since this card was activated.

5615.name: Huge Revolution
5615.text: This card can only be activated during your Main Phase when "People Running About", "Oppressed People", and "United Resistance" are face-up on your side of the field. Send all cards in your opponent's hand to the Graveyard and destroy all cards your opponent controls on the field.

5616.name: Thunder of Ruler
5616.text: During your opponent's Standby Phase: You can activate this card; there is no Battle Phase this turn.

5617.name: Spell Shield Type-8
5617.text:
Activate 1 of these effects.
●When a Spell Card is activated that targets exactly 1 monster on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
●When a Spell Card is activated: Send 1 Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

5618.name: Meteorain
5618.text: During this turn, when your monsters attack with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5619.name: Pineapple Blast
5619.text: When you Normal Summon a monster, if your opponent controls more monsters than you do: Your opponent chooses monster(s) they control, equal to the number of monsters you control, then you destroy all of their monsters they did not choose.

5620.name: Secret Barrel
5620.text: Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand and for each card they control.

5621.name: Physical Double
5621.text: During your opponent's turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; Special Summon 1 "Mirage Token" with the same Level, Type, Attribute, ATK, and DEF as that target. Destroy this Token during the End Phase.

5622.name: Rivalry of Warlords
5622.text: Each player can only control 1 Type of monster. Send all other face-up monsters they control to the GY.

5623.name: Formation Union
5623.text:
Activate 1 of the following effects.
●Target 1 face-up Union monster you control; equip it to 1 appropriate monster you control.
●Unequip 1 Union monster you control that is an Equip Card and Special Summon it in Attack Position.

5624.name: Adhesion Trap Hole
5624.text: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

5625.name: XZ-Tank Cannon
5625.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5626.name: YZ-Tank Dragon
5626.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 face-down monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5627.name: Final Attack Orders
5627.text: All face-up monsters on the field are changed to Attack Position and their battle positions cannot be changed.

5628.name: Dark Paladin
5628.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. When a Spell Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Gains 500 ATK for each Dragon monster on the field and in the GYs.

5629.name: Double Spell
5629.text: Discard 1 Spell, then target 1 Spell in your opponent's GY; place that target in the appropriate Zone on your field, and as this card's effect resolution, follow its card text as if you had used it yourself.

5630.name: Spell Absorption
5630.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, gain 500 LP immediately after it resolves.

5631.name: Diffusion Wave-Motion
5631.text:
(This card is not treated as a "Fusion" card.)
If your opponent controls a monster: Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Level 7 or higher Spellcaster monster you control; this turn, it must attack all monsters your opponent controls once each, also other monsters you control cannot attack. The effects of monsters destroyed by these attacks cannot activate and are negated.

5641.name: Great Angus
5641.text: A very violent beast, it is always berserk. People say that they have never seen it silent.

5642.name: Aitsu
5642.text: He seems to be very unreliable, but he might have incredible potential.

5643.name: Sonic Duck
5643.text: A duck which can walk at a sonic speed. Sometimes, he cannot deal with his incredible pace and loses control.

5644.name: Luster Dragon
5644.text: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

5645.name: Amazoness Paladin
5645.text: Gains 100 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control.

5646.name: Amazoness Blowpiper
5646.text: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls during each of your Standby Phases. It loses 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

5647.name: Amazoness Tiger
5647.text: You can only control 1 "Amazoness Tiger". Gains 400 ATK for each "Amazoness" monster you control. Your opponent's monsters cannot attack "Amazoness" monsters, except this one.

5648.name: Skilled White Magician
5648.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Buster Blader" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

5649.name: Skilled Dark Magician
5649.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

5650.name: Apprentice Magician
5650.text: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. When this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

5651.name: Old Vindictive Magician
5651.text: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5652.name: Chaos Command Magician
5652.text: Negate any monster effects that target this 1 card.

5653.name: Magical Marionette
5653.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. Gains 200 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 2 Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

5654.name: Pixie Knight
5654.text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, your opponent selects 1 Spell Card from your Graveyard, and places that card on the top of your Deck.

5655.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
5655.text: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

5656.name: Magical Plant Mandragola
5656.text: FLIP: Place 1 Spell Counter on each face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on.

5657.name: Magical Scientist
5657.text: Pay 1000 Life Points to Special Summon 1 level 6 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck in face-up Attack or Defense Position. That Fusion Monster cannot attack your opponent's Life Points directly, and is returned to your Extra Deck at the end of the turn.

5658.name: Royal Magical Library
5658.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can remove 3 Spell Counters from this card; draw 1 card.

5659.name: Armor Exe
5659.text: This card cannot attack in the same turn it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned. During each of your and your opponent's Standby Phases, remove 1 Spell Counter on your side of the field. If you do not, destroy this card.

5660.name: Tribe-Infecting Virus
5660.text: Discard 1 card, then declare 1 Monster Type; destroy all monsters on the field with the declared Type.

5661.name: Des Koala
5661.text: FLIP: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand.

5662.name: Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover
5662.text:
When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can activate 1 of these effects.
●Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.
●Send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the GY.

5663.name: Magical Merchant
5663.text: FLIP: Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a Spell/Trap, then add that card to your hand, also send the remaining cards to the GY.

5664.name: Koitsu
5664.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card on the field, you can equip it to your "Aitsu" as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 3000 points. When it attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.
