(1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5665.name: Cat's Ear Tribe
5665.text: The original ATK of your opponent's monster(s) that battles with this card during his/her turn becomes 200 points during the Damage Step.

5666.name: Ultimate Obedient Fiend
5666.text: This card can only attack if this card is the only card on your side of the field and if you also have no cards in your hand. The effects of Effect Monsters that this card destroys are negated.

5667.name: Dark Cat with White Tail
5667.text: FLIP: Return 2 Monster Cards on your opponent's side of the field and 1 Monster Card on your side of the field to their owners' hands.

5668.name: Pitch-Black Power Stone
5668.text: Activate this card by placing 3 Spell Counters on it. Once per turn, during your turn: You can target 1 other face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, and if you do, place 1 Spell Counter on that target. When the last Spell Counter(s) is removed from this card, destroy it.

5669.name: Big Bang Shot
5669.text: The equipped monster gains 400 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent. When this card leaves the field, banish the equipped monster.

5670.name: Gather Your Mind
5670.text: Add 1 "Gather Your Mind" card from your Deck to your hand. Your Deck is then shuffled. You can only use 1 "Gather Your Mind" per turn.

5671.name: Mass Driver
5671.text: Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field to inflict 400 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5672.name: Senri Eye
5672.text: Once per turn, during each of your Standby Phases, you can pay 100 Life Points to look at 1 card on the top of your opponent's Deck and return it to its original position. Your opponent cannot look at the card.

5673.name: Emblem of Dragon Destroyer
5673.text: Add 1 "Buster Blader" from your Deck or GY to your hand.

5674.name: Jar Robber
5674.text: You can only activate this card when "Pot of Greed" is activated. Negate the effect of the "Pot of Greed" and draw 1 card from your Deck.

5675.name: My Body as a Shield
5675.text: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or monster effect that would destroy a monster(s) on the field: Pay 1500 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

5676.name: Spellbook Organization (Updated from: Pigeonholing Books of Spell)
5676.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck, then return them to the top of the Deck in any order.

5677.name: Mega Ton Magical Cannon
5677.text: Remove 10 Spell Counters from your field; destroy all cards your opponent controls.

5678.name: Continuous Destruction Punch
5678.text: If the DEF of the attacked Defense Position monster on your side of the field is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster on your opponent's side of the field, destroy the attacking monster. Damage calculation is applied normally.

5679.name: Exhausting Spell
5679.text: Remove all Spell Counters on the field.

5680.name: Hidden Spellbook (Updated from: Hidden Book of Spell)
5680.text: During your Turn: Target 2 Spell Cards in your Graveyard; shuffle those targets into the Deck.

5681.name: Miracle Restoring
5681.text: Remove 2 Spell Counters from your field, then target 1 "Dark Magician" or "Buster Blader" in your GY; Special Summon that target.

5682.name: Remove Brainwashing
5682.text: The control of all monsters on the field returns to the owners.

5683.name: Disarmament
5683.text: Destroy all Equip Cards on the field.

5684.name: Anti-Spell
5684.text: Remove 2 Spell Counters on your side of the field to negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it.

5685.name: The Spell Absorbing Life
5685.text: Flip all face-down Defense Position Monster Cards on the field face-up. Flip Effects are not activated at this time. Increase your Life Points by 400 points for each Effect Monster Card on the field.

5687.name: Bowganian
5687.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

5695.name: Granadora
5695.text: If this card is Summoned: Gain 1000 LP. If this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You take 2000 damage.

5696.name: Different Dimension Dragon
5696.text: This card cannot be destroyed by Spell/Trap effects that do not target it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has 1900 or less ATK.

5697.name: Shinato, King of a Higher Plane
5697.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Shinato's Ark". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more. If this card destroys an opponent's Defense Position monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's original ATK.

5698.name: Dark Flare Knight
5698.text: You take no Battle Damage from battles involving this card. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Mirage Knight" from your hand or Deck.

5699.name: Mirage Knight
5699.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Dark Flare Knight" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During damage calculation only, this card gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling. During the End Phase of a turn this card attacked or was attacked: Banish this card.

5700.name: Berserk Dragon
5700.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "A Deal with Dark Ruler" and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each. During each of your End Phases, this card loses 500 ATK.

5701.name: Exodia Necross
5701.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Contract with Exodia". Cannot be destroyed by battle or Spell/Trap effects. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 500 ATK. Destroy this card unless all 5 of these cards are in your GY, "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One" and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One".

5702.name: Battle Footballer
5702.text: A cyborg with high defense power. Originally it was invented for a football machine.

5703.name: Arsenal Summoner
5703.text: FLIP: Add 1 "Guardian" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Celtic Guardian", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1", "Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #2", "Guardian of the Labyrinth", or "The Reliable Guardian".

5704.name: Nin-Ken Dog
5704.text: A Ninja dog who has mastered extreme Ninjutsu. Through hard training, it learned the technique to metamorphose into a human being.

5705.name: Acrobat Monkey
5705.text: An autonomous monkey type robot which was developed with cutting-edge technology. It moves very acrobatically.

5706.name: Guardian Elma
5706.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Butterfly Dagger - Elma". When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 appropriate Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; equip that target to this card.

5707.name: Guardian Ceal
5707.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Shooting Star Bow - Ceal". You can send 1 Equip Spell Card you control that is equipped to this card to the Graveyard to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5708.name: Guardian Grarl
5708.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Gravity Axe - Grarl". If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand).

5709.name: Guardian Baou
5709.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou". When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: It gains 1000 ATK. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

5710.name: Guardian Kay'est
5710.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Rod of Silence - Kay'est". This card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

5711.name: Guardian Tryce
5711.text: Cannot be Summoned unless you control a face-up "Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce". When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon the monster from the Graveyard that was used for its Tribute Summon.

5713.name: Gyaku-Gire Panda
5713.text: Increase the ATK of this card by 500 points for each monster on your opponent's side of the field. When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of your opponent's Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5714.name: Blindly Loyal Goblin
5714.text: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, control of this card cannot switch.

5715.name: Despair from the Dark
5715.text: If this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

5716.name: Maju Garzett
5716.text: The ATK of this card becomes equal to the combined original ATK of the 2 monsters you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

5717.name: Fear from the Dark
5717.text: When this card is sent from your hand or Deck to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card.

5718.name: Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow
5718.text:
When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can activate 1 of these effects.
●Target 1 card on the field; return that target to the hand.
●Look at the top card of their Deck, then place it on the top or bottom of the Deck.

5719.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
5719.text: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

5720.name: Thousand Needles
5720.text: When this Defense Position card is attacked and if the DEF of this card is higher than the ATK of the attacking monster, destroy the attacking monster at the end of the Damage Step.

5721.name: Shinato's Ark
5721.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

5722.name: A Deal with Dark Ruler
5722.text:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
If a Level 8 or higher monster under your control was sent to the Graveyard this turn: Special Summon 1 "Berserk Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

5723.name: Contract with Exodia
5723.text: If you have all 5 of "Exodia the Forbidden One", "Right Arm of the Forbidden One", "Left Arm of the Forbidden One", "Right Leg of the Forbidden One", and "Left Leg of the Forbidden One" in your Graveyard: Special Summon 1 "Exodia Necross" from your hand.

5724.name: Butterfly Dagger - Elma
5724.text: The equipped monster gains 300 ATK. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard while equipped: You can return this card to the hand.

5725.name: Shooting Star Bow - Ceal
5725.text: The equipped monster loses 1000 ATK, but it can attack your opponent directly.

5726.name: Gravity Axe - Grarl
5726.text: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

5727.name: Wicked-Breaking Flamberge - Baou
5727.text: Send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. Negate the effects of opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with the equipped monster.

5728.name: Rod of Silence - Kay'est
5728.text: The equipped monster gains 500 DEF. Negate other Spell effects that target the equipped monster, and if you do, destroy that Spell Card.

5729.name: Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce
5729.text: Send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard; equip this card to a monster. It loses 500 ATK, but it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

5730.name: Precious Cards from Beyond
5730.text: When you Tribute Summon a monster using 2 or more Tributes: Draw 2 cards.

5731.name: Rod of the Mind's Eye
5731.text: If a monster equipped with this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, the damage becomes 1000 points.

5732.name: Fairy of the Spring
5732.text: Target 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. That Equip Spell Card cannot be activated this turn.

5733.name: Token Thanksgiving
5733.text: Destroy all tokens on the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of tokens destroyed x 800 points.

5734.name: Morale Boost
5734.text: Each time a player equips an Equip Spell Card, increase the Life Points of the controller of that Equip Spell Card by 1000 points. Each time an Equip Spell Card is removed from the field, the controller of that Equip Spell Card takes 1000 points of damage.

5735.name: Non-Spellcasting Area
5735.text: All face-up monsters, except for Effect Monsters, are unaffected by other Spell effects.

5736.name: Different Dimension Gate
5736.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster on each field; banish those targets. When this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: Return those banished monsters to the field in the same battle positions they were in.

5737.name: Staunch Defender
5737.text: You can only activate this card when your opponent declares an attack. Select 1 face-up monster on your side of the field. During this turn, your opponent can only designate the selected monster as an attack target and your opponent must attack the selected monster with all face-up monsters.

5738.name: Ojama Trio
5738.text: Special Summon 3 "Ojama Tokens" (Beast/LIGHT/Level 2/ATK 0/DEF 1000) to your opponent's field in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, and each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 300 damage.

5739.name: Arsenal Robber
5739.text: Your opponent selects 1 Equip Spell Card from his/her Deck and sends it to the Graveyard.

5740.name: Skill Drain
5740.text: Activate this card by paying 1000 LP. Negate the effects of all face-up monsters while they are face-up on the field (but their effects can still be activated).

5741.name: Really Eternal Rest
5741.text: Destroy all monsters equipped with an Equip Card(s).

5759.name: Gagagigo
5759.text: This young evildoer used to have an evil heart, but by meeting a special person, he discovered justice.

5760.name: D.D. Trainer
5760.text: A poor goblin that was sucked into a different dimension. However, he's doing his best with his new destiny.

5761.name: Ojama Green
5761.text: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

5762.name: Archfiend Soldier
5762.text: An expert at battle who belongs to a crack diabolical unit. He's famous because he always gets the job done.

5763.name: Pandemonium Watchbear
5763.text: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, "Pandemonium" on your side of the field is not destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

5764.name: Sasuke Samurai #2
5764.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can pay 800 Life Points. If you do this, until the End Phase, Spell and Trap Cards cannot be activated.

5765.name: Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong
5765.text:
When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
●Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the top of the Deck.
●Send the top card of their Deck to the GY.

5766.name: Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn
5766.text:
When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent, you can activate 1 of these effects:
●Add 1 "Dark Scorpion" card from your Deck to your hand.
●Target 1 "Dark Scorpion" card in your GY; add that target to your hand.

5767.name: Outstanding Dog Marron
5767.text: When this card is sent to your GY: Shuffle it into your Deck.

5768.name: Great Maju Garzett
5768.text: The ATK of this card becomes twice the original ATK of 1 monster that you Tributed for the Tribute Summon of this card.

5769.name: Iron Blacksmith Kotetsu
5769.text: FLIP: Add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand.

5770.name: Goblin of Greed
5770.text: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, neither player can activate an effect by discarding from his/her hand.

5771.name: Mefist the Infernal General
5771.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Make your opponent discard 1 random card.

5772.name: Vilepawn Archfiend
5772.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 500 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. When resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die and negate that effect if you roll a 3, and if you do, destroy that card. Your opponent's monsters cannot attack any "Archfiend" monsters you control, except "Vilepawn Archfiend".

5773.name: Shadowknight Archfiend
5773.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 900 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. When resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die and negate that effect if you roll a 3, and if you do, destroy that card. Any battle damage this card inflicts to your opponent is halved.

5774.name: Darkbishop Archfiend
5774.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 500 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. When resolving an opponent's card effect that targets an "Archfiend" monster you control, roll a six-sided die and negate that effect if you roll a 1, 3, or 6, and if you do, destroy that card.

5775.name: Desrook Archfiend
5775.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 500 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. When resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die and negate that effect if you roll a 3, and if you do, destroy that card. When "Terrorking Archfiend" you control is destroyed and sent to the GY (even during the Damage Step) (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY, then target that "Terrorking Archfiend" in your GY; Special Summon it.

5776.name: Infernalqueen Archfiend
5776.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 500 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. When resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die, and negate that effect if you roll a 2 or 5, and if you do, destroy that card. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Target 1 "Archfiend" monster on the field; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

5777.name: Terrorking Archfiend
5777.text: Cannot be Normal or Flip Summoned unless you control an "Archfiend" monster. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 800 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. When resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die and negate that effect if you roll a 2 or 5, and if you do, destroy that card. Negate the effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by battle with this card (including in the GY).

5778.name: Skull Archfiend of Lightning
5778.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 500 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. When resolving an opponent's card effect that targets this card, roll a six-sided die and negate that effect if you roll a 1, 3, or 6, and if you do, destroy that card.

5779.name: Metallizing Parasite - Lunatite
5779.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this monster on the field, you can equip it to a face-up monster on your side of the field as an Equip Spell Card, OR unequip the Union equipment and Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. While equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster will be unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards controlled by your opponent. (1 monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the monster that this card is equipped to is destroyed as a result of battle, destroy this card instead.)

5780.name: Tsukuyomi
5780.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up this turn: Return it to the hand.

5781.name: Legendary Flame Lord
5781.text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Incandescent Ordeal". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand. Each time you or your opponent activates 1 Spell Card, put 1 Spell Counter on this card. Remove 3 Spell Counters from this card to destroy all monsters on the field except this card.

5782.name: Dark Master - Zorc
5782.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Contract with the Dark Master". Once per turn: You can roll a six-sided die, then destroy all monsters your opponent controls if you roll 1 or 2, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls if you roll 3, 4 or 5, or destroy all monsters you control if you roll 6.

5783.name: Incandescent Ordeal
5783.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Legendary Flame Lord". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 7 or more from the field or your hand.

5784.name: Contract with the Abyss
5784.text: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any DARK Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

5785.name: Contract with the Dark Master
5785.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Dark Master - Zorc". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal 8 or more.

5786.name: Falling Down
5786.text: Activate this card by targeting an opponent's monster; equip this card to it. Take control of it. Destroy this card unless you control an "Archfiend" card. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: You take 800 damage.

5787.name: Checkmate
5787.text: Tribute 1 "Archfiend" monster, then target 1 "Terrorking Archfiend" you control; it can attack directly this turn.

5788.name: Final Countdown
5788.text: Pay 2000 Life Points. After 20 turns have passed after you activate this card (counting the turn you activate this card as the 1st turn), you win the Duel.

5789.name: Archfiend's Oath
5789.text: Once per turn: You can pay 500 LP, then declare 1 card name; excavate the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, add it to your hand. Otherwise, send it to the GY.

5790.name: Mustering of the Dark Scorpions
5790.text: If you control a face-up "Don Zaloog": You can Special Summon any number of "Dark Scorpion" monsters from your hand, but only 1 copy of each.

5791.name: Pandemonium
5791.text: Neither player has to pay LP during the Standby Phase for "Archfiend" monsters. When an "Archfiend" monster is destroyed and sent to the GY, except by battle: Its owner can add 1 "Archfiend" monster from their Deck to their hand with a lower Level than the destroyed card.

5792.name: Altar for Tribute
5792.text: Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send it to the Graveyard. Increase your Life Points by an amount equal to the original ATK of the monster.

5793.name: Frozen Soul
5793.text: You can only activate this card when your Life Points are at least 2000 lower than your opponent's. Skip your opponent's next Battle Phase.

5794.name: Battle-Scarred
5794.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 "Archfiend" monster you control. Your opponent also pays the same LP that you pay for that monster during the Standby Phase. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. If that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

5795.name: Dark Scorpion Combination
5795.text: You can only activate this card when there are "Don Zaloog", "Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover", "Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow", "Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong", and "Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn" face-up on your side of the field. During this turn, any of these 5 cards can attack your opponent's Life Points directly. In that case, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent by each of those cards becomes 400 points.

5796.name: Archfiend's Roar
5796.text: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 "Archfiend" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target, but it cannot be Tributed, also it is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn.

5797.name: Dice Re-Roll
5797.text: One time, during the rest of this turn, if either player(s) rolls a die (or dice), you can have the player(s) re-roll. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

5798.name: Spell Vanishing
5798.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and destroy it. Also, look at your opponent's hand and Deck and if you find any Spell Cards of the same name as the destroyed Spell Card, send all of them to the Graveyard.

5799.name: Sakuretsu Armor
5799.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.

5800.name: Ray of Hope
5800.text: Add 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

5803.name: Nightmare Penguin
5803.text: WATER monsters you control gain 200 ATK. If this card is flipped face-up: Target 1 card your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

5804.name: Perfect Machine King
5804.text: This card gains 500 ATK for each other Machine-Type monster on the field.

5810.name: Chiron the Mage
5810.text: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell, then target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target.

5811.name: Ojama Yellow
5811.text: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

5812.name: Ojama Black
5812.text: He's one of the Ojama Trio. It's said that he butts in by any means necessary. It's also said that when the three are together, something happens.

5813.name: Soul Tiger
5813.text: The soul of a tiger that is said to devour human souls. He is a famous soul that you wouldn't want to run into in a dark alley.

5814.name: Big Koala
5814.text: A species of huge Des Koala. He's meek, but people are afraid of him because he's very powerful.

5815.name: Des Kangaroo
5815.text: If the ATK of a monster that attacks this monster is lower than the DEF of this card, destroy the attacking monster.

5816.name: Crimson Ninja
5816.text: FLIP: Target 1 Trap Card on the field; destroy that target. (If the target is Set, reveal it, and destroy it if it is a Trap Card. Otherwise, return it to its original position.)

5817.name: Strike Ninja
5817.text: (Quick Effect): You can banish 2 DARK monsters from your GY; banish this face-up card until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Strike Ninja" once per turn.

5818.name: Gale Lizard
5818.text: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

5819.name: Spirit of the Pot of Greed
5819.text: If a player activates "Pot of Greed": Activate this effect; they can draw 1 card. This card must be in face-up Attack Position to activate and to resolve this effect.

5820.name: Chopman the Desperate Outlaw
5820.text: When this card is Flip Summoned, you can equip 1 Equip Spell Card in your Graveyard to this card.

5821.name: Sasuke Samurai #3
5821.text: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, your opponent draws cards until their hand has 7 cards.

5822.name: D.D. Scout Plane
5822.text: During the End Phase, if this card is currently banished, and was banished this turn: Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. This effect can only activate once per turn.

5823.name: Berserk Gorilla
5823.text: If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy this card. This card must attack if able.

5824.name: Freed the Brave Wanderer
5824.text: Once per turn: You can banish 2 LIGHT monsters from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster on the field with higher ATK than this face-up card; destroy that target.

5825.name: Coach Goblin
5825.text: While this card is face-up on your side of the field, you can return 1 Normal Monster Card in your hand to the bottom of your Deck during your End Phase to draw 1 card from your Deck. You can only use this effect once per turn.

5826.name: Witch Doctor of Chaos
5826.text: FLIP: Select 1 Monster Card from you or your opponent's Graveyard. Remove it from play.

5827.name: Chaos Necromancer
5827.text: The ATK of this card is the number of Monster Cards in your Graveyard x 300.

5828.name: Chaosrider Gustaph
5828.text: Once per turn: You can banish up to 2 Spells from your GY; this card gains 300 ATK for each card banished by this effect, until the end of your opponent's turn.

5829.name: Inferno
5829.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 1500 damage to your opponent.

5830.name: Fenrir
5830.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing 2 WATER monsters in your Graveyard from play. When this card destroys an opponent's monster as a result of battle, your opponent skips his/her next Draw Phase.

5831.name: Gigantes
5831.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 EARTH monster from your GY. If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Destroy all Spells and Traps on the field.

5832.name: Silpheed
5832.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard. When this card is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard, your opponent discards 1 random card from their hand.

5833.name: Chaos Sorcerer
5833.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; banish that target. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

5834.name: Gren Maju Da Eiza
5834.text: This card's ATK/DEF become the number of your banished cards x 400.

5835.name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
5835.text:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.
●Target 1 monster on the field; banish it. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.
●If this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: It can make a second attack in a row.

5836.name: Fuhma Shuriken
5836.text: Equip only to a "Ninja" monster. It gains 700 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

5837.name: Heart of the Underdog
5837.text: During your Draw Phase, when you draw a Normal Monster(s): You can reveal it; draw 1 more card.

5838.name: Wild Nature's Release
5838.text: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior monster; it gains ATK equal to its current DEF (until the End Phase), and if it does, it is destroyed during the End Phase.

5839.name: Ojama Delta Hurricane!!
5839.text: If you control "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow", and "Ojama Black": Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

5840.name: Stumbling
5840.text: Any monster that is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned or Special Summoned is changed to Defense Position.

5841.name: Chaos End
5841.text: You can only activate this card if 7 or more of your cards are currently removed from play. Destroy all Monster Cards on the field.

5842.name: Chaos Greed
5842.text: You can only activate this card if 4 or more of your cards are currently removed from play and there are no cards in your Graveyard. Draw 2 cards from your Deck.

5843.name: D.D. Designator
5843.text: Declare 1 card name. Look at your opponent's hand, and if they have the declared card in their hand, banish that 1 card. If they do not have the declared card in their hand, banish 1 random card in your hand.

5844.name: D.D. Borderline
5844.text: While there are no Spells in your GY, neither player can conduct their Battle Phase.

5845.name: Recycle
5845.text: During your Standby Phase, by paying 300 Life Points, select 1 non-Monster Card in your Graveyard and return it to the bottom of your Deck.

5846.name: Primal Seed
5846.text: If there is a "Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning" or "Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End" on the field: Target 2 of your banished cards; add both those targets to your hand.

5847.name: Thunder Crash
5847.text: Destroy all monsters you control, and if you do, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed.

5848.name: Dimension Distortion
5848.text: You can only activate this card if there are no cards in your Graveyard. Select 1 removed from play monster and Special Summon it on your side of the field.

5849.name: Reload
5849.text: Add all cards in your hand to your Deck and shuffle it. Then draw the same number of cards that you added to your Deck.

5850.name: Soul Absorption
5850.text: If a card(s) is banished: Gain 500 LP for each.

5851.name: Big Burn
5851.text: You can only activate this card when your opponent activates a card that targets a monster in the Graveyard. Remove from play all monsters in both players' Graveyards.

5852.name: Blasting the Ruins
5852.text: You can only activate this card if there are 30 or more cards in your Graveyard. Inflict 3000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5853.name: Cursed Seal of the Forbidden Spell
5853.text: When a Spell Card is activated: Discard 1 Spell; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, and if you do that, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards with that name for the rest of this Duel.

5854.name: Tower of Babel
5854.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. If the 4th Spell Counter is placed on this card: Destroy this card, and if you do, the player who activated the Spell Card at that time takes 3000 damage.

5855.name: Spatial Collapse
5855.text: You can only activate this card if both you and your opponent each have 5 or less cards on the field. The maximum number of cards that each player can have on the field is 5.

5856.name: Chain Disappearance
5856.text: When a monster(s) with 1000 or less ATK is Summoned: Banish that monster(s) with 1000 or less ATK, then your opponent banishes all cards with the same name as that card(s) from their hand and Deck.

5857.name: Zero Gravity
5857.text: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on the field.

5858.name: Dark Mirror Force
5858.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Banish all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.

5859.name: Energy Drain
5859.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 200 ATK/DEF for each card your opponent currently has in their hand, until the end of this turn.

5860.name: Chaos Emperor Dragon - Envoy of the End
5860.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn: You can pay 1000 LP; send as many cards in both players' hands and on the field as possible to the GY, then inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each card sent to the opponent's GY by this effect. You cannot activate other cards or effects during the turn you activate this card's effect.

5871.name: Giga Gagagigo
5871.text: In order to fight tremendous evil, he gained formidable power through body reconstruction, but lost his heart and his redemption.

5872.name: Mad Dog of Darkness
5872.text: He used to be a normal dog who played around in a park, but was corrupted by the powers of darkness.

5873.name: Neo Bug
5873.text: A huge bug-like monster said to come from another planet. It gathers in swarms.

5874.name: Sea Serpent Warrior of Darkness
5874.text: A warrior who defends the world of the Sea of Darkness. He prides himself on his fighting prowess both on the ground and, of course, in the water.

5875.name: Terrorking Salmon
5875.text: A feared salmon, master of the Sea of Darkness. Its roe is the best delicacy in the World of Darkness.

5876.name: Blazing Inpachi
5876.text: A wicked wooden spirit now burning in flames. Its fire attack is powerful, but it will soon be nothing but ashes.

5877.name: Burning Algae
5877.text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard, increase your opponent's Life Points by 1000 points.

5878.name: The Thing in the Crater
5878.text: When this card is destroyed and sent from the field to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Pyro-Type Monster from your hand.

5879.name: Molten Zombie
5879.text: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

5880.name: Dark Magician of Chaos
5880.text: During the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Dark Magician of Chaos" once per turn. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, after damage calculation: Banish that opponent's monster. If this face-up card would leave the field, banish it instead.

5881.name: Manticore of Darkness
5881.text: During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was sent there this turn: You can send 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon this card from your GY.

5882.name: Stealth Bird
5882.text: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

5883.name: Sacred Crane
5883.text: If this card is Special Summoned: Draw 1 card.

5884.name: Enraged Battle Ox
5884.text: If your Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

5885.name: Don Turtle
5885.text: When this card is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned, you can Special Summon any number of "Don Turtle"(s) from your hand.

5886.name: Balloon Lizard
5886.text: Put 1 counter on this card during each of your Standby Phases. When this card is destroyed, inflict damage to the controller of the card that destroyed it equal to the number of counters x 400 points.

5887.name: Dark Driceratops
5887.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

5888.name: Hyper Hammerhead
5888.text: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand.

5889.name: Black Tyranno
5889.text: If the only cards your opponent controls are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack directly.

5890.name: Anti-Aircraft Flower
5890.text: By tributing 1 Insect-Type monster on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

5891.name: Prickle Fairy
5891.text: Your opponent cannot attack Insect monsters. If this card battled a monster, at the end of the Damage Step: Change that monster to Defense Position.

5892.name: Insect Princess
5892.text: All Insect monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position. If this card destroys an Insect monster by battle: This card gains 500 ATK.

5893.name: Amphibious Bugroth MK-3
5893.text: As long as "Umi" remains face-up on the field, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

5894.name: Torpedo Fish
5894.text: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

5895.name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
5895.text: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; destroy all other cards on the field.

5896.name: Orca Mega-Fortress of Darkness
5896.text: By tributing 1 "Torpedo Fish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 monster on the field. By Tributing 1 "Cannonball Spear Shellfish" on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

5897.name: Cannonball Spear Shellfish
5897.text: While "Umi" is face-up on the field, this card is unaffected by any Spell Cards.

5898.name: Mataza the Zapper
5898.text: This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. Control of this face-up card on the field cannot switch.

5899.name: Guardian Angel Joan
5899.text: When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Gain LP equal to that monster's original ATK in the GY.

5900.name: Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
5900.text: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster or 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

5901.name: Getsu Fuhma
5901.text: If this card battles a Fiend or Zombie-Type monster, destroy that monster at the end of the Damage Step.

5902.name: Ryu Kokki
5902.text: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled a Warrior or Spellcaster monster: Destroy that monster.

5903.name: Gryphon's Feather Duster
5903.text: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on your side of the field. Increase your Life Points by the number of destroyed cards x 500 points.

5904.name: Stray Lambs
5904.text: Special Summon 2 "Lamb Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Set).

5905.name: Smashing Ground
5905.text: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the highest DEF (your choice, if tied).

5906.name: Dimension Fusion
5906.text: Pay 2000 LP; each player Special Summons as many of their banished monsters as possible.

5907.name: Dedication through Light and Darkness
5907.text: Tribute 1 "Dark Magician"; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician of Chaos" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

5908.name: Salvage
5908.text: Target 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your GY; add those targets to your hand.

5909.name: Ultra Evolution Pill
5909.text: Tribute 1 Reptile monster; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand.

5910.name: Earth Chant
5910.text: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any EARTH Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

5911.name: Jade Insect Whistle
5911.text: Your opponent selects 1 Insect-Type Monster from their Deck. After shuffling the Deck, place the card on top of the Deck.

5912.name: Destruction Ring
5912.text: Destroy 1 face-up monster on your side of the field to inflict 1000 points of damage to both players' Life Points.

5913.name: Fiend's Hand Mirror
5913.text: Switch the opponent's Spell Card effect that targets 1 Spell or Trap Card to another correct target.

5914.name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
5914.text: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

5915.name: A Hero Emerges
5915.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent chooses 1 random card from your hand, then if it is a monster that can be Special Summoned, Special Summon it. Otherwise, send it to the GY.

5916.name: Self-Destruct Button
5916.text: You can only activate this card while your Life Points are lower than your opponent's Life Points and the difference is 7000 points or more. Both players' Life Points become 0.

5917.name: Curse of Darkness
5917.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, immediately after it resolves, the player that activated it takes 1000 damage.

5918.name: Begone, Knave!
5918.text: If a monster inflicts battle damage to a player: Return that monster to the hand.

5919.name: DNA Transplant
5919.text: Activate by declaring 1 monster Attribute. All face-up monsters become that Attribute.

5920.name: Robbin' Zombie
5920.text: If your monster inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY.

5921.name: Trap Jammer
5921.text: When your opponent activates a Trap Card during the Battle Phase: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

5922.name: Invader of Darkness
5922.text: Your opponent cannot activate Quick-Play Spell Cards.

5928.name: Bitelon
5928.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

5934.name: Gora Turtle of Illusion
5934.text: Negate the effect of Spell and Trap Cards controlled by your opponent that target this face-up card on the field.

5946.name: Gogiga Gagagigo
5946.text: His soul long-since collapsed, his body recklessly continues onward, driven by a lust for more power. He no longer resembles his former self....

5947.name: Warrior of Zera
5947.text: A wandering warrior who seeks the sanctuary where he can gain the power of the Archlords. To escape the temptation of evil fiends, he fights solo day by day.

5948.name: Sealmaster Meisei
5948.text: One of the few people who has a good command of Talismans. His history is a mystery.

5949.name: Mystical Shine Ball
5949.text: A soul of light covered by mystical shine. When you see its beautiful shape, your dream will come true.

5950.name: Metal Armored Bug
5950.text: A gigantic insect-like creature covered by thick armor. Everything in his path is destroyed.

5951.name: The Agent of Judgment - Saturn
5951.text: While your LP are higher than your opponent's: You can Tribute this card; inflict damage to your opponent equal to the difference. You must control "The Sanctuary in the Sky" to activate and to resolve this effect. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect.

5952.name: The Agent of Wisdom - Mercury
5952.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if you controlled this face-up card in your Monster Zone and had no cards in your hand at the end of the opponent's last turn: Draw 1 card.

5953.name: The Agent of Creation - Venus
5953.text: You can pay 500 LP; Special Summon 1 "Mystical Shine Ball" from your hand or Deck.

5954.name: The Agent of Force - Mars
5954.text: Unaffected by Spell Cards or effects. While you control "The Sanctuary in the Sky" and your LP are higher than your opponent's, this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the difference.

5955.name: The Unhappy Girl
5955.text: While this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field, this card is not destroyed as a result of battle. (Damage calculation is applied normally.) A monster that battled with this card cannot change its battle position, except with a card effect, or attack while this card is in face-up Attack Position on the field.

5956.name: Soul-Absorbing Bone Tower
5956.text: If you control another Zombie-Type monster, your opponent cannot target this card for attacks. Each time a Zombie-Type monster(s) is Special Summoned: Send the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to the Graveyard.

5957.name: The Kick Man
5957.text: When this card is Special Summoned, you can equip 1 appropriate Equip Spell Card from your Graveyard to this card.

5958.name: Vampire Lady
5958.text: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); your opponent sends 1 card of that type from their Deck to the GY.

5959.name: Rocket Jumper
5959.text: If the only cards on your opponent's side of the field are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

5960.name: Avatar of The Pot
5960.text: By sending 1 "Pot of Greed" from your hand to the Graveyard, draw 3 cards from your Deck.

5961.name: Legendary Jujitsu Master
5961.text: If this Defense Position card battled a monster, at the end of the Damage Step: Place that monster on the top of the Deck.

5962.name: KA-2 Des Scissors
5962.text: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the destroyed monster x 500 points.

5963.name: Needle Burrower
5963.text: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the destroyed monster x 500 points.

5964.name: Blowback Dragon
5964.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; toss a coin 3 times and destroy that target if at least 2 of the results are heads.

5965.name: Zaborg the Thunder Monarch
5965.text: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

5966.name: Atomic Firefly
5966.text: When this face-up card on the field attacks or is attacked and it is destroyed as a result of battle, the player who destroyed it takes 1000 points of damage.

5967.name: Mermaid Knight
5967.text: As long as "Umi" remains face-up on the field, this card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

5968.name: Piranha Army
5968.text: The Battle Damage this card inflicts by attacking your opponent's Life Points directly is doubled.

5969.name: Two Thousand Needles
5969.text: When this Defense Position card is attacked and the ATK of the attacking monster is lower than the DEF of this card, destroy the attacking monster at the end of the Damage Step.

5970.name: Disc Fighter
5970.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster with DEF 2000 or more, destroy the monster with this card's effect without applying Damage Calculation.

5971.name: Arcane Archer of the Forest
5971.text: While there is a Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, this card cannot be attacked. By tributing 1 Plant-Type monster on your side of the field, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

5972.name: Lady Ninja Yae
5972.text: By discarding 1 WIND monster from your hand to the Graveyard, return all Spell and Trap Cards on your opponent's side of the field to the owner's hand.

5973.name: Goblin King
5973.text: While you control another Fiend monster, monsters cannot attack this card. This card's ATK/DEF become the number of other Fiend monsters on the field x 1000.

5974.name: Solar Flare Dragon
5974.text: While you control another Pyro-Type monster, this card cannot be attacked. During each of your End Phases: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

5975.name: White Magician Pikeru
5975.text: During your Standby Phase, increase your Life Points by 400 points for each monster on your side of the field.

5976.name: Archlord Zerato
5976.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on your side of the field, by discarding 1 LIGHT Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

5977.name: Opti-Camouflage Armor
5977.text: You can only equip this card to a Level 1 monster. A monster equipped with this card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly.

5978.name: Mystik Wok
5978.text: Tribute 1 monster. Select either its ATK or DEF and gain that many Life Points.

5979.name: Burst Stream of Destruction
5979.text: If you control "Blue-Eyes White Dragon": Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" you control cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

5980.name: Monster Gate
5980.text: Tribute 1 monster; excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set. Special Summon it, also send the other excavated cards to the GY.

5981.name: Weapon Change
5981.text: Once during each of your Standby Phases: You can pay 700 Life Points, then target 1 Warrior or Machine-Type monster you control; switch the current ATK and DEF of that target until the end of your opponent's next turn.

5982.name: The Sanctuary in the Sky
5982.text: Battle damage to the controller of a Fairy monster from a battle involving that monster becomes 0.

5983.name: Earthquake
5983.text: Change all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position.

5984.name: Talisman of Trap Sealing
5984.text: Activate this card only if you control "Sealmaster Meisei". Trap Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. Negate all Trap effects on the field. If you do not control "Sealmaster Meisei", destroy this card.

5985.name: Goblin Thief
5985.text: Inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points and increase your Life Points by 500 points.

5986.name: Backfire
5986.text: If a face-up FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed and sent to the GY: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

5987.name: Micro Ray
5987.text: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target's DEF becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

5988.name: Light of Judgment
5988.text:
If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field: Discard 1 LIGHT monster to the GY; apply 1 of the following effects.
●Look at your opponent's hand and discard 1 card from their hand.
●Send 1 card your opponent controls to the GY.

5989.name: Talisman of Spell Sealing
5989.text: Activate this card only if you control "Sealmaster Meisei". Spell Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. Negate all Spell effects on the field. If you do not control "Sealmaster Meisei", destroy this card.

5990.name: Wall of Revealing Light
5990.text: Activate by paying any multiple of 1000 Life Points. Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack if their ATK is less than or equal to the amount you paid.

5991.name: Solar Ray
5991.text: Inflict 600 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points for each face-up LIGHT monster on your side of the field.

5992.name: Ninjitsu Art of Transformation
5992.text: Activate this card by Tributing 1 face-up "Ninja" monster; Special Summon 1 Beast, Winged Beast, or Insect monster from your hand or Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the Level the Tributed monster had on the field +3. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster.

5993.name: Beckoning Light
5993.text: Discard your entire hand, then for each card you discarded to the GY by this effect, add 1 LIGHT monster from your GY to your hand.

5994.name: Draining Shield
5994.text: If an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate that attack, and if you do, gain LP equal to that target's ATK.

5995.name: Armor Break
5995.text: Negate the activation of an Equip Spell Card and destroy it.

5996.name: Mazera DeVille
5996.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 face-up "Warrior of Zera" on your side of the field while "Pandemonium" is on the field. If "Pandemonium" is on your side of the field when you Special Summon this card, your opponent discards 3 random cards from their hand. If "Pandemonium" is not on your side of the field, this effect is not applied.

6018.name: Mokey Mokey
6018.text: An outcast angel. Nobody knows what he is thinking at all. Sometimes he gets mad and that is dreadful.

6019.name: Gigobyte
6019.text: He has a tranquil soul, but carries a destiny that one day his heart shall be tainted by evil....

6020.name: Kozaky
6020.text: A workaholic fiend who devotes everything to his research into the languages of Dark World. His mind has collapsed because of working too hard.

6021.name: Fiend Scorpion
6021.text: A huge scorpion inhabited by the soul of a fiend. Usually it holds back, but has untapped potential.

6022.name: Pharaoh's Servant
6022.text: An apparition of those said to formerly serve the Pharaoh. It has tremendous loyalty that does not waver.

6023.name: Pharaonic Protector
6023.text: The mummy of a soldier that has been guarding the royal family for thousands of years. Even now, its spirit does not allow anybody to trespass.

6024.name: Spirit of the Pharaoh
6024.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "The First Sarcophagus". When this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 4 Level 2 or lower Zombie Normal Monsters in your GY; Special Summon those targets.

6025.name: Theban Nightmare
6025.text: Gains 1500 ATK while you have no cards in your hand nor in your Spell & Trap Zones.

6026.name: Aswan Apparition
6026.text: If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, you can return 1 Trap Card from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

6027.name: Protector of the Sanctuary
6027.text: Your opponent cannot draw cards except during Draw Phases.

6028.name: Nubian Guard
6028.text: If this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent's Life Points, you can return 1 Continuous Spell Card from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

6029.name: Legacy Hunter
6029.text: When this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster and destroys it and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, your opponent returns 1 random card from their hand to their Deck. Their Deck is then shuffled.

6030.name: Desertapir
6030.text: FLIP: Flip 1 face-up monster on the field into face-down Defense Position. You cannot select "Desertapir".

6031.name: Sand Gambler
6031.text: Toss a coin 3 times. If all 3 results are Heads, destroy all monsters on your opponent's side of the field. If all 3 results are Tails, destroy all monsters on your side of the field. You can only activate this effect once per turn, during your Main Phase.

6032.name: 3-Hump Lacooda
6032.text: If there are 3 face-up "3-Hump Lacooda" cards on your side of the field, Tribute 2 of them to draw 3 cards.

6033.name: Ghost Knight of Jackal
6033.text: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can target that destroyed monster in your opponent's GY; Special Summon that target to your field in Defense Position.

6034.name: Absorbing Kid from the Sky
6034.text: When this card destroys a monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, increase your Life Points by the Level of the destroyed monster x 300 points.

6035.name: Elephant Statue of Blessing
6035.text: When this card is sent from your hand to your Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: You gain 2000 Life Points.

6036.name: Elephant Statue of Disaster
6036.text: If this card is sent from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Inflict 2000 damage to your opponent.

6037.name: Spirit Caller
6037.text: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from your Graveyard to your side of the field.

6038.name: Emissary of the Afterlife
6038.text: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Each player adds 1 Level 3 or lower Normal Monster from their Deck to their hand.

6039.name: Grave Protector
6039.text: Any monster destroyed by battle is shuffled into the Deck instead of going to the GY.

6040.name: Double Coston
6040.text: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a DARK monster.

6041.name: Regenerating Mummy
6041.text: When this card is sent from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Return this card to the hand.

6042.name: Night Assailant
6042.text:
FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.
If this card is sent from the hand to the GY: Target 1 Flip monster in your GY, except "Night Assailant"; add that target to your hand.

6043.name: Man-Thro' Tro'
6043.text: By tributing 1 Normal Monster (except a Token) on your side of the field, inflict 800 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points.

6044.name: King of the Swamp
6044.text: This card in your hand, field, or GY can be used as a substitute for any 1 Fusion Material whose name is mentioned on the Fusion Monster Card, but the other materials must be correct. You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

6045.name: Emissary of the Oasis
6045.text: While a face-up Level 3 or lower Normal Monster is on your side of the field, your opponent cannot select this card as an attack target. While this card is face-up on your side of the field, any Battle Damage to the controller of this card from battle involving a Level 3 or lower Normal Monster becomes 0.

6046.name: Special Hurricane
6046.text: Discard 1 card from your hand. Destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field.

6047.name: Order to Charge
6047.text: Target 1 non-Token Normal Monster you control; Tribute that Normal Monster, and if you do, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.

6048.name: Sword of the Soul-Eater
6048.text: You can only equip this card to a Level 3 or lower Normal Monster on your side of the field. When you activate this card, Tribute all Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field, except the equipped monster. Increase the ATK of the equipped monster by 1000 points for each Normal Monster that you Tributed.

6049.name: Dust Barrier
6049.text: Face-up Normal Monsters on the field are unaffected by your opponent's Spell Cards. This card is destroyed during your second Standby Phase after activation.

6050.name: Soul Reversal
6050.text: Return 1 Flip Effect Monster from your Graveyard to the top of your Deck.

6051.name: Spell Economics
6051.text: You do not pay Life Points to activate Spell Cards.

6052.name: Blessings of the Nile
6052.text: Each time card(s) are discarded from your hand to the Graveyard by the effect of a card controlled by your opponent, increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

6053.text: When there are 3 face-up "7" cards on your side of the field, draw 3 cards from your Deck. Then destroy all "7" cards. When this card is sent directly from the field to your Graveyard, increase your Life Points by 700 points.

6054.name: Level Limit - Area B
6054.text: Change all face-up Level 4 or higher monsters to Defense Position.

6055.name: Enchanting Fitting Room
6055.text: Pay 800 LP; excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck and Special Summon all excavated Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters, also, after that, shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

6056.name: The Law of the Normal
6056.text: You can only activate this card while there are 5 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters on your side of the field. Both players discard all cards in their hands, and destroy all cards on the field except Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters.

6057.name: Dark Magic Attack
6057.text: If you control "Dark Magician": Destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.

6058.name: Delta Attacker
6058.text: You can only activate this card while there are 3 Normal Monsters of the same name (except Tokens) on your side of the field. The 3 Normal Monsters of the same name can attack your opponent's Life Points directly during the turn this card is activated.

6059.name: Thousand Energy
6059.text: Increase the original ATK and DEF of all face-up Level 2 Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field by 1000 points until the End Phase. Destroy all Level 2 Normal Monsters on your side of the field during the End Phase.

6060.name: Triangle Power
6060.text: Increase the original ATK and DEF of all face-up Level 1 Normal Monsters (except Tokens) on your side of the field by 2000 points until the End Phase. Destroy all Level 1 Normal Monsters on your side of the field during the End Phase.

6061.name: The Third Sarcophagus
6061.text: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus".

6062.name: The Second Sarcophagus
6062.text: This card can only be placed on the field by the effect of "The First Sarcophagus".

6063.name: The First Sarcophagus
6063.text: Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Place 1 "The Second Sarcophagus" or (after you've done that) "The Third Sarcophagus" from your hand or Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone face-up. Then, if you control "The First Sarcophagus", "The Second Sarcophagus", and "The Third Sarcophagus", send all of them to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Spirit of the Pharaoh" from your hand or Deck. If any of these cards, including this card, leaves your field, send all of them you control to the GY, including this card.

6064.name: Dora of Fate
6064.text: You can only activate this card during your opponent's turn. Select 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field. When you Normal Summon a monster that is 1 Level lower than the selected monster during your next turn, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the Level of the selected monster x 500 points.

6065.name: Judgment of the Desert
6065.text: The Battle Positions of face-up monsters that are flipped face-up after activation of this card cannot be changed, except with a card effect.

6066.name: Human-Wave Tactics
6066.text: Once per turn, during the End Phase, if your Level 2 or lower Normal Monster(s) was destroyed by battle this turn: Special Summon Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters from your Deck, equal to the number of your Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters destroyed by battle this turn.

6067.name: Curse of Anubis
6067.text: Change all Effect Monsters on the field to Defense Position. For the rest of this turn, the original DEF of those monsters becomes 0, also their battle positions cannot be changed.

6068.name: Desert Sunlight
6068.text: All monsters on your side of the field are changed to face-up Defense Position.

6069.name: Des Counterblow
6069.text: Destroy any monster that inflicts Battle Damage to a player's Life Points by attacking directly.

6070.name: Labyrinth of Nightmare
6070.text: Once per turn, during each player's End Phase: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters the turn player controls.

6071.name: Soul Resurrection
6071.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Defense Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

6072.name: Order to Smash
6072.text: Target 1 Level 2 or lower non-Token Normal Monster you control; Tribute that Normal Monster, and if you do, destroy up to 2 Spells/Traps your opponent controls.

6073.name: The End of Anubis
6073.text: All cards and effects that target a card(s) in the GY or that activate in the GY are negated.

6076.name: Gandora the Dragon of Destruction
6076.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. You can pay half your LP; destroy as many cards on the field as possible (other than this card), and if you do, banish them. This card gains 300 ATK for each card destroyed this way. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal or Flip Summoned this turn: Send it to the Graveyard.

6093.name: Charcoal Inpachi
6093.text: A wicked wooden spirit that has burned out. The barbecue grilled with this charcoal is so awesome that everybody thinks it's priceless.

6094.name: Neo Aqua Madoor
6094.text: The true nature of this wizard, who rules all water. It defends itself with a vast, impenetrable wall of ice.

6095.name: Skull Dog Marron
6095.text: A lost dog that wandered off 1000 years ago. He's still waiting for his master to come for him.

6096.name: Goblin Calligrapher
6096.text: A Goblin who devotes himself to mastering perfect calligraphy of the word "False". He gives his all to each stroke.

6097.name: Ultimate Insect LV1
6097.text: While this card is on the field, it is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV3" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

6098.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4
6098.text: Control of this face-up card cannot switch. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.

6099.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6
6099.text: This card is unaffected by Spell effects. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" from your hand or Deck.

6100.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8
6100.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6", and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when a Spell Card is activated: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. You must control this face-up card to activate and to resolve this effect.

6101.name: Dark Mimic LV1
6101.text:
FLIP: Draw 1 card.
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Mimic LV3" from your hand or Deck.

6102.name: Dark Mimic LV3
6102.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Draw 1 card, but if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Mimic LV1", draw 2 cards instead.

6103.name: Mystic Swordsman LV2
6103.text: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV4" from your hand or Deck.

6104.name: Mystic Swordsman LV4
6104.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned (but can be Normal Set). At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV6" from your hand or Deck.

6105.name: Armed Dragon LV3
6105.text: During your Standby Phase: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Armed Dragon LV5" from your hand or Deck.

6106.name: Armed Dragon LV5
6106.text: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to the sent monster's ATK; destroy that target. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Armed Dragon LV7" from your hand or Deck.

6107.name: Armed Dragon LV7
6107.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Armed Dragon LV5". You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls with ATK less than or equal to that sent monster's ATK.

6108.name: Horus' Servant
6108.text: Your opponent cannot target face-up "Horus the Black Flame Dragon" monsters with Spells, Traps, or card effects.

6109.name: Black Dragon's Chick
6109.text: You can send this face-up card you control to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" from your hand.

6110.name: Malice Doll of Demise
6110.text: During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the Graveyard by the effect of a Continuous Spell Card: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

6111.name: Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke
6111.text: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-up Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

6112.name: Rafflesia Seduction
6112.text: FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of this turn.

6113.name: Ultimate Baseball Kid
6113.text: This card gains 1000 ATK for each face-up FIRE monster on the field, except this card. You can send 1 other face-up FIRE monster you control to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

6114.name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
6114.text: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; destroy those targets.

6115.name: Element Dragon
6115.text:
This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:
●FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK.
●WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

6116.name: Element Soldier
6116.text:
This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:
●WATER: Control of this card cannot switch.
●EARTH: Negate the effect of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed by battle.

6117.name: Howling Insect
6117.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Insect monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

6118.name: Masked Dragon
6118.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

6119.name: Mind on Air
6119.text: Your opponent must play with their hand revealed.

6120.name: Unshaven Angler
6120.text: When Tribute Summoning a WATER monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

6121.name: The Trojan Horse
6121.text: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an EARTH monster.

6122.name: Nobleman-Eater Bug
6122.text: FLIP: Destroy 2 monsters on the field.

6123.name: Enraged Muka Muka
6123.text: Gains 400 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand.

6124.name: Hade-Hane
6124.text: FLIP: You can return up to 3 monsters on the field to the owner's hand.

6125.name: Penumbral Soldier Lady
6125.text: If this card battles a LIGHT monster, this card gains 1000 ATK during the Damage Step only.

6126.name: Ojama King
6126.text: Choose up to 3 of your opponent's unused Monster Zones. Those zones cannot be used.

6129.name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
6129.text: Target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY; add them to your hand.

6130.name: Hammer Shot
6130.text: Destroy the 1 Attack Position monster on the field with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied).

6131.name: Mind Wipe
6131.text: Activate only if your opponent has 3 or less cards in their hand. Your opponent adds their hand to the Deck and shuffles it, then draws the same number of cards they added to the Deck.

6132.name: Abyssal Designator
6132.text: Pay 1000 Life Points. Declare a Type and an Attribute. Your opponent must send 1 monster with both the declared Type and Attribute from their hand or Deck to the Graveyard.

6133.name: Level Up!
6133.text: Send 1 face-up "LV" monster you control to the GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck that is listed in the sent monster's text, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

6134.name: Inferno Fire Blast
6134.text: Target 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" in your Monster Zone; inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of that "Red-Eyes Black Dragon". "Red-Eyes Black Dragon" cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

6135.name: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
6135.text: Add 2 "LV" monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

6136.name: Two-Man Cell Battle
6136.text: During each player's End Phase, the turn player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 Normal Monster from their hand.

6137.name: Big Wave Small Wave
6137.text: Destroy as many WATER monsters you control as possible, then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand, up to the number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

6138.name: Fusion Weapon
6138.text: Equip only to a Level 6 or lower Fusion Monster. It gains 1500 ATK/DEF.

6139.name: Ritual Weapon
6139.text: Equip only to a Level 6 or lower Ritual Monster. It gains 1500 ATK/DEF.

6140.name: Taunt
6140.text: Activate only during your opponent's Main Phase 1; select 1 monster on your side of the field. While the selected card remains on the field, if your opponent attacks with a monster(s) this turn, they must select the selected monster as the attack target.

6141.name: Absolute End
6141.text: Activate only during your opponent's turn. This turn, the attacks from your opponent's monsters become direct attacks.

6142.name: Spirit Barrier
6142.text: While you control a monster, you take no battle damage.

6143.name: Ninjitsu Art of Decoy
6143.text: Target 1 face-up "Ninja" monster you control; it cannot be destroyed by battle.

6144.name: Enervating Mist
6144.text: Your opponent's hand size limit becomes 5.

6145.name: Heavy Slump
6145.text: If your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand: They shuffle their entire hand into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

6146.name: Greed
6146.text: Each time a player draws cards because of a card effect, they take 500 damage during the End Phase for each card drawn by the card effect.

6147.name: Mind Crush
6147.text: Declare 1 card name; if that card is in your opponent's hand, they must discard all copies of it, otherwise you discard 1 random card.

6148.name: Cemetary Bomb
6148.text: Inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their Graveyard.

6149.name: Hallowed Life Barrier
6149.text: Discard 1 card; you take no damage from your opponent's cards this turn, also your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

6159.name: Shattered Axe
6159.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster on the field. During each of your Standby Phases: It loses 500 ATK. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

6162.name: Silent Swordsman LV3
6162.text: Negate your opponent's Spell effects that target this card. During your Standby Phase: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV5" from your hand or Deck. You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Summoned or flipped face-up.

6164.name: Silent Swordsman LV5
6164.text: Unaffected by your opponent's Spell effects. During your next Standby Phase after this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Silent Swordsman LV7" from your hand or Deck.

6172.name: Woodborg Inpachi
6172.text: The new form of the enigmatic Inpachi, remodeled by cutting-edge Dark World technology. Maneuverability has been sacrificed for strong armor, which is considered more important.

6173.name: Mighty Guard
6173.text: A machine soldier that was developed as a guard. It is made of rust-proof metal.

6174.name: Bokoichi the Freightening Car
6174.text: A freight car that is exclusively for Dekoichi. It can transport anything, but most cargo arrives broken.

6175.name: Harpie Girl
6175.text: A Harpie chick who aspires to flit about beautifully and gorgeously, but attack sharply.

6176.name: The Creator
6176.text: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your Graveyard; send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon that target.

6177.name: The Creator Incarnate
6177.text: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "The Creator" from your hand.

6178.name: Ultimate Insect LV3
6178.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV1", while it remains on the field all of your opponent's monsters lose 300 ATK. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV5" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

6179.name: Mystic Swordsman LV6
6179.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned (but can be Normal Set). At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster, and if you do, you can place it on top of your opponent's Deck instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

6181.name: Heavy Mech Support Platform
6181.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 500 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

6182.name: Element Magician
6182.text:
