This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:
●WATER: Control of this card cannot switch.
●WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

6183.name: Element Saurus
6183.text:
Gains the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field.
●FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK.
●EARTH: Negate the effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

6184.name: Roc from the Valley of Haze
6184.text: When this card is sent directly from your hand to the Graveyard, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it.

6185.name: Sasuke Samurai #4
6185.text: If this card battles a monster, toss a coin and call heads or tails before damage calculation. If you call it right, destroy the opponent's monster with this effect.

6186.name: Harpie Lady 1
6186.text:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
All WIND monsters on the field gain 300 ATK.

6187.name: Harpie Lady 2
6187.text:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
Negate the effects of Flip monsters this card destroys by battle.

6188.name: Harpie Lady 3
6188.text:
(This card's name is always treated as "Harpie Lady".)
An opponent's monster that battles this card cannot declare an attack during your opponent's next 2 turns.

6189.name: Raging Flame Sprite
6189.text: This card can attack directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: It gains 1000 ATK.

6190.name: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch
6190.text: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand, then, if it was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 100.

6191.name: Eagle Eye
6191.text: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

6192.name: Tactical Espionage Expert
6192.text: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

6193.name: Invasion of Flames
6193.text: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

6194.name: Creeping Doom Manta
6194.text: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

6195.name: Pitch-Black Warwolf
6195.text: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

6196.name: Mirage Dragon
6196.text: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

6197.name: Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective
6197.text: Once per turn: You can Tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters; this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. During the End Phase: Destroy this card.

6198.name: Fox Fire
6198.text: During the End Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard this turn and was face-up at the start of the Damage Step: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. This face-up card cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

6199.name: B.E.S. Big Core (Updated from: Big Core)
6199.text: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 3 counters on it. Cannot be destroyed by battle. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card battled: Remove 1 counter from this card. If you cannot, destroy it.

6200.name: Fusilier Dragon, the Dual-Mode Beast
6200.text: You can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing, but its original ATK and DEF become halved.

6201.name: Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive
6201.text: FLIP: Draw 1 card, then draw 1 additional card for each face-up "Bokoichi the Freightening Car" you control.

6202.name: A-Team: Trap Disposal Unit
6202.text: This effect can be used during either player's turn. When your opponent activates a Trap Card, Tribute this face-up card to negate the activation of the Trap Card and destroy it.

6203.name: Homunculus the Alchemic Being
6203.text: Once per turn: You can change the Attribute of this card.

6204.name: Dark Blade the Dragon Knight
6204.text: Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can select up to 3 Monster Cards from your opponent's Graveyard and remove them from play.

6205.name: Mokey Mokey King
6205.text: When this face-up card leaves the field: You can Special Summon as many "Mokey Mokey" as possible from your GY.

6206.name: Serial Spell
6206.text: Activate only when you activate one of your Normal Spell Cards. Discard all the cards in your hand to the Graveyard. The effect of this card becomes the same as the Normal Spell Card.

6207.name: Harpies' Hunting Ground
6207.text: All Winged Beast monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. If any "Harpie Lady" or "Harpie Lady Sisters" is Normal or Special Summoned: The player who conducted the Summon targets 1 Spell/Trap on the field; that player destroys that target.

6208.name: Triangle Ecstasy Spark
6208.text: Until the end of this turn, the ATK of all "Harpie Lady Sisters" currently on the field becomes 2700, your opponent cannot activate any Trap Cards, also negate all your opponent's Trap effects on the field.

6209.name: Necklace of Command
6209.text:
When a monster you control that's equipped with this card is destroyed by battle, and this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can either:
●Draw 1 card. OR
●Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

6210.name: Flint
6210.text: The equipped monster loses 300 ATK and cannot change its battle position or declare an attack. If this card is destroyed because the equipped monster is destroyed: Target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that monster.

6211.name: Mokey Mokey Smackdown
6211.text: If a face-up Fairy monster you control is destroyed while you control "Mokey Mokey", until the end of this turn the ATK of each "Mokey Mokey" you control will become 3000.

6212.name: Back to Square One
6212.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; place that target on the top of the Deck.

6213.name: Monster Reincarnation
6213.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

6214.name: Ballista of Rampart Smashing
6214.text: If the equipped monster attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, it gains 1500 ATK during damage calculation only.

6215.name: Lighten the Load
6215.text: Once per turn, you can add 1 Level 7 or higher monster from your hand to your Deck and shuffle it, then draw 1 card.

6216.name: Malice Dispersion
6216.text: Discard 1 card; destroy all face-up Continuous Traps on the field.

6217.name: Divine Wrath
6217.text: When a monster effect is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.

6218.name: Xing Zhen Hu
6218.text: Activate by selecting 2 Set Spell or Trap Cards on the field. The selected Spell or Trap Cards cannot be activated.

6219.name: Rare Metalmorph
6219.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 Machine monster on the field; while this card is face-up on the field, that Machine monster gains 500 ATK, also negate the first Spell effect that targets that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

6220.name: Fruits of Kozaky's Studies
6220.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your Deck and return those cards to the top of the Deck in any order.

6221.name: Mind Haxorz
6221.text: Pay 500 Life Points. Look at your opponent's hand and all Set cards on their side of the field.

6222.name: Fuh-Rin-Ka-Zan
6222.text:
When there are face-up WIND, WATER, FIRE and EARTH monster(s) on the field: Apply 1 of these effects.
●Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
●Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.
●Discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.
●Draw 2 cards.

6223.name: Chain Burst
6223.text: Each time a player activates a Trap Card, they take 1000 damage immediately after it resolves.

6224.name: Pikeru's Circle of Enchantment
6224.text: Damage to you from card effects becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

6225.name: Spell Purification
6225.text: Discard 1 card; destroy all face-up Continuous Spells on the field.

6226.name: Astral Barrier
6226.text: If your opponent's monster attacks a monster you control: You can make the attack a direct attack instead.

6227.name: Covering Fire
6227.text: During the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster attacks your monster: Target 1 other face-up monster you control; your attacked monster gains ATK equal to that target's ATK, during the Damage Step only.

6232.name: Space Mambo
6232.text: A Space Mambo floating in the vast universe. This living relic was found in the ruins of a super civilization on Alphard 4.

6233.name: Divine Dragon Ragnarok
6233.text: A legendary dragon sent by the gods as their instrument. Legends say that if provoked, the whole world will sink beneath the sea.

6234.name: Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter
6234.text: A fiery mouse, travelling the world to become the strongest fighter in the world of mice. Be careful not to touch him, or you will get burned.

6235.name: Insect Knight
6235.text: Of all Insect fighters, he is the paragon of the Indestructible Insect Invaders, which only the elite of the elite can join. We can no longer ignore their unmatched battle prowess.

6236.name: Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
6236.text: Once per turn, during your next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: Special Summon this card from the GY. If you do: Destroy all Spells and Traps on the field.

6237.name: Hand of Nephthys
6237.text: You can Tribute this card and 1 other monster; Special Summon 1 "Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys" from your hand or Deck.

6238.name: Ultimate Insect LV5
6238.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV3", while it remains on the field all of your opponent's monsters lose 500 ATK. During your Standby Phase, by sending this face-up card to the Graveyard, Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV7" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)

6239.name: Granmarg the Rock Monarch
6239.text: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target.

6240.name: Element Valkyrie
6240.text:
(This card is not treated as a "Valkyrie" card.)
This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:
●FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK.
●WATER: Control of this card cannot switch.

6241.name: Element Doom

This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:
●EARTH: Negate the effect of an Effect Monster that this card destroyed by battle.
●WIND: If this card destroyed your opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.

6242.name: Maji-Gire Panda
6242.text: Each time a Beast-Type monster(s) on the field is destroyed, this card gains 500 ATK.

6243.name: Catnipped Kitty
6243.text: This card cannot be attacked if there is another Beast-Type monster on your side of the field. Once per turn, you can make the DEF of 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field 0 until the end of this turn.

6244.name: Behemoth the King of All Animals
6244.text: You can Normal Summon/Set this card with 1 Tribute, but its original ATK becomes 2000. When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target Beast monsters in your GY equal to the number of monsters Tributed; return them to the hand.

6245.name: Big-Tusked Mammoth
6245.text: Monsters your opponent controls cannot attack the turn they are Summoned.

6246.name: Kangaroo Champ
6246.text: A monster that battles with this card is changed to Defense Position after damage calculation.

6247.name: Hyena
6247.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon any number of "Hyenas" from your Deck.

6248.name: Blade Rabbit
6248.text: When this card is changed from Attack Position to face-up Defense Position, destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

6249.name: Mecha-Dog Marron
6249.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 1000 damage to both players. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard except by battle, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

6250.name: Blast Magician
6250.text: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell Card resolves. You can remove any number of Spell Counters from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field with ATK less than or equal to the number of counters you removed x 700; destroy that target.

6251.name: Gearfried the Swordmaster
6251.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Release Restraint". Each time an Equip Card(s) is equipped to this card: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

6252.name: Armed Samurai - Ben Kei
6252.text: For each Equip Card equipped to this card, it gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase.

6253.name: Shadowslayer
6253.text: If all monsters your opponent controls are in Defense Position, this card can attack your opponent directly.

6254.name: Golem Sentry
6254.text: Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

6255.name: Abare Ushioni
6255.text: Once per turn, you can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If you call it wrong, you take 1000 damage.

6256.name: The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion
6256.text: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding LIGHT Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

6257.name: The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion
6257.text: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

6258.name: The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion
6258.text: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding EARTH Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

6259.name: Whirlwind Prodigy
6259.text: When Tribute Summoning a WIND monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

6260.name: Flame Ruler
6260.text: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a FIRE monster.

6261.name: Firebird
6261.text: Each time a Winged Beast-Type monster(s) on your side of the field is destroyed, this card gains 500 ATK.

6262.name: Rescue Cat
6262.text: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Beast monsters from your Deck, but their effects are negated, also they are destroyed during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Cat" once per turn.

6263.name: Brain Jacker
6263.text: FLIP: Equip this card to a monster on your opponent's side of the field and treat it as an Equip Card. Take control of the equipped monster. Your opponent gains 500 Life Points during each of their Standby Phases.

6264.name: Gatling Dragon
6264.text: Once per turn: You can toss a coin 3 times and destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, but not more than the number of heads.

6265.name: King Dragun
6265.text: Your opponent cannot target Dragon monsters with card effects. Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Dragon monster from your hand.

6266.name: A Feather of the Phoenix
6266.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card in your GY; return that target to the top of your Deck.

6267.name: Poison Fangs
6267.text: Each time a Beast-Type monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

6268.name: Swords of Concealing Light
6268.text: Destroy this card during your 2nd Standby Phase after activation. When this card is activated: If your opponent controls a face-up monster, flip all monsters they control to face-down Defense Position. Monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

6269.name: Spiral Spear Strike
6269.text: If "Gaia The Fierce Knight", "Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight", or "Gaia the Dragon Champion" you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. If "Gaia the Dragon Champion" inflicts battle damage with this effect: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.

6270.name: Release Restraint
6270.text: Tribute 1 "Gearfried the Iron Knight"; Special Summon 1 "Gearfried the Swordmaster" from your hand or Deck.

6271.name: Centrifugal Field
6271.text: When a Fusion Monster(s) is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Its owner targets 1 Fusion Material Monster in their Graveyard that is listed on that Fusion Monster; that player Special Summons that target.

6272.name: Fulfillment of the Contract
6272.text: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

6273.name: Re-Fusion
6273.text: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Fusion Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

6274.name: The Big March of Animals
6274.text: All face-up Beast monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each Beast monster you control, until the end of this turn.

6275.name: Cross Counter
6275.text: If the DEF of an attacked Defense Position monster is higher than the ATK of your opponent's attacking monster, the Battle Damage inflicted to your opponent is doubled. Destroy the attacking monster after damage calculation.

6276.name: Pole Position
6276.text: The face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards. When "Pole Position" is removed from the field, destroy the face-up monster(s) with the highest ATK on the field.

6277.name: Penalty Game!
6277.text:
When your opponent has 4 cards in their hand: Activate 1 of these effects.
●Your opponent cannot draw during their next Draw Phase.
●Your opponent cannot activate Spell/Trap Cards this turn.

6278.name: Threatening Roar
6278.text: Your opponent cannot declare an attack this turn.

6279.name: Phoenix Wing Wind Blast
6279.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; place that target on the top of the Deck.

6280.name: Good Goblin Housekeeping
6280.text: Draw cards equal to the number of "Good Goblin Housekeeping" cards in your Graveyard +1, then select 1 card from your hand and return it to the bottom of your Deck.

6281.name: Beast Soul Swap
6281.text: Target 1 Beast-Type monster you control; return it to the hand, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Beast-Type monster from your hand with the same Level as the monster that was returned to the hand.

6282.name: Assault on GHQ
6282.text: Target 1 monster you control; destroy it, then send 2 cards from the top of your opponent's Deck to the GY.

6283.name: D.D. Dynamite
6283.text: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each of their removed from play cards.

6284.name: Deck Devastation Virus
6284.text: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 2000 or more ATK; look at your opponent's hand, all monsters they control, and all cards they draw until the end of their 3rd turn after this card resolves, and destroy all those monsters with 1500 or less ATK.

6285.name: Elemental Burst
6285.text: Tribute 1 each of WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH monsters to activate this card. Destroy all cards on your opponent's side of the field.

6286.name: Forced Ceasefire
6286.text: Discard 1 card from your hand. No Trap Cards can be activated until the end of this turn.

6310.name: Elemental HERO Avian
6310.text: A winged Elemental HERO who wheels through the sky and manipulates the wind. His signature move, Featherbreak, gives villainy a blow from sky-high.

6311.name: Elemental HERO Burstinatrix
6311.text: A flame manipulator who was the first Elemental HERO woman. Her Burstfire burns away villainy.

6312.name: Elemental HERO Clayman
6312.text: An Elemental HERO with a clay body built-to-last. He'll preserve his Elemental HERO colleagues at any cost.

6313.name: Elemental HERO Sparkman
6313.text: An Elemental HERO and a warrior of light who proficiently wields many kinds of armaments. His Static Shockwave cuts off the path of villainy.

6314.name: Winged Kuriboh
6314.text: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the GY: For the rest of this turn, you take no battle damage.

6315.name: Ancient Gear Golem
6315.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

6316.name: Ancient Gear Beast
6316.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Negate the effects of an opponent's monster destroyed by battle with this card (including in the GY).

6317.name: Ancient Gear Soldier
6317.text: If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

6318.name: Millennium Scorpion
6318.text: Each time this card destroys 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, this card gains 500 ATK.

6319.name: Ultimate Insect LV7
6319.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV5", while it remains on the field all of your opponent's monsters lose 700 ATK and DEF.

6320.name: Lost Guardian
6320.text: The original DEF of this card equals the number of your banished Rock-Type monsters x 700.

6321.name: Hieracosphinx
6321.text: Your opponent cannot select a face-down Defense Position monster as an attack target.

6322.name: Criosphinx
6322.text: When a monster is returned from the field to the owner's hand, the owner of the returned monster selects and sends 1 card in their hand to the Graveyard.

6323.name: Moai Interceptor Cannons
6323.text: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position.

6324.name: Megarock Dragon
6324.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing any number of Rock monster(s) from your GY. The original ATK/DEF of this card become the number of Rock monsters banished to Special Summon it x 700.

6325.name: Dummy Golem
6325.text: FLIP: Your opponent selects 1 monster they control. Switch control of the selected monster and this card.

6326.name: Grave Ohja
6326.text: While there is a face-down Defense Position monster(s) on your side of the field, no player can select this card as an attack target. Each time a monster on your side of the field is Flip Summoned, inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

6327.name: Mine Golem
6327.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

6328.name: Monk Fighter
6328.text: Battle Damage to this card's controller from a battle involving this card becomes 0.

6329.name: Master Monk
6329.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by Tributing 1 "Monk Fighter". This card can attack twice during the same turn.

6330.name: Guardian Statue
6330.text: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. When this card is Flip Summoned, return 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field to its owner's hand.

6331.name: Medusa Worm
6331.text: Once per turn: You can flip this card to face-down Defense Position. If this card is Flip Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

6332.name: D.D. Survivor
6332.text: During the End Phase, if this card was banished while face-up on your field, this turn: Special Summon this banished card. This effect can only activate once per turn.

6333.name: Mid Shield Gardna
6333.text: Once per turn, you can flip this card into face-down Defense Position. Negate the activation of any Spell Card that targets this 1 face-down monster. At that time, flip this card into face-up Defense Position.

6334.name: White Ninja
6334.text: FLIP: Target 1 Defense Position monster on the field; destroy that target.

6335.name: Aussa the Earth Charmer
6335.text: FLIP: Target 1 EARTH monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

6336.name: Eria the Water Charmer
6336.text: FLIP: Target 1 WATER monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

6337.name: Hiita the Fire Charmer
6337.text: FLIP: Target 1 FIRE monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

6338.name: Wynn the Wind Charmer
6338.text: FLIP: Target 1 WIND monster your opponent controls; take control of that monster while this card is face-up on the field.

6339.name: Batteryman AA
6339.text: If all "Batteryman AA"(s) on your side of the field are in Attack Position, this card gains 1000 ATK for each "Batteryman AA" on your side of the field. If all "Batteryman AA"(s) on your side of the field are in Defense Position, this card gains 1000 DEF for each "Batteryman AA" on your side of the field.

6340.name: Des Wombat
6340.text: Any damage to you from a card effect becomes 0.

6341.name: King of the Skull Servants
6341.text: The original ATK of this card is the combined number of "King of the Skull Servants" and "Skull Servant" in your GY x 1000. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other "King of the Skull Servants" or 1 "Skull Servant" from your GY; Special Summon this card.

6342.name: Reshef the Dark Being
6342.text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Final Ritual of the Ancients". Once per turn, by discarding 1 Spell Card from your hand, take control of 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of this turn.

6343.name: Elemental Mistress Doriado
6343.text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Doriado's Blessing". The Attribute of this card is also treated as WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH while it is face-up on the field.

6344.name: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman
6344.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster in the GY.

6345.name: Elemental HERO Thunder Giant
6345.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field with original ATK less than the ATK of this card; destroy that target.

6346.name: Gift of the Martyr
6346.text: Send 1 monster you control to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the sent monster until the end of this turn.

6347.name: Double Attack
6347.text: Discard 1 Monster Card from your hand to the Graveyard. Select 1 monster on your side of the field with a lower Level than the discarded monster. The selected monster can attack twice this turn.

6348.name: Battery Charger
6348.text: Pay 500 Life Points. Special Summon 1 "Batteryman" monster from your Graveyard.

6349.name: Kaminote Blow
6349.text: Activate only if there is at least 1 face-up "Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter", "Monk Fighter", or "Master Monk" on your side of the field. Destroy the monster(s) that battle with these monsters on your side of the field this turn, at the end of each Damage Step.

6350.name: Doriado's Blessing
6350.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Elemental Mistress Doriado". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 3 or more from the field or your hand.

6351.name: Final Ritual of the Ancients
6351.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Reshef the Dark Being". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand.

6352.name: Legendary Black Belt
6352.text: Equip only to "Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter", "Monk Fighter", or "Master Monk". When the equipped monster destroys your opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the DEF of the destroyed monster.

6353.name: Nitro Unit
6353.text: Equip only to a monster on your opponent's side of the field. When the equipped monster is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the equipped monster.

6354.name: Shifting Shadows
6354.text: Once per turn, by paying 300 Life Points, rearrange the face-down Defense Position monsters in your Main Monster Zones, then return them in face-down Defense Position.

6355.name: Impenetrable Formation
6355.text: Select 1 monster on your side of the field to activate this card. While you have 2 or more monsters on your side of the field, and all monsters on your side of the field are in Defense Position, the selected monster gains 700 DEF. When the selected monster is removed from the field, destroy this card.

6356.name: Hero Signal
6356.text: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand or Deck.

6357.name: Pikeru's Second Sight
6357.text: Until your opponent's second End Phase, your opponent shows you all cards that they draw before adding them to their hand.

6358.name: Minefield Eruption
6358.text: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each face-up "Mine Golem" on your side of the field. After that, destroy all face-up "Mine Golem"(s) on your side of the field.

6359.name: Kozaky's Self-Destruct Button
6359.text: Inflict 1000 damage to the player who destroyed this Set card.

6360.name: Mispolymerization
6360.text: Activate only when a Fusion Monster is Special Summoned. Return all face-up Fusion Monsters to their respective Extra Decks.

6361.name: Level Conversion Lab
6361.text: Select 1 monster in your hand and show it to your opponent, then roll a six-sided die. If the result is 1, send the selected monster to the Graveyard. If the result is 2-6, the Level of the selected monster becomes equal to the result until the end of this turn.

6362.name: Rock Bombardment
6362.text: Send 1 Rock monster from your Deck to the GY; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

6363.name: Grave Lure
6363.text: Turn the top card of your opponent's Deck face-up, then your opponent shuffles their Deck. When your opponent draws the face-up card, immediately send it to the Graveyard.

6364.name: Token Feastevil
6364.text: When a Token(s) is Special Summoned: Destroy as many Tokens on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each Token destroyed.

6365.name: Spell-Stopping Statute
6365.text: Activate only when your opponent activates a Continuous Spell Card. Negate the activation and the effect of the card and destroy it.

6366.name: Royal Surrender
6366.text: Activate only when your opponent activates a Continuous Trap Card. Negate the activation and the effect of the card and destroy it.

6367.name: Lone Wolf
6367.text: Activate only if the 1 and only monster on your side of the field is "Chu-Ske the Mouse Fighter", "Monk Fighter", or "Master Monk". That monster cannot be destroyed as a result of battle, and is unaffected by any of your opponent's monster effects.

6383.name: Cycroid
6383.text: The most lovable and friendly of all the Vehicroids. It can arm itself with training wheels!

6384.name: Patroid
6384.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can look at 1 face-down card your opponent controls, then return it to its original position.

6385.name: Gyroid
6385.text: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed.

6386.name: Steamroid
6386.text: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, this card gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, this card loses 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

6387.name: Drillroid
6387.text: Before damage calculation, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

6388.name: UFOroid
6388.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Machine-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

6389.name: Jetroid
6389.text: At the time this card is selected as an attack target by an opponent's monster, you can activate Trap Card(s) from your hand.

6390.name: Cyber Dragon
6390.text: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

6391.name: Wroughtweiler
6391.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 "Elemental HERO" card and 1 "Polymerization" in your GY; add them to your hand.

6392.name: Dark Catapulter
6392.text: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in Defense Position, put 1 counter on this card. You can remove from play a number of card(s) in your Graveyard equal to the number of counters on this card to destroy that many Spell or Trap Card(s) on the field. Then remove all counter(s) from this card.

6393.name: Elemental HERO Bubbleman
6393.text: If this is the only card in your hand, you can Special Summon it (from your hand). When this card is Summoned: You can draw 2 cards. You must control no other cards and have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

6395.name: UFOroid Fighter
6395.text: A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. The original ATK and DEF of this card become equal to the combined original ATK of the 2 Fusion Material Monsters you used for the Fusion Summon of this card.

6396.name: Cyber Twin Dragon
6396.text: A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

6397.name: Cyber End Dragon
6397.text: A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

6398.name: Power Bond
6398.text: Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material, and it gains ATK equal to its original ATK. During the End Phase of the turn this card is activated, you take damage equal to the amount of ATK gained from this effect at the time of the Summon.

6399.name: Skyscraper
6399.text: If an "Elemental HERO" monster attacks a monster that has a higher ATK, the attacking monster gains 1000 ATK during damage calculation only.

6406.name: Winged Kuriboh LV10
6406.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Transcendent Wings". During your opponent's Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this face-up card; destroy as many Attack Position monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s).

6407.name: Transcendent Wings
6407.text: Send 1 face-up or face-down "Winged Kuriboh" you control and 2 cards from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Winged Kuriboh LV10" from your hand or Deck.

6408.name: Bubble Shuffle
6408.text: Target 1 face-up Attack Position "Elemental HERO Bubbleman" you control and 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change both those targets to Defense Position, then Tribute that "Elemental HERO Bubbleman", then Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your hand.

6409.name: Spark Blaster
6409.text: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Sparkman". During your Main Phase: You can target 1 face-up monster; change the battle position of that target. After you use this effect 3 times, destroy this card.

6411.name: Soitsu
6411.text: Apparently totally unreliable, he wonders if he has incredible potential.

6412.name: Mad Lobster
6412.text: A gourmet food renowned by the Dark World upper crust. It has sensational flavor.

6413.name: Jerry Beans Man
6413.text: Jerry, a bean soldier, believes he is the strongest warrior in the world, but his true abilities are still untested.

6414.name: Cybernetic Magician
6414.text: You can discard 1 card to target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target's ATK becomes 2000 until the End Phase.

6415.name: Cybernetic Cyclopean
6415.text: While you have no cards in your hand, this card gains 1000 ATK.

6416.name: Mechanical Hound
6416.text: While you have no cards in your hand, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards.

6417.name: Cyber Archfiend
6417.text: At the beginning of your Draw Phase, if you have no cards in your hand, draw 1 more card in addition to your normal draw. During your End Phase, if you have 1 or more card(s) in your hand, destroy this card.

6418.name: Goblin Elite Attack Force
6418.text: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and its battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn.

6419.name: B.E.S. Crystal Core
6419.text: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

6420.name: Giant Kozaky
6420.text: If there is no face-up "Kozaky" on the field, destroy this card. If this face-up card is destroyed, inflict damage equal to the original ATK of this card to its current controller.

6421.name: Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei
6421.text: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

6422.name: Protective Soul Ailin
6422.text: Once per turn, you can equip this card to an "Indomitable Fighter Lei Lei" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, you can change that monster's battle position once per turn. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

6423.name: Doitsu
6423.text: Once per turn, you can equip this card to a "Soitsu" you control, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. When equipped to a monster by this card's effect, that monster gains 2500 ATK. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

6424.name: Des Frog
6424.text: When this card is Tribute Summoned, you can Special Summon "Des Frog"(s) from your hand or Deck up to the number of "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) in your Graveyard.

6425.name: T.A.D.P.O.L.E.
6425.text: When this card you control is destroyed by battle and sent to your Graveyard, you can add any "T.A.D.P.O.L.E."(s) from your Deck to your hand.

6426.name: Poison Draw Frog
6426.text: When this face-up card on the field is sent to the Graveyard (unless it was attacked while face-down and destroyed by battle), you can draw 1 card.

6427.name: Tyranno Infinity
6427.text: The original ATK of this card becomes the number of your banished Dinosaur monsters x 1000.

6428.name: Batteryman C
6428.text: If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Attack Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 ATK for each "Batteryman C" you control. If all "Batteryman C"(s) you control are in Defense Position, all Machine-Type monsters you control gain 500 DEF for each "Batteryman C" you control.

6429.name: Ebon Magician Curran
6429.text: During your Standby Phase, inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

6430.name: D.D.M. - Different Dimension Master
6430.text: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell, then target 1 of your banished monsters; Special Summon that target.

6431.name: Fusion Recovery
6431.text: Target 1 "Polymerization" in your GY, and 1 monster in your GY that was used as material for a Fusion Summon; add them to your hand.

6432.name: Miracle Fusion
6432.text: Fusion Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials mentioned on it from your field or GY.

6433.name: Dragon's Mirror
6433.text: Fusion Summon 1 Dragon Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing Fusion Materials listed on it from your field or GY.

6434.name: System Down
6434.text: Pay 1000 LP; banish all Machine-Type monsters your opponent controls and in their Graveyard.

6435.name: Des Croaking
6435.text: Activate only while you control 3 face-up "Des Frogs". Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

6436.name: Pot of Generosity
6436.text: Return 2 cards from your hand to your Deck. Then shuffle your Deck.

6437.name: Shien's Spy
6437.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; give control of it to your opponent until the End Phase of this turn.

6438.name: Fire Darts
6438.text: You can only activate this card when you have no cards in your hand. Roll a six-sided die 3 times, and inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the total result of the die rolls x 100 points.

6439.name: Spiritual Earth Art - Kurogane
6439.text: Tribute 1 EARTH monster and target 1 other Level 4 or lower EARTH monster in your GY; Special Summon that EARTH monster.

6440.name: Spiritual Water Art - Aoi
6440.text: Tribute 1 WATER monster; look at your opponent's hand, then send 1 card from their hand to the GY.

6441.name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
6441.text: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

6442.name: Spiritual Wind Art - Miyabi
6442.text: Tribute 1 WIND monster, then target 1 card your opponent controls; place that opponent's card on the bottom of the Deck.

6443.name: A Rival Appears!
6443.text: Select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls. Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that has the same Level as the selected monster.

6444.name: Magical Explosion
6444.text: Activate only while you have no cards in your hand. Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each Spell Card in your Graveyard.

6445.name: Rising Energy
6445.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target gains 1500 ATK until the end of this turn.

6446.name: D.D. Trap Hole
6446.text: When your opponent Sets exactly 1 monster (and no other cards): Target that Set monster and 1 monster you control; destroy those targets, and if you do, banish them.

6447.name: Conscription
6447.text: Excavate the top card of your opponent's Deck, and if it is a monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set, Special Summon it to your field. Otherwise, add that card to your opponent's hand.

6448.name: Dimension Wall
6448.text: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Instead of you, your opponent takes the Battle Damage you would have taken from this battle.

6449.name: Prepare to Strike Back
6449.text: Each time your opponent declares a face-up Defense Position monster as an attack target, toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, change the targeted monster to Attack Position. If you call it wrong, the controller of this card takes damage equal to the amount that the ATK of the attacking monster is higher than the DEF of the attack target.

6454.name: Arcana Knight Joker
6454.text: A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above materials. Once per turn, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that targets this face-up card on the field (Quick Effect): You can discard the same type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap); negate the effect.

6467.name: Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman
6467.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 300 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" card in your GY. If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK in the GY.

6468.name: Level Modulation
6468.text: Your opponent draws 2 cards. Special Summon 1 "LV" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions. The monster that was Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, nor activate or apply its effect this turn.

6469.name: Ojamuscle
6469.text:
(This card is always treated as a "Ojama" card.)
Select 1 face-up "Ojama King". Destroy all "Ojama" monsters on the field, except the selected "Ojama King". It gains 1000 ATK for each monster destroyed this way.

6470.name: Ojamagic
6470.text: If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: Add 1 each of "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow", and "Ojama Black" from your Deck to your hand.

6471.name: V-Tiger Jet
6471.text: This ace fighter is unbeatable in a dogfight. It combines with other monsters to launch an array of encircling attacks.

6472.name: Blade Skater
6472.text: An image of beauty on the ice, this gorgeous warrior rips her opponents into pieces with her stylish Accel Slicer attack.

6473.name: Reborn Zombie
6473.text: While you have no cards in your hand and this card is in Attack Position, it cannot be destroyed by battle.

6474.name: Chthonian Soldier
6474.text: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

6475.name: W-Wing Catapult
6475.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "V-Tiger Jet" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. The equipped monster gains 400 ATK/DEF.

6476.name: Infernal Incinerator
6476.text: This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK. This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control.

6477.name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
6477.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

6479.name: Hydrogeddon
6479.text: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.

6480.name: Oxygeddon
6480.text: If this card is destroyed by battle with a Pyro monster and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage.

6481.name: Water Dragon
6481.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Bonding - H2O". The ATK of FIRE monsters and Pyro monsters on the field becomes 0. When this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon" in your GY; Special Summon them.

6482.name: Etoile Cyber
6482.text: If this card attacks directly, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

6483.name: VW-Tiger Catapult
6483.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position. (Flip effects are not activated.)

6484.name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
6484.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish that target. When this card declares an attack on an opponent's monster: You can target the attack target; change that attack target's battle position. (Flip effects are not activated.)

6485.name: Cyber Blader
6485.text:
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. This card gains the following effect, based on the number of monsters your opponent controls.
●1: Cannot be destroyed by battle.
●2: This card's ATK is doubled.
●3: Your opponent's activated card effects are negated.

6486.name: Elemental HERO Rampart Blaster
6486.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. This card can attack directly while in Defense Position. If it does, apply its ATK for damage calculation, and its ATK is halved during damage calculation only.

6487.name: Elemental HERO Tempest
6487.text: Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You can send 1 other card you control to the Graveyard to target 1 monster you control; while this card is face-up on the field, that monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

6488.name: Elemental HERO Wildedge
6488.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each.

6489.name: Chthonian Alliance
6489.text: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK for each other face-up monster on the field that has the same name it does.

6491.name: Feather Shot
6491.text: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" you control; during this turn, that target can attack a number of times equal to the number of monsters you control when this card resolves, but cannot attack directly, and other monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

6492.name: Bonding - H2O
6492.text: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

6493.name: Chthonian Polymer
6493.text: Activate only when your opponent Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster. Tribute 1 monster to take control of that Fusion Monster.

6494.name: Chthonian Blast
6494.text: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK.

6495.name: Hero Barrier
6495.text: Negate 1 attack from an opponent's monster. You must control a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster to resolve this effect.

6496.name: Feather Wind
6496.text: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated while you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Avian": Negate the activation and destroy it.

6497.name: Zure, Knight of Dark World
6497.text: The name of this illustrious knight is known by all residents of Dark World. He never oppresses the commoners.

6498.name: B.E.S. Tetran
6498.text: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

6499.name: Nanobreaker
6499.text: If this card attacks a face-up Level 3 or lower monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

6500.name: Rapid-Fire Magician
6500.text: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent each time you activate a Normal Spell Card.

6501.name: Beiige, Vanguard of Dark World
6501.text: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Special Summon this card.

6502.name: Broww, Huntsman of Dark World
6502.text: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Draw 1 card, or, if it was discarded from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect, draw 2 cards instead.

6503.name: Brron, Mad King of Dark World
6503.text: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can discard 1 card.

6504.name: Sillva, Warlord of Dark World
6504.text: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Special Summon this card, then, if it was discarded from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect, your opponent places exactly 2 cards from their hand on the bottom of their Deck, in any order.

6505.name: Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World
6505.text: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: If it was discarded from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect, you can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; Special Summon this card, then destroy those targets (if any).

6506.name: Scarr, Scout of Dark World
6506.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Add 1 Level 4 or lower "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand.

6507.name: Familiar-Possessed - Aussa
6507.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Aussa the Earth Charmer" and 1 face-up EARTH monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

6508.name: Familiar-Possessed - Eria
6508.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Eria the Water Charmer" and 1 face-up WATER monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

6509.name: Familiar-Possessed - Hiita
6509.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Hiita the Fire Charmer" and 1 face-up FIRE monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

6510.name: Familiar-Possessed - Wynn
6510.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Wynn the Wind Charmer" and 1 face-up WIND monster you control to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

6511.name: Pot of Avarice
6511.text: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

6512.name: Dark World Lightning
6512.text: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target, then discard 1 card.

6513.name: Branch!
6513.text: When a Fusion Monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of the Fusion Materials in your Graveyard that was used for its Fusion Summon; Special Summon it.

6514.name: Boss Rush
6514.text: Activate only if you did not Normal Summon/Set this turn. You cannot Normal Summon/Set. During the End Phase, if a face-up "B.E.S." monster(s) you control was destroyed and sent to the GY this turn while this card was face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone: You can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster from your Deck.

6515.name: Gateway to Dark World
6515.text: Target 1 "Dark World" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. You cannot Summon monsters the turn you activate this card, except by this effect (but you can Normal Set).

6516.name: The Forces of Darkness
6516.text: Target 2 "Dark World" monsters in your GY; add those targets to your hand.

6517.name: Dark Deal
6517.text: When your opponent activates a Normal Spell Card: Pay 1000 LP; the activated effect of that Normal Spell becomes "Your opponent discards 1 random card".

6518.name: Simultaneous Loss
6518.text: Each player sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

6519.name: Weed Out
6519.text: Pay 500 Life Points. Destroy all face-up Attack Position Level 3 monsters.

6520.name: The League of Uniform Nomenclature
6520.text: Select 1 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monster you control to activate this card. Special Summon as many cards as possible from your Deck with the same name as the selected monster.

6521.name: Roll Out!
6521.text: Target 1 Union monster in your GY; equip that target to an appropriate monster you control for that Union monster's effect.

6523.name: Level Limit - Area A
6523.text: Change all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters to Attack Position.

6524.name: Armed Changer
6524.text: Send 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to activate this card. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by battle, the controller of this Equip Card can add 1 monster with ATK equal to or less than the equipped monster from their Graveyard to their hand.

6527.name: Elemental HERO Necroshade
6527.text: Once, while this card is in the GY, you can Normal Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "Elemental HERO" monster without Tributing.

6529.name: Elemental HERO Mudballman
6529.text: Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways.

6535.name: Elemental HERO Steam Healer
6535.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Gain LP equal to that monster's original ATK in the GY.

6540.name: Armed Dragon LV10
6540.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Armed Dragon LV7". You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

6563.name: Uria, Lord of Searing Flames
6563.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Traps you control to the GY. Gains 1000 ATK for each Continuous Trap in your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target. Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards in response to this effect's activation.

6564.name: Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
6564.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 3 face-up Continuous Spells you control to the GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. While this card is in face-up Defense Position, monsters your opponent controls cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one.

6565.name: Raviel, Lord of Phantasms
6565.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 Fiend monsters. Each time your opponent Normal Summons a monster: Special Summon 1 "Phantasm Token" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 1000/DEF 1000), but it cannot declare an attack. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 monster; this card gains ATK equal to the Tributed monster's original ATK, until the end of this turn.

6566.name: Elemental HERO Neo Bubbleman
6566.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending an "Elemental Hero Bubbleman" you control and "Metamorphosis" in your hand to the Graveyard. This card's name is treated as "Elemental Hero Bubbleman" while it is face-up on the field. Destroy an opponent's monster that battles this card at the end of the Damage Step.

6567.name: Hero Kid
6567.text: When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon any number of "Hero Kid"(s) from your Deck.

6568.name: Cyber Barrier Dragon
6568.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Attack Reflector Unit". Once per turn, while this card is in Attack Position, your opponent's next attack is negated.

6569.name: Cyber Laser Dragon
6569.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Photon Generator Unit". Once per turn, you can destroy 1 monster with ATK or DEF equal to or higher than the ATK of this card.

6570.name: Ancient Gear
6570.text: If you control an "Ancient Gear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in Attack Position.

6571.name: Hero Heart
6571.text: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control; halve its ATK until the end of this turn, but it can attack twice during this turn's Battle Phase.

6572.name: Magnet Circle LV2
6572.text: Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Machine monster from your hand.

6573.name: Ancient Gear Factory
6573.text: Reveal 1 Level 5 or higher "Ancient Gear" monster from your hand, then banish a number of "Ancient Gear" monsters from your Graveyard, whose combined Levels are double the revealed monster's, and if you do, if you Normal Summon the revealed monster this turn, you must Normal Smmon it without Tributing.

6574.name: Ancient Gear Drill
6574.text: If you control an "Ancient Gear" monster: Discard 1 card; Set 1 Spell Card directly from your Deck. This turn, that Spell Card cannot be activated.

6575.name: Phantasmal Martyrs
6575.text: While you have at least 2 other cards in your hand, and control "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames" or "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder": Send your entire hand to the GY; Special Summon 3 "Phantasmal Martyr Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Attack Position.

6576.name: Cyclone Boomerang
6576.text: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Wildheart". It gains 500 ATK. When the equipped monster is destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field, then inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each Spell/Trap Card destroyed by this effect.

6577.name: Photon Generator Unit
6577.text: Tribute 2 "Cyber Dragons". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Laser Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard.

6578.name: Ancient Gear Castle
6578.text: All "Ancient Gear" monsters gain 300 ATK. Each time a monster is Normal Summoned/Set, place 1 counter on this card. If you Tribute Summon an "Ancient Gear" monster face-up, you can Tribute this card instead, if the number of its counters is equal to or greater than the number of required Tribute(s).

6579.name: Super Junior Confrontation
6579.text: Activate only when an opponent's monster declares an attack. Negate the battle, and 1 monster with the lowest ATK in face-up Attack Position your opponent controls battles against 1 monster with the lowest DEF in face-up Defense Position you control. After that battle, end the Battle Phase.

6580.name: Miracle Kids
6580.text: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; that target loses 400 ATK for each "Hero Kid" in your Graveyard, until the End Phase.

6581.name: Attack Reflector Unit
6581.text: Tribute 1 "Cyber Dragon". Special Summon 1 "Cyber Barrier Dragon" from your hand or Deck.

6582.name: Damage Condenser
6582.text: When you take battle damage: Discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with ATK less than or equal to the battle damage you took, in Attack Position.

6587.name: Ancient Gear Cannon
6587.text: You can Tribute this card; inflict 500 damage to your opponent, and if you do, neither player can activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase of this turn.

6588.name: Proto-Cyber Dragon
6588.text: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field.

6589.name: Adhesive Explosive
6589.text: Before damage calculation, if this card was attacked by an opponent's monster and was in face-down Defense Position at the start of the Damage Step: Equip this card to the attacking monster. Then, during your opponent's next Standby Phase, destroy the monster this card is equipped to.

6590.name: Machine King Prototype
6590.text: This card gains 100 ATK and DEF for each Machine-Type monster on the field, except this card.

6591.name: B.E.S. Covered Core
6591.text: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 2 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, at the end of the Damage Step toss a coin and call it. If you call it wrong, remove 1 counter. If this card battles without a counter, destroy it at the end of the Damage Step.

6592.name: D.D. Guide
6592.text: When this card is Normal Summoned, give control of it to your opponent. During each player's End Phase, your opponent selects 1 card from the Graveyard of this card's controller and removes it from play.

6593.name: Chain Thrasher
6593.text: This card can attack 1 additional time during the same Battle Phase for each "Chain Thrasher" in your Graveyard.

6594.name: Disciple of the Forbidden Spell
6594.text: When this card is Summoned, declare different Monster Card Attributes equal to the number of "Disciple of the Forbidden Spell"(s) in your Graveyard. If this card attacks a monster that has a declared Attribute, destroy the monster with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

6595.name: Tenkabito Shien
6595.text: This card is unaffected by the effects of Trap Cards.

6596.name: Parasitic Ticky
6596.text: The ATK and DEF of this card are each equal to the number of tokens on the field x 500.

6597.name: Gokipon
6597.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can add 1 Insect monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

6598.name: Silent Insect
6598.text: This card is changed to Defense Position when it is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned. Negate the effects of all Continuous Spell Cards and Continuous Trap Cards.

6599.name: Chainsaw Insect
6599.text: If this card battled, at the end of the Damage Step: Your opponent draws 1 card.

6600.name: Anteatereatingant
6600.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by sending 2 Spell or Trap Cards you control to the Graveyard. You can destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

6601.name: Saber Beetle
6601.text: During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

6602.name: Doom Dozer
6602.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 Insect monsters from your GY. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY.

6603.name: Treeborn Frog
6603.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if this card is in your GY and you do not control "Treeborn Frog": You can Special Summon this card. You must control no Spells/Traps to activate and to resolve this effect.

6604.name: Beelze Frog
6604.text: This card gains 300 ATK for each "T.A.D.P.O.L.E." in your Graveyard.

6605.name: Princess Pikeru
6605.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Trial of the Princesses". During your Standby Phase, gain 800 Life Points for each monster you control.

6606.name: Princess Curran
6606.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "Trial of the Princesses". During your Standby Phase, inflict 600 damage to your opponent for each monster they control.

6607.name: Memory Crusher
6607.text: If this card successfully attacks directly, inflict 100 damage to your opponent for each card in their Extra Deck.

6608.name: Malice Ascendant
6608.text: During your opponent's Standby Phase, send 1 card from the top of their Deck to the Graveyard for each "Malice Ascendant" in your Graveyard.

6609.name: Grass Phantom
6609.text: This card gains 500 ATK for each "Grass Phantom" in your Graveyard.

6610.name: Sand Moth
6610.text: If this face-down Defense Position card is destroyed and sent to the GY: Special Summon it and switch its original ATK/DEF.

6611.name: Divine Dragon - Excelion
6611.text:
When this card is Normal Summoned, it gets 1 of the following effects for each "Divine Dragon - Excelion" in your Graveyard when this effect resolves (your choice). These effects cannot accumulate.
●This card gains 1000 ATK.
●If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, it can attack once again in a row.
●When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the destroyed monster.

6612.name: Ruin, Queen of Oblivion
6612.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "End of the World". When this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can activate this effect; this card can make a second attack in a row.

6613.name: Demise, King of Armageddon
6613.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "End of the World". You can pay 2000 LP; destroy all other cards on the field.

6614.name: D.3.S. Frog
6614.text: A Fusion Summon of this card can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. This card gains 500 ATK for each "Treeborn Frog" in your Graveyard.

6615.name: Symbol of Heritage
6615.text: Activate only while there are 3 Monster Cards with the same name in your Graveyard. Select 1 of those monsters, Special Summon it, and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

6616.name: Trial of the Princesses
6616.text: Equip only to "White Magician Pikeru" or "Ebon Magician Curran"; it gains 800 ATK. During a turn that the equipped monster destroyed a Level 5 or higher monster by battle, you can Tribute the equipped monster and this card to Special Summon from your hand or Deck: 1 "Princess Pikeru" if you Tributed "White Magician Pikeru", or 1 "Princess Curran" if you Tributed "Ebon Magician Curran".

6617.name: End of the World
6617.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Ruin, Queen of Oblivion" or "Demise, King of Armageddon". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels exactly equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon.

6618.name: Samsara
6618.text: Monster Cards Tributed for a Ritual Summon are returned to the owner's Deck instead of being sent to the Graveyard.

6619.name: Karma Cut
6619.text: Discard 1 card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; banish that target, then banish all cards with the same name as that monster from your opponent's GY.

6620.name: Next to be Lost
6620.text: Select 1 face-up monster you control. Send 1 card from your Deck to the Graveyard with the same name as the selected card.

6621.name: Generation Shift
6621.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; destroy that target, then add 1 card with the same name as the destroyed card from your Deck to your hand.

6622.name: Full Salvo
6622.text: When this card resolves, send your entire hand to the Graveyard. Inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each card you sent to the Graveyard by this effect.

6623.name: Success Probability 0%
6623.text: Send 2 random Fusion Monsters from your opponent's Extra Deck to the Graveyard.

6624.name: Option Hunter
6624.text: Activate only when a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. Gain Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.

6625.name: Goblin Out of the Frying Pan
6625.text: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Spell Card and return it to the owner's hand.

6626.name: Malfunction
6626.text: Pay 500 Life Points. Negate the activation of a Trap Card and return it to its original position.

6639.name: Elemental HERO Electrum
6639.text: Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. While face-up on the field, this card is also WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH-Attribute. 6812.name: Brainwashing Beam
6812.text: Select 1 monster with at least 1 A-Counter on your opponent's side of the field and take control of that monster. During each of your End Phases, remove 1 A-Counter from that controlled monster. If all A-Counters are removed from that monster, or that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

6813.name: Royal Writ of Taxation
6813.text: Activate only during your opponent's Standby Phase. Select 1 random card from your opponent's hand and look at it. Unless the selected card or a card with the same name is Normal Summoned or activated by the end of your next turn, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If the selected card or a card with the same name is Normal Summoned or activated by the end of your next turn, you take 1000 damage.

6814.name: Cyclone Blade
6814.text: Equip only to a "Destiny HERO" monster. At the end of the Damage Step, if the equipped monster attacked: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

6830.name: Cyberdark Horn
6830.text: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; equip that Dragon monster to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster, instead.

6831.name: Cyberdark Edge
6831.text: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; equip that Dragon monster to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. This card can attack directly. If it does using this effect, its ATK is halved during damage calculation only. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster, instead.

6832.name: Cyberdark Keel
6832.text: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 Level 3 or lower Dragon monster in your GY; equip that Dragon monster to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster, instead.

6833.name: Cyberdark Dragon
6833.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 Dragon monster in your GY; equip that target to this card. Gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect. Gains 100 ATK for each monster in your GY. If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster instead.

6835.name: Super Vehicroid - Stealth Union
6835.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up non-Machine monster on the field; equip that target to this card. While equipped with a monster by this effect, this card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If this card attacks, its original ATK is halved. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

6854.name: Cyber Ogre
6854.text: By discarding this card from your hand to the Graveyard, negate 1 battle involving a "Cyber Ogre" on your side of the field, and it gains 2000 ATK until the end of its next battle. This effect can be activated during either player's turn.

6855.name: Cyber Esper
6855.text: While this card is in face-up Attack Position, you can look at every card your opponent draws.

6856.name: Cyber Ogre 2
6856.text: A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When this card attacks, it gains ATK equal to half the ATK of the attack target, during damage calculation only.

6858.name: Cyber Shadow Gardna
6858.text: During your opponent's Main Phase: Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK ?/DEF ?). (This card is also still a Trap.) When an opponent's monster declares an attack that targets this card: The ATK/DEF of this card become the ATK/DEF of the attacking monster. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: Set this card in its Spell & Trap Zone.

6859.name: Byroad Sacrifice
6859.text: Activate only if a monster on your side of the field is destroyed by battle. Special Summon 1 "Cyber Ogre" from your hand.

6860.name: Trojan Blast
6860.text: Activate only when an opponent's card effect shifts control of a monster from your side of the field to theirs. Destroy that 1 monster and inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

6870.name: Allure Queen LV3
6870.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 Level 3 or lower monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card as an Equip Spell (max. 1). If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster, instead. During your Standby Phase: You can send this card equipped with a monster by this card's effect to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Allure Queen LV5" from your hand or Deck.

6871.name: Allure Queen LV5
6871.text: Once per turn, if you control this card that was Special Summoned by the effect of "Allure Queen LV3": You can target 1 Level 5 or lower monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card as an Equip Spell (max. 1). If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster, instead. During your Standby Phase: You can send this card equipped with a monster by this card's effect to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Allure Queen LV7" from your hand or Deck.

6872.name: Allure Queen LV7
6872.text: Once per turn, if you control this card that was Special Summoned by the effect of "Allure Queen LV5": You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card as an Equip Spell (max. 1). If this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy that equipped monster, instead.

6876.name: Dark Lucius LV4
6876.text: Negate the effects of your opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with this card. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of your next turn after this card has destroyed a monster by battle: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV6" from your hand or Deck.

6877.name: Dark Lucius LV6
6877.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV4", negate the effects of your opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with this card. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of your next turn after this card negated your opponent's monster effect by this effect: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV8" from your hand or Deck.

6878.name: Dark Lucius LV8
6878.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV6", banish your opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with this card, also negate their effects.

6879.name: Snipe Hunter
6879.text: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; roll a six-sided die, and destroy that target unless you roll a 1 or 6.

6880.name: Blast Asmodian
6880.text: If any Spell or Trap Card(s) are Chained, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

6881.name: Vanity's Fiend
6881.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. Neither player can Special Summon monsters.

6882.name: Barrier Statue of the Abyss
6882.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except DARK monsters.

6883.name: Barrier Statue of the Torrent
6883.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except WATER monsters.

6884.name: Barrier Statue of the Inferno
6884.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except FIRE monsters.

6885.name: Barrier Statue of the Stormwinds
6885.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except WIND monsters.

6886.name: Barrier Statue of the Drought
6886.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except EARTH monsters.

6887.name: Barrier Statue of the Heavens
6887.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters, except LIGHT monsters.

6888.name: Vanity's Ruler
6888.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. Your opponent cannot Special Summon monsters.

6889.name: Iris, the Earth Mother
6889.text: After a Chain with 3 or more Links resolves, draw 1 card. This effect cannot activate if multiple cards/effects with the same name were activated in that Chain.

6890.name: Lightning Punisher
6890.text: After a Chain with 3 or more Links resolves, destroy 1 card on your opponent's side of the field. This effect cannot activate if multiple cards/effects with the same name were activated in that Chain.

6891.name: Queen's Bodyguard
6891.text: "Allure Queen" monsters on your side of the field cannot be selected as an attack target.

6892.name: Combo Fighter
6892.text: If a Chain (of 2 or more Links) occurred in your Main Phase 1, this card can attack twice during the Battle Phase this turn.

6893.name: Combo Master
6893.text: If a Chain (of 2 or more Links) occurred in your Main Phase 1, this card can attack twice during the Battle Phase this turn.

6894.name: Man Beast of Ares
6894.text: After a Chain (of 2 or more Links) resolves, this card gains 500 ATK.

6895.name: Rampaging Rhynos
