6895.text: Once per turn, this card can move to an adjacent (horizontal) unoccupied Monster Card Zone. If this card attacks the monster in its same column, this card gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step.

6896.name: Storm Shooter
6896.text:
Once per turn, you can select and activate 1 of these effects:
●Move this card to an adjacent (horizontal) unoccupied Monster Card Zone.
●Return 1 Spell, Trap or Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field in the same column as this card to its owner's hand.

6897.name: Alien Infiltrator
6897.text: Once per turn, this card can move to an adjacent (horizontal) unoccupied Monster Card Zone. If no Spell, Trap or Monster Card on your opponent's side of the field is in the same column as this card, it can attack your opponent directly.

6898.name: Corruption Cell "A"
6898.text: Place 1 A-Counter on 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field.

6899.name: Flash of the Forbidden Spell
6899.text: If your opponent controls monsters in all of their Main Monster Zones: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

6900.name: Ritual Foregone
6900.text: Pay 1000 Life Points. Special Summon 1 Ritual Monster from your hand. The Ritual Monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, and is destroyed during the End Phase. Only 1 "Ritual Foregone" can be activated per turn.

6901.name: Instant Fusion
6901.text: Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot attack, also it is destroyed during the End Phase. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) You can only activate 1 "Instant Fusion" per turn.

6902.name: Counter Cleaner
6902.text: Pay 500 LP; remove all counters on the field.

6903.name: Linear Accelerator Cannon
6903.text: Tribute 1 monster and inflict damage to your opponent equal to half that monster's original ATK. If you activate this card, you cannot activate any other Spell Cards this turn.

6904.name: Chain Strike
6904.text: Activate only as Chain Link 2 or higher; inflict 400 damage to your opponent times the Chain Link number of this card. You cannot activate this card if multiple cards/effects with the same name are in that Chain.

6905.name: Miraculous Rebirth
6905.text: Activate only as Chain Link 4 or higher. Select 1 monster from either player's Graveyard and Special Summon it. You cannot activate this card if multiple cards/effects with the same name are in that Chain.

6906.name: Mystical Wind Typhoon
6906.text: Activate only as Chain Link 3 or higher. Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field. You cannot activate this card if multiple cards/effects with the same name are in that Chain.

6907.name: Level Down!?
6907.text: Select 1 face-up "LV" monster on the field to activate this card. Return the selected card to its owner's Deck and Special Summon 1 monster from the owner's Graveyard to their side of the field with the same name but lower "LV" (ignoring the Summoning conditions).

6908.name: Degenerate Circuit
6908.text: The controller of this card pays 500 Life Points during each of their Standby Phases (this is not optional). Monster Cards that would be returned from the field to the hand are removed from play instead.

6909.name: Senet Switch
6909.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your Main Monster Zone and choose 1 of its unused adjacent (horizontal) Monster Zones; move that target to the chosen adjacent zone.

6910.name: Blasting Fuse
6910.text: If all zones of this card's column are occupied, while this card is Set: Destroy all cards in this column.

6911.name: Straight Flush
6911.text: If your opponent controls a card in each of their Spell & Trap Zones: Destroy all cards in their Spell & Trap Zones.

6912.name: Justi-Break
6912.text: When your opponent's monster declares an attack on your Normal Monster: Destroy all monsters on the field, except Attack Position Normal Monsters.

6913.name: Dimensional Inversion
6913.text: Activate only when a monster(s) you own is removed from play by an opponent's effect. Special Summon 1 of those monsters.

6914.name: Chain Healing
6914.text: Gain 500 Life Points. If this card was activated as Chain Link 2 or 3, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it. If this card was activated as Chain Link 4 or higher, return this card to the hand.

6915.name: Chain Detonation
6915.text: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. If this card was activated as Chain Link 2 or 3, add this card to the Deck and shuffle it. If this card was activated as Chain Link 4 or higher, return this card to the hand.

6916.name: Accumulated Fortune
6916.text: Activate only as Chain Link 4 or higher. Draw 2 cards. You cannot activate this card if multiple cards/effects with the same name are in that Chain.

6917.name: Vanity's Call
6917.text: Activate only as Chain Link 4 or higher. Pay half your Life Points. Negate the activation and effects of all other cards in the same Chain, and destroy them.

6918.name: Black Horn of Heaven
6918.text: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster: Negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy it.

6936.name: Stray Asmodian
6936.text: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, both players gain 800 Life Points.

6937.name: Abaki
6937.text: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by battle, both players take 500 damage.

6938.name: Flame Ogre
6938.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Normal Summoned, draw 1 card.

6960.name: Gene-Warped Warwolf
6960.text: This warwolf was given incalculable strength through horrific genetic manipulation. Its gentle nature was completely wiped out, and it now lives only to unleash destruction.

6961.name: Frostosaurus
6961.text: This monster's metabolism enables it to endure long periods of cold, harnessing the power to become a creature of solid ice! Nothing else can withstand such temperatures, especially victims of its glacial rampage.

6962.name: Spiral Serpent
6962.text: When huge whirlpools lay cities asunder, it is the hunger of this sea serpent at work. No one has ever escaped its dreaded Spiral Wave to accurately describe the terror they experienced.

6963.name: The Six Samurai - Yariza
6963.text: While you control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

6964.name: The Six Samurai - Zanji
6964.text: At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: Destroy the monster this card attacked. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

6965.name: The Six Samurai - Nisashi
6965.text: While you control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name, this card can attack twice during each Battle Phase. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

6966.name: The Six Samurai - Yaichi
6966.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap Card; destroy that target. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. This monster cannot declare an attack during the turn this effect is activated. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

6967.name: The Six Samurai - Kamon
6967.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card; destroy that target. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. This card cannot declare an attack during the turn this effect is activated. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

6968.name: The Six Samurai - Irou
6968.text: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. You must control a face-up "Six Samurai" monster with a different name to activate and to resolve this effect. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy another face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

6969.name: Great Shogun Shien
6969.text: If you control 2 or more face-up "Six Samurai" monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Your opponent can only activate 1 Spell/Trap Card each turn. If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy a face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control instead.

6970.name: Shien's Footsoldier
6970.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Six Samurai" monster from your Deck.

6971.name: Sage of Silence
6971.text: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, your opponent cannot activate Spell Cards during the next turn.

6972.name: Sage of Stillness
6972.text: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the next turn.

6973.name: Reign-Beaux, Overlord of Dark World
6973.text: If this card is discarded from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect: Special Summon this card from the GY. If Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls OR all Spells/Traps they control.

6974.name: Kahkki, Guerilla of Dark World
6974.text: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

6975.name: Gren, Tactician of Dark World
6975.text: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it.

6976.name: Fusion Devourer
6976.text: If this card battles a Fusion Monster, that Fusion Monster's ATK becomes 0 during the Damage Step only.

6977.name: Electric Virus
6977.text: You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 Machine or Dragon monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

6978.name: Puppet Plant
6978.text: You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

6979.name: Marionette Mite
6979.text: You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 Fiend or Zombie monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

6980.name: D.D. Crow
6980.text: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

6981.name: Raging Earth
6981.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-EARTH monsters.

6982.name: Silent Abyss
6982.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-WATER monsters.

6983.name: Firestorm Prominence
6983.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-FIRE monsters.

6984.name: Destruction Cyclone
6984.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-WIND monsters.

6985.name: Umbral Soul
6985.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-DARK monsters.

6986.name: Radiant Spirit
6986.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, destroy all face-down and non-LIGHT monsters.

6987.name: Alien Psychic
6987.text: This card is changed to Defense Position when it is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned. Monsters with A-Counters cannot declare an attack.

6988.name: Elemental HERO Glow Neos
6988.text:
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Return this card to the Extra Deck. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy that target, and if you do, apply this effect based on its type.
●Monster: This card cannot attack this turn.
●Spell: This card can attack directly this turn.
●Trap: Change this card to Defense Position.

6989.name: Elemental HERO Air Neos
6989.text: This card can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck by returning the above cards you control to the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) While your Life Points are lower than your opponent's, this card gains ATK equal to the difference. This card returns to the Extra Deck during the End Phase.

6990.name: Elemental HERO Grand Neos
6990.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Return this card to the Extra Deck.

6991.name: Lycanthrope
6991.text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Synthesis Spell". When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, inflict 200 damage to your opponent for each Normal Monster in your Graveyard.

6992.name: Cú Chulainn the Awakened
6992.text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Emblem of the Awakening". Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 Normal Monster from your Graveyard. This card gains ATK equal to that Normal Monster's ATK, until the Standby Phase of your next turn.

6993.name: Neos Force
6993.text: Equip only to "Elemental HERO Neos". It gains 800 ATK. When it destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster in the Graveyard. During the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Deck.

6994.name: "A" Cell Scatter Burst
6994.text: Select 1 face-up "Alien" monster you control. Destroy it and distribute new A-Counters equal to its Level among your opponent's face-up monsters.

6995.name: Ancient Rules
6995.text: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your hand.

6996.name: Advanced Ritual Art
6996.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon any 1 Ritual Monster. You must also send Normal Monsters from your Deck to the GY whose total Levels equal the Level of that Ritual Monster.

6997.name: Synthesis Spell
6997.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Lycanthrope". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 6 or more from the field or your hand.

6998.name: Emblem of the Awakening
6998.text: This card is used to Ritual Summon "Cú Chulainn the Awakened". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 4 or more from the field or your hand.

6999.name: Twister
6999.text: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

7000.name: Legendary Ebon Steed
7000.text: Equip only to a "Six Samurai" monster. It gains 200 ATK and DEF. If it would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.

7001.name: Card Trader
7001.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck; draw 1 card.

7002.name: Dark World Dealings
7002.text: Each player draws 1 card, then each player discards 1 card.

7003.name: Shien's Castle of Mist
7003.text: When a "Six Samurai" monster is attacked, the attacking monster loses 500 ATK during damage calculation only.

7004.name: Skyscraper 2 - Hero City
7004.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase, if you control this card: You can target 1 "Elemental HERO" monster in your GY that was destroyed by battle and sent there; Special Summon that target.

7005.name: Change of Hero - Reflector Ray
7005.text: When an "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level × 300.

7006.name: Hero Medal
7006.text: When this Set card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect, shuffle this card into its owner's Deck. Then draw 1 card.

7007.name: Return of the Six Samurai
7007.text: Target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. Destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

7008.name: Eliminating the League
7008.text: Discard 1 Spell, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy that target, then look at your opponent's hand and send all cards in their hand with the same name as that destroyed card to the GY.

7009.name: Flashbang
7009.text: Activate only after damage calculation when a monster your opponent controls made a direct attack. It is now the End Phase of this turn.

7010.name: The Transmigration Prophecy
7010.text: Target 2 cards in the GY(s); shuffle those targets into the Deck(s).

7011.name: Anti-Fusion Device
7011.text: Destroy 1 face-up Fusion Monster on the field.

7012.name: Ritual Sealing
7012.text: Destroy 1 face-up Ritual Monster on the field.

7013.name: Birthright
7013.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

7014.name: Swift Samurai Storm!
7014.text: Each turn, after the first time a "Six Samurai" monster you control battles, all "Six Samurai" monsters you control gain 300 ATK until the end of this turn.

7015.name: Cloak and Dagger
7015.text: Declare 1 Monster Card name. If your opponent Normal Summons, Special Summons, or flips that monster(s) face-up, remove that monster(s) and this card from play.

7016.name: Pulling the Rug
7016.text: When a monster effect is activated that activates when a monster is Normal Summoned: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.

7071.name: Crystal Beast Amethyst Cat
7071.text: This card can attack your opponent directly, but when it uses this effect, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is halved. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

7072.name: Crystal Beast Amber Mammoth
7072.text: When another "Crystal Beast" monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can change the attack target to this card. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

7073.name: Crystal Beacon
7073.text: Special Summon 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your Deck. You must have 2 or more "Crystal Beast" cards in your Spell & Trap Zone to activate and to resolve this effect.

7074.name: Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle
7074.text: When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon as many "Crystal Beast" Monster Cards as possible from your Spell & Trap Zones. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

7075.name: Crystal Beast Emerald Tortoise
7075.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster you control that attacked this turn; change that target to Defense Position. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

7076.name: Crystal Beast Topaz Tiger
7076.text: If this card attacks an opponent's monster, it gains 400 ATK during the Damage Step only. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

7077.name: Crystal Beast Cobalt Eagle
7077.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Crystal Beast" card you control; place that target on top of the Deck. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

7078.name: Crystal Beast Sapphire Pegasus
7078.text: When this card is Summoned: You can place 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. If this face-up card is destroyed in a Monster Zone, you can place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, instead of sending it to the GY.

7079.name: Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins
7079.text:
You must have this many "Crystal Beast" cards in your Spell & Trap Zone to activate and to resolve these effects.
●1+: This card cannot be destroyed by card effects.
●2+: Once per turn (including the opponent's) you can halve the battle damage you take.
●3+: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can send 1 "Crystal Beast" monster you control to the GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.
●4+: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can draw 1 card.
●5: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon that target.

7080.name: Rare Value
7080.text: If you control 2 or more "Crystal Beast" cards in your Spell & Trap Zone: Your opponent chooses 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell & Trap Zone, you send it to the GY, and if you do, you draw 2 cards.

7081.name: Last Resort
7081.text: Activate only when your opponent's monster declares an attack. You can select 1 "Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins" from your Deck and activate it. If your opponent had an active Field Spell Card when this card was activated, they can draw 1 card.

7082.name: Volcanic Shell
7082.text: Once per turn: You can pay 500 LP; add 1 "Volcanic Shell" from your Deck to your hand. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

7083.name: Volcanic Scattershot
7083.text: If this card is sent to the GY: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. If this card is sent to the GY by the effect of a "Blaze Accelerator" card: You can send 2 "Volcanic Scattershots" from your hand and/or Deck to the GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

7084.name: Triggered Summon
7084.text: Activate only when a monster is Special Summoned to your opponent's side of the field. Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from their hand.

7085.name: Volcanic Doomfire
7085.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by sending 1 "Tri-Blaze Accelerator" you control to the GY. During your opponent's Battle Phase, all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls that can attack must attack this card. If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each monster destroyed by this effect.

7086.name: Blaze Accelerator
7086.text: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; send 1 Pyro monster with 500 or less ATK from your hand to the GY, and if you do, destroy that target. Your monsters cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

7087.name: Soul of Fire
7087.text: Your opponent draws 1 card. Select 1 Pyro-Type monster from your Deck and remove it from play. Inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK of the removed monster. If you activate this card, you cannot declare an attack this turn.

7088.name: Tri-Blaze Accelerator
7088.text: Activate this card by sending 1 face-up "Blaze Accelerator" you control to the GY. During your Main Phase: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; send 1 Pyro monster from your hand to the GY, and if you do, destroy that target, and if you do that, inflict 500 damage to your opponent. Your monsters cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

7089.name: Wild Fire
7089.text: Pay 500 LP; destroy all "Blaze Accelerator" cards you control, and if you do, destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, then, Special Summon 1 "Wild Fire Token" (Pyro/FIRE/Level 3/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) in Attack Position. Your monsters cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

7090.name: Firewall
7090.text: When your opponent declares a direct attack: You can banish 1 Pyro monster in your GY; negate the attack. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 500 LP or destroy this card.

7096.name: Destiny HERO - Plasma
7096.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters. Negate the effects of face-up monsters while your opponent controls them. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; equip that target to this card (max. 1). Gains ATK equal to half the original ATK of the monster equipped to it by this effect.

7102.name: Volcanic Blaster
7102.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can place 1 "Volcanic" monster from your Deck on top of your Deck.

7103.name: Volcanic Slicer
7103.text: Once per turn, you can inflict 500 damage to your opponent. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

7104.name: Volcanic Hammerer
7104.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to the number of "Volcanic" monsters in your GY x 200. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

7105.name: Elemental HERO Captain Gold
7105.text: You can discard this card to the Graveyard; add 1 "Skyscraper" from your Deck to your hand. If "Skyscraper" is not face-up on the field, destroy this card.

7106.name: Gravekeeper's Commandant
7106.text: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Necrovalley" from your Deck to your hand.

7107.name: Warrior of Atlantis
7107.text: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "A Legendary Ocean" from your Deck to your hand.

7108.name: Destroyersaurus
7108.text: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Jurassic World" from your Deck to your hand.

7109.name: Zeradias, Herald of Heaven
7109.text: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "The Sanctuary in the Sky" from your Deck to your hand. If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is not on the field, destroy this card.

7110.name: Archfiend General
7110.text: You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Pandemonium" from your Deck to your hand. If "Pandemonium" is not on the field, destroy this card.

7111.name: Harpie Queen
7111.text: This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can discard this card to the GY; add 1 "Harpies' Hunting Ground" from your Deck to your hand.

7112.name: Sky Scourge Enrise
7112.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play 3 LIGHT Fairy-Type monsters and 1 DARK Fiend monster in your Graveyard. Once per turn, you can remove from play 1 face-up monster on the field. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

7113.name: Sky Scourge Norleras
7113.text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play 1 LIGHT Fairy-Type monster and 3 DARK Fiend-Type monsters in your Graveyard. You can pay 1000 Life Points to send all cards on the field and in both players' hands to the Graveyard, then you draw 1 card.

7114.name: Sky Scourge Invicil
7114.text:
This card cannot be Special Summoned. If you Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 of the following monsters, this card gets the appropriate effect:
●LIGHT Fairy-Type monster: Negate the effects of all Spell Cards.
●DARK Fiend-Type monster: Negate the effects of all Trap Cards.

7115.name: Goe Goe the Gallant Ninja
7115.text: When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Your opponent must discard 2 random cards. Your opponent must have at least 5 cards in their hand for you to activate and to resolve this effect.

7116.name: Mei-Kou, Master of Barriers
7116.text: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 face-up Continuous Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

7117.name: Raiza the Storm Monarch
7117.text: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; place that target on the top of the Deck.

7118.name: Seismic Crasher
7118.text: Twice per turn, you can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell or Continuous Trap Card you control to the Graveyard to inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

7119.name: Dweller in the Depths
7119.text: Gains 300 ATK for each Continuous Spell in your Spell & Trap Zone.

7120.name: Magna-Slash Dragon
7120.text: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell Card you control to the Graveyard to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls.

7121.name: Gravi-Crush Dragon
7121.text: You can send 1 face-up Continuous Spell Card you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

7122.name: Crystal Blessing
7122.text: Target up to 2 "Crystal Beast" monsters in your GY; place those targets face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells.

7123.name: Crystal Abundance
7123.text: Send 4 "Crystal Beast" cards from your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY; send as many cards on the field as possible to the GY, then Special Summon as many "Crystal Beast" monsters as possible from your GY, up to the number of cards sent from your opponent's field to the GY by this card's effect.

7124.name: Crystal Promise
7124.text: Target 1 "Crystal Beast" card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon that target.

7125.name: Lucky Iron Axe
7125.text: The equipped monster gains 500 ATK. If this face-up card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card effect and sent to your Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

7126.name: Tornado
7126.text: Activate only when there are 3 or more cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone. Destroy 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone.

7127.name: Field Barrier
7127.text: Field Spells on the field cannot be destroyed. Neither player can activate a new Field Spell Card. You can only control 1 "Field Barrier".

7128.name: "A" Cell Breeding Device
7128.text: During each of your Standby Phases, put 1 A-Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.

7129.name: Otherworld - The "A" Zone
7129.text: If your opponent's monster battles an "Alien" monster you control, the opponent's monster loses 300 ATK and DEF during damage calculation only.

7130.name: Crystal Raigeki
7130.text: Send 1 "Crystal Beast" card from your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

7131.name: Volcanic Recharge
7131.text: Return up to 3 "Volcanic" Monster Cards from your Graveyard to your Deck.

7132.name: Terrible Deal
7132.text: Activate only by paying 1000 Life Points when your opponent activates a Spell Card. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

7133.name: Breakthrough!
7133.text: Select 1 "Six Samurai" monster you control. If the selected monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle, "Great Shogun Shien" and all "Six Samurai" monsters you control can attack your opponent directly during the Battle Phase of this turn.

7134.name: Backs to the Wall
7134.text: Pay LP so that you only have 100 left; Special Summon as many "Six Samurai" monsters with different names from your GY as possible. You cannot Special Summon a monster with the same name as a monster you already control.

7135.name: Introduction to Gallantry
7135.text: Activate only when your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand. Your opponent discards 1 random card.

7136.name: Secrets of the Gallant
7136.text: Select 1 Normal Monster you control. When the selected monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent this turn, your opponent discards 2 random cards.

7137.name: Radiant Mirror Force
7137.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they control 3 or more Attack Position monsters: Destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.

7138.name: Hard-sellin' Goblin
7138.text: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, return 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zone to its owner's hand.

7139.name: Hard-sellin' Zombie
7139.text: Each time a monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, select 1 card from your opponent's Graveyard and return it to the bottom of their Deck.

7140.name: Mass Hypnosis
7140.text: Activate only while you control an "Alien" monster. Select and take control of up to 3 of your opponent's monsters that each have an A-Counter(s) on them. This card is destroyed during the End Phase of the turn it is activated.

7141.name: Gem Flash Energy
7141.text: During each of your Standby Phases, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the number of face-up Continuous Spell Cards on the field x 300.

7154.name: Cocoon Party
7154.text: Special Summon 1 "Chrysalis" monster from your Deck for each "Neo-Spacian" monster with a different name in your Graveyard.

7155.name: Chrysalis Chicky
7155.text: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird" from your hand or Deck.

7156.name: Chrysalis Pantail
7156.text: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Dark Panther" from your hand or Deck.

7157.name: Chrysalis Pinny
7157.text: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Glow Moss" from your hand or Deck.

7158.name: Cocoon Veil
7158.text: Activate by Tributing 1 face-up "Chrysalis" monster. This turn, any damage to a player caused by an effect becomes 0. Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster written on the "Chrysalis" monster you Tributed from your hand, Deck or from either player's Graveyard.

7159.name: Convert Contact
7159.text: If you control no monsters: Send 2 "Neo-Spacian" monsters (1 from your hand and 1 from your Deck) to the GY, then draw 2 cards.

7160.name: Hero Counterattack
7160.text: When an "Elemental HERO" monster you control is destroyed by battle: Your opponent chooses and reveals 1 random card from your hand, then, if it is an "Elemental HERO" monster, you destroy 1 monster your opponent controls and Special Summon the chosen monster.

7161.name: Fifth Hope
7161.text: Target 5 "Elemental HERO" cards in your Graveyard; shuffle them into the Deck, then draw 2 cards (draw 3 cards instead, if you had no other cards on your side of the field and in your hand when you activated this card).

7162.name: NEX
7162.text: Send 1 face-up "Neo-Spacian" monster you control to the Graveyard. Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster with the same name from your Extra Deck.

7163.name: Reverse of Neos
7163.text: Activate only when a face-up "Neos" Fusion Monster you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 "Elemental Hero Neos" from your Deck in Attack Position. It gains 1000 ATK and is destroyed during the End Phase of this turn.

7164.name: Venom Swamp
7164.text: During each player's End Phase: Place 1 Venom Counter on each face-up monster, except "Venom" monsters. Monsters lose 500 ATK for each Venom Counter on them. Destroy a monster if its ATK becomes 0 by this effect.

7165.name: Snake Whistle
7165.text: Activate only when a Reptile-Type monster you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Reptile-Type monster from your Deck.

7166.name: Snake Rain
7166.text: Discard 1 card; send 4 Reptile monsters from your Deck to the GY.

7167.name: Damage = Reptile
7167.text: Once per turn, when you take damage from a battle involving a Reptile monster: You can Special Summon 1 Reptile monster from your Deck with ATK less than or equal to the damage you took.

7168.name: Snake Deity's Command
7168.text: Activate by showing your opponent 1 "Venom" monster in your hand. Negate the activation and effect of an opponent's Spell Card, and destroy it.

7169.name: Rise of the Snake Deity
7169.text: When a face-up "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" you control is destroyed, except by battle: Special Summon 1 "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" from your hand or Deck.

7170.name: Mirror Gate
7170.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack targeting a face-up "Elemental HERO" monster you control: Switch control of the opponent's attacking monster with the targeted monster you control, then calculate damage. Control of both monsters switches back during the End Phase.

7171.name: Rainbow Dragon
7171.text:
(This card is always treated as an "Ultimate Crystal" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 7 "Crystal Beast" cards with different names on your field and/or GY. This card cannot activate the following effects the turn it is Special Summoned. (Quick Effect): You can send all "Crystal Beast" monsters you control to the GY; this card gains 1000 ATK for each monster sent to the GY. You can banish all "Crystal Beast" monsters from your GY; shuffle all cards on the field into the Deck.

7172.name: Chrysalis Larva
7172.text: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab" from your hand or Deck.

7173.name: Chrysalis Mole
7173.text: You can Tribute this card while "Neo Space" is on the field to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian Grand Mole" from your hand or Deck.

7174.name: Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin
7174.text: This card's name is also treated as "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin". This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "NEX". Once per turn, you can discard 1 card to look at your opponent's hand and select 1 Monster Card in it. If you control a monster with ATK greater than or equal to the selected monster's, destroy the selected monster and inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

7175.name: Elemental HERO Marine Neos
7175.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Once per turn: You can destroy 1 random card in your opponent's hand.

7176.name: Elemental HERO Darkbright
7176.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card attacks, change it to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step. If this card is destroyed: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

7177.name: Elemental HERO Magma Neos
7177.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) This card gains 400 ATK for each card on the field. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck. If this card is shuffled into the Extra Deck this way: Return all cards on the field to the hand.

7178.name: Necro Gardna
7178.text: During your opponent's turn: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the next attack this turn from a monster your opponent controls (this is a Quick Effect).

7179.name: Ojama Knight
7179.text: Choose up to 2 of your opponent's unused Monster Zones. Those zones cannot be used.

7180.name: Venom Snake
7180.text: Once per turn, you can place 1 Venom Counter on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

7181.name: Venom Boa
7181.text: Once per turn, you can place 2 Venom Counters on 1 monster your opponent controls. If you activate this effect, this card cannot attack during this turn.

7182.name: Venom Serpent
7182.text: Once per turn, you can place 1 Venom Counter on 1 monster your opponent controls.

7183.name: Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes
7183.text: Cannot be Special Summoned by another Effect Monster's effect. Unaffected by "Venom Swamp". Gains 500 ATK for each Reptile monster in your GY. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other Reptile monster from your GY; Special Summon this card.

7184.name: Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes
7184.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Rise of the Snake Deity" or by its own effect. Gains 500 ATK for each Reptile monster in your GY. Neither player can target this card with card effects, also it is unaffected by other cards and their effects. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can banish 1 other Reptile monster from your GY; Special Summon this card. When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Place 1 Hyper-Venom Counter on it. When the 3rd Hyper-Venom Counter is placed on this card, you win the Duel.

7188.name: Ritual Raven
7188.text: If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 DARK Ritual Monster with a card effect that requires use of monsters, this card can be used as the entire requirement.

7189.name: Venom Shot
7189.text: Activate only while you control a face-up "Venom" monster, "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes", or "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes". Send 1 Reptile-Type monster from your Deck to the Graveyard and place 2 Venom Counters on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.

7190.name: Alien Shocktrooper
7190.text: The Aliens have used a mysterious biological substance to create a supreme race of soldiers. They do not have the natural powers of the other Aliens, but can make stunning physical attacks.

7191.name: Volcanic Rat
7191.text: This mutated mouse dwells in the core of active volcanoes. No amount of heat is too much for it to bear.

7192.name: Renge, Gatekeeper of Dark World
7192.text: His renowned athletic physique has made him famous with the populace of Dark World. They call him "Iron Wall Renge" because no one can break through his incredible defenses.

7193.name: Hunter Dragon
7193.text: This dragon has taken down countless prey with its sharp fangs. It strikes very quickly, because if it does not strike first it is vulnerable to a counter-attack.

7194.name: Venom Cobra
7194.text: Hard scales cover all parts of this gigantic cobra. It hunts by shooting out massive amounts of venom, but because of its large size, its attack pattern is easily predicted.

7195.name: Elemental HERO Neos Alius
7195.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
●This card's name becomes "Elemental HERO Neos" while on the field.

7196.name: Chthonian Emperor Dragon
7196.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●This card can attack twice during the same Battle Phase.

7197.name: Aquarian Alessa
7197.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, they discard 1 random card.

7198.name: Lucky Pied Piper
7198.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, draw 1 card.

7199.name: Grasschopper
7199.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

7200.name: Goggle Golem
7200.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●The original ATK of this card becomes 2100.

7201.name: Dawnbreak Gardna
7201.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●The original DEF of this card becomes 2300.

7202.name: Doom Shaman
7202.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
●Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Fiend-Type monster from your hand or from either Graveyard. When this card leaves the field, destroy all Fiend-Type monsters Special Summoned by this effect.

7203.name: King Pyron
7203.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●Once per turn, you can inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

7204.name: Shadow Delver
7204.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●Once per turn, you can select 1 face-up Level 4 or lower DARK monster you control. It can attack your opponent directly this turn.

7205.name: Flint Lock
7205.text: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Flint" in the Spell & Trap Zone; equip it to this card. During your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Flint" equipped to this card, and 1 face-up monster on the field, except this card; equip that "Flint" to that targeted monster. This card can only be equipped with 1 "Flint". While equipped with "Flint", this card is unaffected by the effect of "Flint", and cannot be destroyed by battle.

7206.name: Gravitic Orb
7206.text: FLIP: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

7207.name: Phantom Cricket
7207.text: FLIP: Return 1 face-down monster from the field to the top of its owner's Deck.

7208.name: Crystal Seer
7208.text: FLIP: Excavate the top 2 cards of your Deck, then add 1 of them to your hand, then place the other on the bottom of your Deck.

7209.name: Neo Space Pathfinder
7209.text: You can discard this card to the Graveyard to add 1 "Neo Space" from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

7210.name: Frost and Flame Dragon
7210.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE and 2 WATER monsters from your Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card to target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

7211.name: Desert Twister
7211.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 WIND and 1 EARTH monsters from your GY. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy it.

7212.name: Razor Lizard
7212.text: While you control another Reptile-Type monster, if this card attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without flipping it face-up or applying damage calculation.

7213.name: Light Effigy
7213.text: If you Tribute Summon a LIGHT Normal Monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

7214.name: Dark Effigy
7214.text: If you Tribute Summon a DARK Normal Monster, you can treat this 1 monster as 2 Tributes.

7215.name: Zombie Master
7215.text: Once per turn: You can send 1 monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Zombie monster in either GY; Special Summon that target. This monster must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

7216.name: Cocoon Rebirth
7216.text: You can Tribute 1 face-up "Chrysalis" monster you control to Special Summon 1 "Neo-Spacian" monster written in the card text of that card from either player's Graveyard.

7217.name: Cyberdark Impact!
7217.text: Fusion Summon 1 "Cyberdark Dragon" from your Extra Deck, by shuffling 1 each of "Cyberdark Horn", "Cyberdark Edge", and "Cyberdark Keel" from your hand, field, and/or GY, into the Deck, as Fusion Material.

7218.name: Flint Missile
7218.text: Destroy 1 monster equipped with "Flint". You can return this card to your Deck instead of sending it to the Graveyard after it resolves.

7219.name: Double Summon
7219.text: You can conduct 2 Normal Summons/Sets this turn, not just 1.

7220.name: Summoner's Art
7220.text: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

7221.name: Creature Seizure
7221.text: Each player gives their opponent control of 1 of their monsters (controller's choice). You must choose a face-up Normal Monster.

7222.name: Phalanx Pike
7222.text: The equipped monster gains 900 ATK for each card in either Graveyard that has the same name it does.

7223.name: Symbols of Duty
7223.text: Send 1 Normal Monster you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon it, and if you do, equip this card to it. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

7224.name: Amulet of Ambition
7224.text: Equip only to a Normal Monster. If it battles a monster with a higher Level, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK x the difference in Levels, during that damage calculation only. When this card is sent to the GY: You can place it on top of your Deck.

7226.name: Ambush Fangs
7226.text: Activate only when a face-up "Venom" monster you control is declared as an attack target. Negate the attack and end the Battle Phase. Then place 1 Venom Counter on the monster that attacked.

7227.name: Venom Burn
7227.text: Select 1 monster with a Venom Counter(s). Remove all Venom Counters from that card, and inflict 700 damage to your opponent for each Venom Counter removed.

7228.name: Common Charity
7228.text: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 Normal Monster from your hand, or, if you do not have any in your hand, send your entire hand to the GY.

7229.name: Destructive Draw
7229.text: If either player has no cards in their hand at the start of their Draw Phase, they can draw 1 more card in addition to their normal draw. This card's controller loses 700 Life Points during their End Phase. (If less than 700, they become 0 instead.) When this face-up card is removed from the field, inflict 3000 damage to the player who controlled it.

7230.name: Shield Spear
7230.text: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 400 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

7231.name: Strike Slash
7231.text: When a monster you control declares an attack: Until the End Phase, that monster gains 700 ATK, also, if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

7232.name: Spell Reclamation
7232.text: Discard 1 card and chain this card to a Spell Card you activated. Whenever that Spell Card is sent to the Graveyard, return it to its owner's hand.

7233.name: Trap Reclamation
7233.text: Discard 1 card and chain this card to a Trap Card you activated. Whenever that Trap Card is sent to the Graveyard, return it to its owner's hand.

7236.name: Counter Counter
7236.text: Negate the activation of a Counter Trap Card, and destroy it.

7252.name: Elemental HERO Plasma Vice
7252.text: Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

7254.name: Over Limit
7254.text: Pay 500 Life Points. Special Summon from both players' Graveyards as many Normal Monsters as possible with 1000 or less ATK that were destroyed by battle this turn.

7255.name: Contact Out
7255.text: Return 1 "Neos" Fusion Monster you control to the Extra Deck. If all the Fusion Material Monsters listed on that Fusion Monster are in your Deck, you can Special Summon them.

7256.name: Swing of Memories
7256.text: Target 1 Normal Monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but destroy it during the End Phase of this turn.

7257.name: Evil HERO Inferno Wing
7257.text: Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion". If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the original ATK or DEF (whichever is higher) of that monster in the GY.

7258.name: Evil HERO Malicious Edge
7258.text: If your opponent controls a monster, you can Tribute Summon this card face-up with 1 Tribute. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

7259.name: Evil HERO Infernal Gainer
7259.text: During your Main Phase 1: You can banish this card from the field, then target 1 Fiend monster you control; that target can make a second attack during each Battle Phase while you control it face-up. Once per turn, during your second Standby Phase after this card was banished to activate this effect: Special Summon this card in Attack Position.

7260.name: Evil HERO Lightning Golem
7260.text: Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion". Once per turn: You can target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

7261.name: Evil HERO Dark Gaia
7261.text: Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion". The original ATK of this card becomes the combined original ATK of the materials used for its Fusion Summon. When this card declares an attack: You can change all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls to face-up Attack Position. (Flip effects are not activated at this time.)

7262.name: Dark Fusion
7262.text: Fusion Summon 1 Fiend Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. Your opponent cannot target it with card effects this turn.

7264.name: Cloudian - Eye of the Typhoon
7264.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. If this card declares an attack: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters, except "Cloudian" monsters.

7265.name: Cloudian - Ghost Fog
7265.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. Neither player takes battle damage from attacks involving this card. If this card is destroyed by battle: Distribute Fog Counters equal to the Level of the monster that destroyed it among face-up monsters.

7266.name: Cloudian - Nimbusman
7266.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. You can Tribute any number of WATER monsters for the Tribute Summon of this card. If this card is Tribute Summoned: Place 1 Fog Counter on it for each WATER monster you Tributed. This card gains 500 ATK for each Fog Counter on the field.

7267.name: Cloudian - Sheep Cloud
7267.text: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Special Summon 2 "Cloudian Tokens" (Fairy/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. These Tokens cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, except for "Cloudian" monsters.

7268.name: Cloudian - Poison Cloud
7268.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, if it was face-up at the start of the Damage Step: Destroy the monster that destroyed it, and if you do, inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

7269.name: Diamond-Dust Cyclone
7269.text: Target 1 monster with 4 or more Fog Counters; destroy it, and if you do, draw 1 card for every 4 Fog Counters that was on it.

7270.name: Summon Cloud
7270.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Cloudian" monster from your hand or either GY. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect. If you Special Summon a monster from the GY with this effect, destroy this card.

7271.name: Lucky Cloud
7271.text: During the End Phase, if you Summoned 2 or more "Cloudian" monsters with the same name this turn, draw 2 cards.

7272.name: Natural Disaster
7272.text: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent each time a card(s) they control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by the effect of a "Cloudian" monster.

7273.name: Rain Storm
7273.text:
Target 1 "Cloudian" monster you control; reduce its ATK by exactly 1000 or 2000, and if you do, apply the appropriate effect.
●1000: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls.
●2000: Destroy 2 cards your opponent controls.

7275.name: Elemental HERO Chaos Neos
7275.text:
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. Once per turn, during the End Phase: Shuffle this card into the Extra Deck, and if you do, Set all face-up monsters on the field. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can toss a coin 3 times.
●3 Heads: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
●2 Heads: For the rest of this turn, the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent controls are negated.
●1 Head: Return all monsters you control to the hand.

7276.name: Chamberlain of the Six Samurai
7276.text: The Six Samurai are supported from the shadows by this silent and mysterious warrior. His past is unknown to them, but his countless scars are proof of his experience.

7277.name: Cloudian - Smoke Ball
7277.text: Smoke Balls are newly born Cloudians. They fear being alone, and would rather swing and sway in the sky with their friends.

7278.name: Cloudian - Acid Cloud
7278.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Fog Counter on it for each "Cloudian" monster on the field. You can remove 2 Fog Counters from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

7279.name: Cloudian - Cirrostratus
7279.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Fog Counter on it for each "Cloudian" monster on the field. You can remove 2 Fog Counters from this card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

7280.name: Cloudian - Altus
7280.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Fog Counter on it for each "Cloudian" monster on the field. You can remove 3 Fog Counters from anywhere on the field; discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.

7281.name: Cloudian - Turbulence
7281.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy it. If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Fog Counter on it for each "Cloudian" monster on the field. You can remove 1 Fog Counter from this card; Special Summon 1 "Cloudian - Smoke Ball" from your Deck or either GY.

7282.name: Gladiator Beast Alexander
7282.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of "Gladiator Beast Dimacari". If this card was Special Summoned, it is unaffected by the effects of Spell Cards. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked, you can return it to the Deck to Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Alexander".

7283.name: Gladiator Beast Spartacus
7283.text: This card cannot be Special Summoned except by the effect of "Gladiator Beast Hoplomus". When this card is Special Summoned, add 1 "Gladiator Beast" Equip Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked, you can return it to the Deck to Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Spartacus".

7284.name: Gladiator Beast Murmillo
7284.text: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster: Target 1 face-up monster; destroy that target. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Murmillo".

7285.name: Gladiator Beast Bestiari
7285.text: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Bestiari".

7286.name: Gladiator Beast Laquari
7286.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster, its original ATK becomes 2100. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card battled: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Laquari".

7287.name: Gladiator Beast Hoplomus
7287.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster, its original DEF becomes 2400. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked: You can shuffle it into the Deck; Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Hoplomus".

7288.name: Gladiator Beast Dimacari
7288.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster, it can attack twice during each Battle Phase. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked, you can return it to the Deck to Special Summon 1 "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Dimacari".

7289.name: Gladiator Beast Secutor
7289.text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of a "Gladiator Beast" monster, then at the end of any Battle Phase in which this card attacked or was attacked: Special Summon 2 "Gladiator Beast" monsters from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Secutor".

7290.name: Test Ape
7290.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Gladiator Beast" monster from your Deck.

7291.name: Witch Doctor of Sparta
7291.text: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent each time a monster(s) is Special Summoned from either player's Deck.

7292.name: Infinity Dark
7292.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● When this card declares an attack, you can change the battle position of 1 face-up monster your opponent controls.

7293.name: Magical Reflect Slime
7293.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
●Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card.

7294.name: Ancient Gear Knight
7294.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the GY. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
●If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

7295.name: Goblin Black Ops
7295.text: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

7296.name: Gambler of Legend
7296.text:
Once per turn, you can toss a coin 3 times and apply the appropriate effect:
●3 Heads: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
●2 Heads: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
●1 Head: Destroy 1 card you control.
●3 Tails: Discard your entire hand.

7297.name: Enishi, Shien's Chancellor
7297.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 "Six Samurai" monsters from your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster; destroy that target. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

7298.name: Spirit of the Six Samurai
7298.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK and DEF. If the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Draw 1 card. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

7299.name: Alien Telepath
7299.text: Once per turn, you can remove 1 A-Counter from an opponent's monster to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card. (If a monster with an A-Counter battles an "Alien" monster, it loses 300 ATK and DEF for each A-Counter during damage calculation only.)

7300.name: Alien Hypno
7300.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● During your Main Phase, you can select 1 monster your opponent controls with an A-Counter(s), and take control of it while this card is on the field. During each of your End Phases, remove 1 A-Counter from each controlled monster. If all A-Counters are removed from one of these monsters, destroy it.

7301.name: Superalloy Beast Raptinus
7301.text: All Gemini Monsters on the field are treated as Effect Monsters, and gain their effects.

7302.name: Gladiator Beast Gaiodiaz
7302.text: This card can only be Special Summoned from your Extra Deck, by returning the above cards you control to the Deck. (You do not use "Polymerization".) When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the DEF of the destroyed monster. At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card attacked or was attacked, you can return it to the Extra Deck to Special Summon 2 "Gladiator Beast" monsters from your Deck, except "Gladiator Beast Spartacus".

7303.name: Gladiator Beast Heraklinos
7303.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards you control into the Deck. When a Spell/Trap Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

7304.name: Fog Control
7304.text: Tribute 1 face-up "Cloudian" monster, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; place 3 Fog Counters on that target.

7305.name: Cloudian Squall
7305.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Place 1 Fog Counter on each face-up monster on the field.

7306.name: Super Double Summon
7306.text: Select 1 Gemini monster you control and Normal Summon it. During the End Phase of this turn, return it to your hand.

7307.name: Colosseum - Cage of the Gladiator Beasts
7307.text: Place 1 Counter on this card each time a monster is Special Summoned from either player's Deck. All "Gladiator Beast" monsters gain 100 ATK and DEF for each of these counters on this card. If this card would be destroyed by a card effect, you can discard 1 "Colosseum - Cage of the Gladiator Beasts" to prevent this card from being destroyed.

7308.name: Gladiator Beast's Battle Halberd
7308.text: Equip only to a "Gladiator Beast" monster. When it attacks, destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card at the end of the Damage Step. When the equipped monster is returned from your side of the field to the Deck and this card is sent to the Graveyard, return this card to your hand.

7309.name: Gladiator Beast's Battle Gladius
7309.text: Equip only to a "Gladiator Beast" monster. It gains 300 ATK. When the equipped monster is returned from your side of the field to the Deck and this card is sent to the Graveyard, return this card to your hand.

7310.name: Gladiator Beast's Battle Manica
7310.text: Equip only to a "Gladiator Beast" monster. It cannot be destroyed by battle (Damage calculation is applied normally). When the equipped monster is returned from your side of the field to the Deck and this card is sent to the Graveyard, return this card to your hand.

7311.name: Gladiator Beast's Respite
7311.text: Shuffle 2 "Gladiator Beast" cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw 3 cards.

7312.name: Gladiator's Return
7312.text: Target 3 "Gladiator Beast" cards in your Graveyard; shuffle all 3 targets into the Deck, then draw 1 card.

7313.name: Soul Devouring Bamboo Sword
7313.text: Select 1 monster equipped with a "Bamboo Sword" Equip Spell Card. If it inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent while equipped with a "Bamboo Sword" card, they skip their next Draw Phase. Destroy this card during your second Standby Phase after activation.

7314.name: Cunning of the Six Samurai
7314.text: Send 1 face-up "Six Samurai" monster you control to the Graveyard, then target 1 "Six Samurai" monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

7315.name: "A" Cell Incubator
7315.text: Each time an A-Counter(s) is removed from play by a card effect, place 1 A-Counter on this card. When this card is destroyed, distribute the A-Counters on this card among face-up monsters.

7316.name: Updraft
7316.text: Remove all Fog Counters from the field. Inflict 300 damage to your opponent for each Fog Counter you removed.

7317.name: Release from Stone
7317.text: Target 1 of your banished Rock monsters; Special Summon it. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

7318.name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
7318.text: Negate all LIGHT monster effects activated on the field or in the GY.

7319.name: Shadow-Imprisoning Mirror
7319.text: Negate all DARK monster effects activated on the field or in the GY.

7320.name: Disarm
7320.text: Return 1 "Gladiator Beast" card from your hand to the Deck, and negate the activation and effect of a Spell Card, and destroy it.

7321.name: Parry
7321.text: Return 1 "Gladiator Beast" card from your hand to the Deck, and negate the activation and effect of a Trap Card, and destroy it.

7322.name: Swiftstrike Armor
7322.text: During your Draw Phase, each time you draw a "Six Samurai" Monster Card(s): You can reveal it; Special Summon it.

7323.name: Double-Edged Sword Technique
7323.text: Target 2 "Six Samurai" monsters in your GY; Special Summon those targets in Attack Position. During the End Phase of this turn, destroy them, and if you do, take damage equal to those destroyed monsters' ATK.

7324.name: Energy-Absorbing Monolith
7324.text: Chain this card to an opponent's card effect that would inflict damage to you. That damage is negated, and you gain Life Points equal to the amount you would have taken.

7325.name: Cell Explosion Virus
7325.text: Activate only when an opponent's monster with an A-Counter(s) declares an attack. Destroy all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.

7326.name: Detonator Circle "A"
7326.text: Destroy 1 face-up monster with an A-Counter(s), and then inflict 1000 damage to each player.

7327.name: Interdimensional Warp
7327.text: Select a monster you control and a monster with an A-Counter(s) your opponent controls. Switch control of those monsters.

7328.name: Foolish Revival
7328.text: Select 1 monster from your opponent's Graveyard, and Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position on your opponent's side of the field.

7329.name: An Unfortunate Report
7329.text: Your opponent conducts their next Battle Phase twice.

7342.name: Armityle the Chaos Phantasm (Updated from: Armityle the Chaos Phantom)
7342.text: Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. (You do not use "Polymerization".) Cannot be destroyed by battle. Gains 10,000 ATK during your turn only.

7365.name: Gladiator Beast Andal
7365.text: This one-eyed warrior bear is an aggressive hunter that strikes down its prey with the powerful swipes of its claws. No one can bear the brunt of his tremendously fast and heavy blows.

7366.name: Atlantean Pikeman
7366.text: The Great Ocean Lord, who reigns over the depths, is served by these lancers. Deep-sea creatures exist in fear of facing the stream of attacks their lances are capable of.

7367.name: Earth Effigy
7367.text: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an EARTH Normal Monster.

7368.name: Wind Effigy
7368.text: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WIND Normal Monster.

7369.name: Gemini Lancer
7369.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
●During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent.

7370.name: Imprisoned Queen Archfiend
7370.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, you must pay 1000 LP (this is not optional), or this card is destroyed. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Target 1 Level 4 or lower Fiend monster on the field; that target gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. "Pandemonium" must be on the field and this card must be in your GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

7378.name: Evil HERO Wild Cyclone
7378.text: Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion". If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Destroy all Set Spells/Traps your opponent controls.

7379.name: Evil HERO Infernal Sniper
7379.text: Must be Special Summoned with "Dark Fusion". Cannot be destroyed by Spell effects. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. This card must be in face-up Defense Position to activate and to resolve this effect.

7406.name: Rainbow Dark Dragon
7406.text:
(This card is always treated as an "Ultimate Crystal" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 7 DARK monsters with different names from your GY. You can banish all other DARK monsters from your field and GY; this card gains 500 ATK for each card banished this way.

7407.name: Samsara Lotus
7407.text: During your End Phase, if you control no Spell or Trap Cards, you can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard in face-up Attack Position. This card's controller takes 1000 damage during each of their Standby Phases.

7408.name: Regenerating Rose
7408.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon 2 "Regenerating Rose Tokens" (Plant-Type/DARK/Level 3/ATK 1200/DEF 1200).

7409.name: Yubel
7409.text: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no battle damage from battles involving this card. Before damage calculation, if this face-up Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that attacking monster's ATK. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Tribute 1 other monster or destroy this card. When this card is destroyed, except by its own effect: Its owner can Special Summon 1 "Yubel - Terror Incarnate" from their hand, Deck, or GY.

7410.name: Yubel - Terror Incarnate
7410.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Yubel". Cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no battle damage from battles involving this card. Before damage calculation, if this face-up Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that attacking monster's ATK. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Destroy all other monsters on the field. When this face-up card leaves the field: You can Special Summon 1 "Yubel - The Ultimate Nightmare" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

7411.name: Yubel - The Ultimate Nightmare
7411.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned by "Yubel - Terror Incarnate". Cannot be destroyed by battle. You take no battle damage from battles involving this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this face-up Attack Position card battled an opponent's monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that opponent's monster's ATK, also destroy that monster.

7412.name: Armored Cybern
7412.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "Cyber Dragon" you control, or 1 Fusion Monster you control that lists "Cyber Dragon" as Fusion Material; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. Once per turn, while equipped to a monster by this effect: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; the equipped monster loses exactly 1000 ATK (even if this card leaves the field), and if it does, destroy that target. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

7413.name: Cyber Valley
7413.text:
You can activate 1 of these effects.
●When this card is targeted for an attack: You can banish this card; draw 1 card, then end the Battle Phase.
●You can target 1 face-up monster you control and this card; banish both those targets, then draw 2 cards.
●You can target 1 card in your GY; banish both this card and 1 card from your hand, then place that target on top of the Deck.

7414.name: Cyber Ouroboros
7414.text: When this card is removed from play, you can send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard to draw 1 card.

7415.name: Volcanic Counter
7415.text: When you take battle damage while this card is in your Graveyard: Banish it from your Graveyard, then if there is a FIRE monster other than "Volcanic Counter" in your Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the amount of battle damage you took.

7416.name: Destiny HERO - Dunker
7416.text: You can send 1 "Destiny HERO" card from your hand to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

7417.name: Destiny HERO - Departed
7417.text: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position to your opponent's side of the field. If this card is destroyed by battle, banish it instead of sending it to the Graveyard. If a card effect would send this card to the Graveyard from the hand or Deck, banish it instead.

7418.name: Dark Horus
7418.text: Once per turn, after resolving a Spell Card that was activated during your opponent's Main Phase: You can target 1 Level 4 DARK monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

7419.name: The Dark Creator
7419.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 5 or more DARK monsters in your Graveyard while you control no monsters. Once per turn: You can banish 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard to target 1 DARK monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

7420.name: Dark Nephthys
7420.text: If you have 3 or more DARK monsters in your Graveyard and this card in your hand: You can banish 2 of them from your Graveyard; send this card from your hand to the Graveyard. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent to the Graveyard by this effect: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When this card is Special Summoned: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

7421.name: Dark Armed Dragon
7421.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 3 DARK monsters in your GY. You can banish 1 DARK monster from your GY, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

7422.name: Dark Crusader
7422.text: You can send 1 DARK monster from your hand to the Graveyard; this card gains 400 ATK.

7423.name: Armageddon Knight
7423.text: When this card is Summoned: You can send 1 DARK monster from your Deck to the GY.

7424.name: Doomsday Horror
7424.text: This card's ATK and DEF are equal to the number of banished DARK monsters x 300. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Return all banished DARK monsters to the Graveyards.

7425.name: Obsidian Dragon
7425.text: Negate any Spell/Trap effects that target exactly 1 DARK monster you control (and no other cards), and if you do, destroy them.

7426.name: Shadowpriestess of Ohm
