9740.text: You can target 1 face-up "Wind-Up" monster you control; increase its Level by 1 and its ATK by 600, until the End Phase. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

9741.name: Wind-Up Knight
9741.text: When a face-up "Wind-Up" monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can negate the attack. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

9742.name: Wind-Up Hunter
9742.text: You can Tribute 1 face-up "Wind-Up" monster, except "Wind-Up Hunter"; send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

9743.name: Wind-Up Bat
9743.text: You can target 1 "Wind-Up" monster in your Graveyard; change this face-up Attack Position card you control to face-up Defense Position, and add that target to your hand. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

9744.name: Wind-Up Kitten
9744.text: Once while face-up on the field: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

9745.name: D.D. Telepon
9745.text: If this face-up card you control is banished: You can banish 1 Psychic-Type monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck. Then, during your next Standby Phase, if this card is still banished: Special Summon that monster banished by this effect.

9747.name: Naturia Marron

9748.name: Prior of the Ice Barrier
9748.text: If you control an "Ice Barrier" monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You cannot Special Summon any Level 5 or higher monsters the turn you Summon this way. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 "Ice Barrier" monster in your GY, except "Prior of the Ice Barrier"; Special Summon that target.

9749.name: Senior Silver Ninja
9749.text: When this card is flipped face-up: You can Special Summon any number of "Ninja" monsters, except "Senior Silver Ninja", from your hand and/or Graveyard in face-down Defense Position. There can only be 1 face-up "Senior Silver Ninja" on the field.

9750.name: Rodenut
9750.text: Each time your opponent Special Summons a monster(s), place 1 Nut Counter on this card. You can remove 1 Nut Counter from this card to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

9751.name: Fenghuang
9751.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Destroy all Set Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls.

9752.name: Tribe-Shocking Virus
9752.text: Once per turn: You can banish 1 monster from your hand; destroy all face-up monsters on the field with the same Type as that monster.

9753.name: Goblin Pothole Squad
9753.text: When this card is Normal Summoned, Trap Cards cannot be activated. Also, "Trap Hole" Trap Cards cannot be activated when a monster is Summoned, except "Dark Trap Hole".

9754.name: Creepy Coney
9754.text: FLIP: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent for each face-up Normal Monster you control, except Tokens.

9755.name: Rescue Rabbit
9755.text: Cannot be Special Summoned from the Deck. You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower Normal Monsters with the same name from your Deck, but destroy them during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Rescue Rabbit" once per turn.

9756.name: Baby Tiragon
9756.text:
3 Level 1 monsters
During your Main Phase 1: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, then target 1 Level 1 monster you control; it can attack your opponent directly.

9757.name: Number 83: Galaxy Queen
9757.text:
3 Level 1 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; until the opponent's next End Phase, the monsters you currently control cannot be destroyed by battle, and if they attack a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

9758.name: Black Ray Lancer
9758.text:
2 Level 3 WATER monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 face-up monster on the field; negate that target's effects until the End Phase.

9759.name: Number 10: Illumiknight
9759.text:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; send 1 card from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, draw 1 card.

9760.name: Number 20: Giga-Brilliant
9760.text:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; all monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK.

9761.name: Evolzar Laggia

2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters
When a monster(s) would be Normal or Special Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can detach 2 materials from this card; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy it.

9762.name: Thunder End Dragon
9762.text:
2 Level 8 Normal Monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; destroy all other monsters on the field.

9763.name: Attraffic Control
9763.text: If your opponent controls 3 or more monsters, they cannot declare an attack.

9764.name: Ego Boost
9764.text: When a monster declares an attack: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase.

9765.name: Monster Slots
9765.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control and 1 monster in your Graveyard with the same Level; banish the target from the Graveyard, then draw 1 card and reveal it, then if the card you drew is a monster with the same Level as the monster on the field, Special Summon it.

9766.name: Cross Attack
9766.text: Target 2 face-up Attack Position monsters you control with the same ATK; this turn, one of them can attack your opponent directly and the other cannot attack.

9767.name: Xyz Gift
9767.text: If you control 2 or more face-up Xyz Monsters: Detach 2 Xyz Materials from a monster you control and draw 2 cards.

9768.name: Photon Veil
9768.text: Shuffle 3 LIGHT monsters from your hand into the Deck, then add 1 to 3 Level 4 or lower LIGHT monsters from your Deck to your hand. If you add 2 or more monsters, they must have the same name.

9769.name: Photon Lead
9769.text: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT monster from your hand in face-up Attack Position.

9770.name: Photon Booster
9770.text: Target 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT monster on the field, except a Token; the ATK of all monsters currently on the field with its name become 2000, until the end of this turn.

9771.name: Evo-Karma
9771.text: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster you control, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects.

9772.name: Evo-Miracle
9772.text: Target 1 monster that was Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster; this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects.

9773.name: Zenmailfunction
9773.text: Target 1 "Wind-Up" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position. Its effect(s) is negated, and it cannot be Tributed or used as a Synchro Material Monster.

9774.name: Extra Gate
9774.text: Declare a Level between 1 and 12; your opponent banishes 1 monster of that Level from their Extra Deck. If your opponent does not have a monster of that Level in their Extra Deck, you discard 1 card.

9775.name: Shard of Greed
9775.text: Each time you draw a card(s) for your normal draw in your Draw Phase, place 1 Greed Counter on this card. You can send this card with 2 or more Greed Counters to the GY; draw 2 cards.

9776.name: Murmur of the Forest
9776.text: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-down Defense Position, then you can return all Field Spell Cards on the field to the hand.

9777.name: Tri-Wight
9777.text: Target 3 Level 2 or lower Normal Monsters in your GY; Special Summon them.

9778.name: One Day of Peace
9778.text: Each player draws 1 card, and neither player takes damage until the end of the opponent's next turn.

9779.name: Space Cyclone
9779.text: Detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster.

9780.name: Poisonous Winds
9780.text: WIND monsters cannot be Special Summoned. All face-up WIND monsters on the field lose 500 ATK.

9781.name: Heartfelt Appeal
9781.text: When you take battle damage from your opponent's direct attack: Take control of the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the highest DEF, until your next End Phase. (If it's a tie, you get to choose.) Its effects are negated, also it cannot declare an attack.

9782.name: Fiery Fervor
9782.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. If your opponent controls a monster with ATK higher than that same monster's original ATK, the ATK of the equipped monster becomes double the equipped monster's original ATK, during the Damage Step only.

9783.name: Damage Diet
9783.text: Halve all damage you take this turn. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; halve all effect damage you take this turn. (You cannot halve the same damage twice with this effect.)

9784.name: Copy Knight
9784.text: When a Level 4 or lower Warrior monster is Normal Summoned to your field: Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster with the same name and Level as the Normal Summoned monster (Warrior/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0). (This card is also still a Trap.)

9785.name: Mirror Mail
9785.text: When a face-up monster you control is targeted for an attack: Its ATK becomes equal to that of the attacking monster.

9786.name: Fish Rain
9786.text: When a face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster on the field is banished: Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster from your hand. (The banished monster(s) must be Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type even after being banished.)

9787.name: Icy Crevasse
9787.text: When exactly 1 monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard by an opponent's card effect: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; send that target to the Graveyard, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK in the Graveyard.

9788.name: Lumenize
9788.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and 1 face-up LIGHT monster you control gains ATK equal to that target's ATK, until your next End Phase.

9789.name: Evolutionary Bridge
9789.text: When a monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target 1 "Evoltile" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target, then switch the attack target to that monster and conduct damage calculation.

9790.name: Zenmairch
9790.text: Target 1 face-up Level 4 or lower "Wind-Up" monster you control: Return that target to the hand (no matter its Level), then Special Summon 1 "Wind-Up" monster from the hand with the same Level as the returned monster's.

9791.name: Wattcancel
9791.text: When your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s): Discard 1 "Watt" monster; negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s).

9792.name: Champion's Vigilance
9792.text: If you control a Level 7 or higher Normal Monster, when a monster(s) would be Summoned OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

9793.name: Darklight
9793.text: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 1500 or more ATK; destroy all monsters that were Special Summoned this turn.

9794.name: Tyrant's Throes
9794.text: Activate by Tributing 2 Normal Monsters (except Tokens). Neither player can Normal or Special Summon Effect Monsters.

9795.name: Sound the Retreat!
9795.text: Return all monsters you control to the hand.

9796.name: Deep Dark Trap Hole
9796.text: When a Level 5 or higher Effect Monster(s) is Special Summoned: Banish that Level 5 or higher Effect Monster(s).

9797.name: Eisbahn
9797.text: If a non-WATER monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned while you control a WATER monster: Change that Summoned monster to Defense Position.

9798.name: Sealing Ceremony of Suiton
9798.text: Once per turn: You can send 1 WATER monster from your hand to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

9875.name: Kurivolt
9875.text: You can target 1 Xyz Monster that has material; detach 1 material from it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Kurivolt" from your Deck. Cannot be used as Synchro Material.

9876.name: Darklon
9876.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can have all face-up monsters you currently control gain 1 Level, also, they become DARK (these effects last until the End Phase).

9877.name: Gagaga Girl
9877.text:
You can target 1 "Gagaga Magician" you control; this card's Level becomes the current Level of that monster. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using only this card and other "Gagaga" monsters as material gains this effect.
●When it is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls; its ATK becomes 0.

9878.name: Gogogo Giant
9878.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 "Gogogo" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, then change this card to Defense Position. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase.

9879.name: ZW - Unicorn Spear
9879.text: You can target 1 "Number C39: Utopia Ray" you control; equip this card from your hand to that target. It gains 1900 ATK. If the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster, the opponent's monster's effect is negated during the Battle Phase only. You can only control 1 "ZW - Unicorn Spear".

9880.name: Shocktopus
9880.text: When this card is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster and sent to the Graveyard: You can equip this card to that opponent's monster. That monster's ATK becomes 0, also it cannot change its battle position.

9881.name: Photon Lizard
9881.text: You can Tribute this card; add 1 Level 4 or lower "Photon" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Photon Lizard" once per turn.

9882.name: Photon Thrasher
9882.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) while you control no monsters. Cannot attack if you control another monster.

9883.name: Photon Crusher
9883.text: If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

9884.name: Photon Leo
9884.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can have your opponent shuffle their entire hand into the Deck, then they draw the same number of cards as they shuffled into the Deck.

9885.name: Photon Circle
9885.text: Any Battle Damage you take from battles involving this card is halved.

9886.name: Reverse Buster

If this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster, at the start of the Damage Step: You can destroy that face-down monster.

9887.name: Flame Armor Ninja
9887.text: When this card is Summoned: You can target 1 "Ninja" monster you control; increase its Level by 1.

9888.name: Air Armor Ninja

9889.name: Aqua Armor Ninja
9889.text: When your opponent's monster declares a direct attack, if you have another "Ninja" monster in your Graveyard: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target the attacking monster; negate that attack.

9890.name: Earth Armor Ninja
9890.text: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

9891.name: Inzektor Hornet

While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's Level is increased by 3, also it gains ATK/DEF equal to this card's ATK/DEF. While this card is equipped to a monster: You can send this Equip Card to the GY, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

9892.name: Inzektor Ant
9892.text: Once per turn: You can equip 1 "Inzektor" monster from your hand or Graveyard to this card. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's Level is increased by 3, also it gains ATK and DEF equal to this card's ATK and DEF. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, you can destroy this Equip Card instead.

9893.name: Inzektor Centipede
9893.text: Once per turn: You can equip 1 "Inzektor" monster from your hand or GY to this card. If an Equip Card(s) is sent to your GY while equipped to this card (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Inzektor" card from your Deck to your hand. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's Level is increased by 3.

9894.name: Inzektor Dragonfly
9894.text: Once per turn: You can equip 1 "Inzektor" monster from your hand or GY to this card. If an Equip Card(s) is sent to your GY while equipped to this card (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 "Inzektor" monster from your Deck, except "Inzektor Dragonfly". While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's Level is increased by 3.

9895.name: Inzektor Giga-Mantis
9895.text: You can target 1 face-up "Inzektor" monster you control; equip this card from your hand to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's original ATK becomes 2400. If this card is sent to the GY while equipped to a monster: You can target 1 "Inzektor" monster in your GY except "Inzektor Giga-Mantis"; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Inzektor Giga-Mantis" once per turn.

9896.name: Inzektor Giga-Weevil
9896.text: You can target 1 face-up "Inzektor" monster you control; equip this card from your hand to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's original DEF becomes 2600. If this card is sent to the Graveyard while equipped to a monster: You can target 1 "Inzektor" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target. This effect of "Inzektor Giga-Weevil" can only be used once per turn.

9897.name: Wind-Up Rat
9897.text: During your Main Phase: You can target 1 "Wind-Up" monster in your Graveyard; change this face-up Attack Position card you control to face-up Defense Position, and Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

9898.name: Wind-Up Honeybee
9898.text: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Wind-Up" monster from your Deck.

9899.name: Evoltile Pleuro
9899.text: If this card you control is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Evolsaur" monster from your hand.

9900.name: Evoltile Casinerio
9900.text: At the end of the Battle Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 2 Level 6 or lower FIRE Dinosaur-Type monsters with the same name from your Deck. Their effects are negated and they are banished during the End Phase.

9901.name: Evolsaur Elias
9901.text: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster: You can Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower FIRE Dinosaur-Type monster from your hand.

9902.name: Evolsaur Terias
9902.text: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster: This card loses 500 ATK.

9903.name: Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo
9903.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Ninjitsu Art" card from your Deck to your hand. When this card is Flip or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Ninja" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo".

9904.name: Masked Ninja Ebisu
9904.text: Once per turn, if you control a "Ninja" monster other than "Masked Ninja Ebisu": You can activate this effect; return Spells/Traps your opponent controls to the hand, equal to the number of "Ninja" monsters you control, also each of your "Goe Goe the Gallant Ninja" can attack directly this turn.

9905.name: Upstart Golden Ninja
9905.text: Once per turn: You can send 1 Trap from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Ninja" monster from your Deck in face-up Defense Position or face-down Defense Position.

9906.name: Chow Len the Prophet
9906.text: Once per turn: You can declare either Spell or Trap, then target 1 Set card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone; look at that target, and if it is the declared card type, that card cannot be activated this turn.

9907.name: Familiar-Possessed - Dharc
9907.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Dharc the Dark Charmer" you control and 1 face-up DARK monster you control to the Graveyard. When you do: You can add 1 Level 3 or 4 LIGHT Spellcaster-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card was Special Summoned by this effect and attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

9908.name: Dark Blade the Captain of the Evil World
9908.text: Once per turn: You can banish 1 DARK monster from your Graveyard to target 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT monster your opponent controls; equip it to this card. (You can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card with this effect.) If this card on the field would be destroyed, the monster equipped to it with this effect is destroyed, instead.

9909.name: Trance Archfiend
9909.text: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Fiend-Type monster, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn. When this card you control is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard: You can target 1 of your banished DARK monsters; add that target to your hand.

9910.name: Divine Dragon Apocralyph
9910.text: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

9911.name: Darkstorm Dragon
9911.text:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is a Normal Monster on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it become an Effect Monster with this effect.
●Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card you control to the Graveyard; destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

9912.name: Numen erat Testudo
9912.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters with 1800 or less ATK.

9913.name: Twin Photon Lizard
9913.text: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon, from your Graveyard, both of the Fusion Material Monsters used for the Fusion Summon of this card.

9914.name: Number C39: Utopia Ray
9914.text:
3 Level 4 LIGHT monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a "Number 39: Utopia" you control as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) You can detach 1 material from this card; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn, and if it does, 1 monster your opponent controls loses 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. You must have 1000 LP or less to activate and to resolve this effect.

9915.name: Blade Armor Ninja
9915.text:
2 Level 4 Warrior-Type monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 "Ninja" monster you control; it can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

9916.name: Number 12: Crimson Shadow Armor Ninja
9916.text:
2 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; this turn, face-up "Ninja" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects.

9917.name: Number 96: Dark Mist
9917.text:
3 Level 2 monsters
Once per battle, when an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's monster (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; halve the ATK of the opponent's monster, and if you do, this card gains that same amount of ATK.

9918.name: Wind-Up Carrier Zenmaity
9918.text:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Wind-Up" monster from your hand or Deck. When a face-up "Wind-Up" monster on the field is destroyed and sent to your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target that monster; return that target to the hand.

9919.name: Evolzar Solda
9919.text:
2 Level 6 Dinosaur monsters
Cannot be destroyed by card effects while it has material. When your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 material from this card; destroy that monster(s).

9920.name: Inzektor Exa-Beetle
9920.text:
2 Level 6 monsters
When this card is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 monster in either GY; equip that target to this card. This card gains ATK/DEF equal to half the original ATK/DEF of the monster equipped by this effect. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up card on each field; send those targets to the GY.

9921.name: Full-Force Strike
9921.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; this turn, it cannot be destroyed by battle, players take no battle damage from its attacks, and if it attacks an opponent's monster, destroy that opponent's monster after damage calculation.

9922.name: Gagagabolt
9922.text: If you control a "Gagaga" monster: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

9923.name: Double Defender
9923.text: Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack while you control 2 or more face-up Defense Position monsters: You can target the attacking monster; negate that attack.

9924.name: Galaxy Storm
9924.text: Target 1 face-up Xyz Monster on the field that has no Xyz Material; destroy that target.

9925.name: Armor Ninjitsu Art of Alchemy
9925.text: If you control a "Ninjitsu Art" card: Destroy as many other "Ninjitsu Art" cards you control as possible, then draw 2 cards.

9926.name: Star Light, Star Bright
9926.text: Target 1 face-up monster you control; all face-up monsters you currently control with an ATK or DEF equal to that monster's become the same Level as that monster, until the End Phase.

9927.name: Armor Blast
9927.text: Target 1 face-up "Inzektor" card you control and 2 face-up cards your opponent controls; destroy them.

9928.name: Inzektor Sword - Zektkaliber
9928.text: Equip only to an "Inzektor" monster. It gains 800 ATK/DEF. If this face-up card on the field is sent to the GY: Target 1 "Inzektor" monster in your GY; add that target to your hand.

9929.name: Weights & Zenmaisures
9929.text: Target 2 face-up "Wind-Up" monsters you control with different Levels; your opponent chooses 1 of them, and the Level of the other monster becomes the same as the chosen monster's, until the End Phase. Then, if your opponent chose the monster with a lower Level, you can draw 1 card.

9930.name: Primordial Soup
9930.text: Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can shuffle up to 2 "Evolsaur" monsters from your hand into the Deck, then draw the same number of cards. You can only control 1 face-up "Primordial Soup".

9931.name: Evo-Force
9931.text: Tribute 1 "Evoltile" monster; Special Summon 1 "Evolsaur" monster from your Deck. (This is treated as a Special Summon by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster.)

9932.name: Dark Mambele
9932.text: If you control 3 or more DARK monsters: Target 1 face-up card on the field; banish that target.

9933.name: Creeping Darkness
9933.text: Banish 2 DARK monsters from your GY; add 1 Level 4 DARK monster from your Deck to your hand.

9934.name: Shrine of Mist Valley
9934.text: Once per turn, when a WIND monster(s) is destroyed by a card effect and sent to your Graveyard (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower WIND monster from your hand or Deck. Its effects are negated.

9935.name: Xyz Burst
9935.text: If you control a Rank 6 or higher Xyz Monster: Destroy all Set cards your opponent controls.

9936.name: Galaxy Wave
9936.text: Each time you Xyz Summon: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

9937.name: Dicephoon
9937.text:
Roll a six-sided die and apply the result.
●2, 3, or 4: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap on the field.
●5: Destroy 2 Spells/Traps on the field.
●1 or 6: You take 1000 damage.

9938.name: Counterforce
9938.text: When a monster's attack is negated that targeted a face-up Attack Position monster: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the difference in ATK between the 2 monsters.

9939.name: Gagagaguard
9939.text: If you control 2 or more face-up "Gagaga" monsters: This turn, monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or by card effects.

9940.name: Xyz Reflect
9940.text: When a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect is activated that targets a face-up Xyz Monster(s) on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

9941.name: Splash Capture
9941.text: When your opponent Xyz Summons: Banish 2 Fish-Type monsters from your Graveyard to target that face-up Xyz Monster; take control of that target.

9942.name: Armor Ninjitsu Art of Freezing
9942.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack, if you control a "Ninja" monster: You can flip this card face-up; negate that attack and end the Battle Phase. While this card is face-up on the field and you control a "Ninja" monster, monsters your opponent controls cannot change their battle positions.

9943.name: Armor Ninjitsu Art of Rust Mist
9943.text: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field, if you control a "Ninja" monster: Halve the current ATK of that Special Summoned monster(s).

9944.name: Inzektor Orb
9944.text: Target 1 face-up "Inzektor" monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK and DEF. When exactly 1 "Inzektor" monster you control is targeted by a card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can send this Equip Card to the Graveyard; negate that effect.

9945.name: Variable Form
9945.text:
Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.
●Target 2 face-up "Inzektor" monsters you control; equip one to the other.
●Target 1 "Inzektor" monster you control that is an Equip Card; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position.

9946.name: Zenmailstrom
9946.text: Tribute 1 "Wind-Up" monster with 1500 or more ATK; Special Summon 1 "Wind-Up" monster from your hand, then you can Special Summon 1 "Wind-Up" monster from your Deck with the same ATK as the monster Special Summoned by this effect.

9947.name: Degen-Force
9947.text: Tribute 1 Level 4 or higher Dinosaur-Type monster; Special Summon 2 Level 3 or lower Reptile-Type monsters from your hand and/or Graveyard.

9948.name: Evo-Branch
9948.text: Target 1 face-up Reptile-Type monster you control; destroy it and Special Summon 1 "Evoltile" monster in face-down Defense Position from your Deck.

9949.name: Ninjitsu Art of Super-Transformation
9949.text: Activate this card by targeting 1 "Ninja" monster you control and 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; send them to the GY, then Special Summon 1 Dragon, Dinosaur, or Sea Serpent monster from your Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the combined original Levels of the sent monster(s). When this card leaves the field, banish that monster.

9950.name: Xyz Reborn
9950.text: Target 1 Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it, and if you do, attach this card to it as material.

9951.name: Over Capacity
9951.text: When your opponent Special Summons a monster: Banish all face-up Level 2 or lower monsters on the field.

9952.name: The Huge Revolution is Over
9952.text: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated that would destroy 2 or more cards on the field: Negate the activation, and if you do, banish it.

9953.name: Royal Prison
9953.text: Neither player can Special Summon monsters from the GY.

9954.name: Sealing Ceremony of Katon
9954.text: Once per turn: You can banish 1 FIRE monster from your Graveyard to target 1 card in your opponent's Graveyard; banish that target.

10024.name: Wattaildragon
10024.text:
Capable of indefinite flight. Attacks by wrapping its body with electricity and ramming into opponents.
IMPORTANT: Capturing the "Wattaildragon" is forbidden by the Ancient Rules and is a Level 6 offense, the minimum sentence for which is imprisonment for no less than 2500 heliocycles.

10025.name: Hieratic Seal of the Sun Dragon Overlord
10025.text: A mysterious engraved Hieratic relic. It was thought to be a simple stone, but it was actually infused with the power of a sun-wielding dragon. Aeons passed, and the power of the relic grew and grew until it finally shone like the sun itself.

10026.name: Overlay Owl
10026.text: Once per turn: You can pay 600 Life Points; detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on the field.

10027.name: Tasuke Knight
10027.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack, while you have no cards in your hand and this card is in your Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your Graveyard, then end the Battle Phase. You can only use this effect of "Tasuke Knight" once per Duel.

10028.name: Gagaga Gardna
10028.text: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. When this card is targeted for an attack: You can discard 1 card; this card cannot be destroyed by that battle.

10029.name: Cardcar D
10029.text: Cannot be Special Summoned. During your Main Phase 1, if this card was Normal Summoned this turn: You can Tribute this card; draw 2 cards, then it becomes the End Phase. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this effect.

10030.name: Overlay Eater
10030.text: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; take 1 Xyz Material from a monster your opponent controls and attach it to an Xyz Monster you control as Xyz Material.

10031.name: Hammer Shark
10031.text: Once per turn: You can reduce the Level of this card by 1, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower WATER monster from your hand.

10032.name: Hammer Bounzer
10032.text: If your opponent controls a card and you control no cards, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If this card attacks an opponent's monster, as long as you control no Spell/Trap Cards, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

10033.name: Blade Bounzer
10033.text: Once per turn, if this card attacks and your opponent controls a monster at the end of the Damage Step: You can discard 1 card; this card can attack an opponent's monster once again during this Battle Phase.

10034.name: Phantom Bounzer
10034.text: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 2 "Bounzer" cards from your Deck to your hand.

10035.name: Morpho Butterspy
10035.text: Once per turn, when the battle position of an opponent's monster(s) is changed (except during the Damage Step): You can target one of those monsters; it loses 1000 ATK and DEF.

10036.name: Swallowtail Butterspy
10036.text: When another monster you control inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses ATK equal to the Battle Damage inflicted.

10037.name: Moonlit Papillon
10037.text: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Butterspy" monster from your Deck.

10038.name: Jumbo Drill
10038.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can increase the Levels of all Machine-Type monsters you currently control by 1. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

10039.name: Rocket Arrow Express
10039.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by controlling no cards, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you Special Summon this card. You cannot activate cards or effects, or Set any cards. During each of your Standby Phases, destroy this card unless you send your entire hand to the Graveyard (min.1).

10040.name: Cameraclops
10040.text: If this card attacks a face-up monster on the field, at the start of the Damage Step: Destroy that monster. Its DEF must be higher than this card's ATK to activate and to resolve this effect.

10041.name: Hieratic Dragon of Nuit
10041.text: Once per turn, during either player's turn, when this face-up card on the field is targeted by a Spell Card, Trap Card, or card effect: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

10042.name: Hieratic Dragon of Gebeb
10042.text: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 "Hieratic" Normal Monster from your hand, Deck or Graveyard.

10043.name: Hieratic Dragon of Eset
10043.text: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1000. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Dragon Normal Monster on the field; the Levels of all face-up "Hieratic" monsters currently on the field become the Level of that monster, until the End Phase. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY, and make its ATK/DEF 0.

10044.name: Hieratic Dragon of Nebthet
10044.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Hieratic" monster. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Hieratic" monster, except this card, from your hand or your side of the field, to target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

10045.name: Hieratic Dragon of Tefnuit
10045.text: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Cannot attack during the turn it is Special Summoned this way. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY, and make its ATK/DEF 0.

10046.name: Hieratic Dragon of Su
10046.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Hieratic" monster. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 "Hieratic" monster, except this card, from your hand or your side of the field, to target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target. When this card is Tributed: Special Summon 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or Graveyard, and make its ATK and DEF 0.

10047.name: Hieratic Dragon of Asar
10047.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT Dragon-Type monster and 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster from your Graveyard. If this face-up card on the field would be destroyed, you can Tribute 1 face-up "Hieratic" monster instead, except this card.

10048.name: Hieratic Dragon of Sutekh
10048.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 3 Dragon-Type Normal Monsters from your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can banish 1 Dragon-Type monster from your Graveyard to target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

10049.name: Evoltile Lagosucho
10049.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send 1 "Evolsaur" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard. When this card is flipped face-up: You can Special Summon 1 "Evoltile" monster from your Deck.

10050.name: Evolsaur Darwino
10050.text: When this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Evoltile" monster: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; increase that target's Level by up to 2.

10051.name: Inzektor Firefly
10051.text: Once per turn: You can equip 1 "Inzektor" monster from your hand or Graveyard to this card. If an "Inzektor" card equips to this card: You can look at all Set cards your opponent controls. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's Level is increased by 1, also it gains ATK and DEF equal to this card's ATK and DEF.

10052.name: Inzektor Ladybug
10052.text: Once per turn: You can equip 1 "Inzektor" monster from your hand or GY to this card. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's Level is increased by 2, also it gains ATK/DEF equal to this card's ATK/DEF. While this card is equipped to a monster: You can send this Equip Card to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster you control; increase that target's Level by 1 or 2.

10053.name: Inzektor Earwig
10053.text: Once per turn: You can equip 1 "Inzektor" monster from your hand or Graveyard to this card. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster gains ATK and DEF equal to this card's ATK and DEF. When this card is sent to the Graveyard while equipped to a monster: The monster this card was equipped to gains 1000 ATK, until the End Phase.

10054.name: Inzektor Giga-Cricket
10054.text: If this card is in your Graveyard: You can banish 1 Insect-Type monster from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up "Inzektor" monster you control; equip this card from the Graveyard to that target. This effect of "Inzektor Giga-Cricket" can only be used once per turn. While this card is equipped to a monster, that monster's original ATK becomes 2000, and if it attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing Battle Damage to your opponent.

10055.name: Lightray Sorcerer
10055.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) while 3 or more of your LIGHT monsters are banished, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can target 1 of your banished LIGHT monsters and 1 face-up monster on the field; shuffle the first target into the Deck, and if you do, banish the second target. This card cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.

10056.name: Lightray Daedalus
10056.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 4 or more LIGHT monsters in your Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can target 1 Field Spell Card and 2 other cards on the field; destroy them.

10057.name: Lightray Gearfried
10057.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 5 or more LIGHT monsters with different names in your Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated: You can banish 1 Warrior-Type monster from your Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. All face-up monsters you control must be Warrior-Type to activate and to resolve this effect.

10058.name: Lightray Diabolos
10058.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 5 or more LIGHT monsters with different names in your Graveyard. Once per turn: You can banish 1 LIGHT monster from your Graveyard, then target 1 Set card your opponent controls; reveal that target, then place that target on either the top or bottom of the Deck.

10059.name: Lady of D.
10059.text: Your opponent cannot target face-up Dragon-Type monsters you control for attacks. If this card on the field would be destroyed by battle or by a card effect, you can send 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard instead.

10060.name: Absorbing Jar
10060.text: FLIP: Destroy all Set Spells/Traps on the field, then each player draws 1 card for each of the cards they controlled that was destroyed by this effect. You cannot Set any cards this turn.

10061.name: Red-Headed Oni
10061.text: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard by the effect of a Zombie-Type monster: You can target 1 face-up Zombie-Type monster you control; detach 1 Xyz Material from a monster on the field, and if you do, increase the targeted monster's Level by 1 and its ATK by 300 (even if the targeting conditions are no longer correct).

10062.name: Flame Tiger
10062.text: During your Draw Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you control no monsters, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, banish it when it leaves the field.

10063.name: Nomadic Force
10063.text: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Tribute this card to target 1 face-down Defense Position monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

10064.name: Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon
10064.text:
3 Level 8 monsters
If this card is Xyz Summoned using "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" as any of its materials: Negate the effects of all other face-up cards currently on the field. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; detach all materials from monsters your opponent controls, then this card gains 500 ATK for each, also it can attack up to that many times during each Battle Phase this turn.

10065.name: Number 32: Shark Drake
10065.text:
3 Level 4 monsters

2 Level 6 monsters

2 Level 4 monsters

2 Level 6 monsters

2 Level 7 monsters

2 Level 6 Dragon monsters

2 Level 8 monsters

2 Level 4 monsters

2 Level 5 Insect monsters

10075.name: Mini-Guts

10083.text: Send 5 face-up "Inzektor" cards you control to the Graveyard; destroy all cards your opponent controls, also, during the Battle Phase of this turn, your opponent cannot activate monster effects that activate in the hand or Graveyard.

10176.name: Gear Gigant X

10177.name: Alchemic Magician

3 Level 4 Spellcaster-Type monsters

10178.name: Soul of Silvermountain
10178.text:
2 Level 3 EARTH monsters

2 Level 4 EARTH monsters

10180.name: Sword Breaker

2 Level 6 monsters

10182.name: Overlay Regen
10182.text: Target 1 face-up Xyz Monster on the field; attach this card to it as material.

10183.name: Heroic Chance
10183.text: Target 1 face-up "Heroic" monster you control; this turn, double its ATK, but it cannot attack your opponent directly. You can only activate 1 "Heroic Chance" per turn.

10184.name: Chronomaly Technology

You can only activate 1 "Chronomaly Technology" per turn. You cannot Special Summon any monsters during the turn you activate this card, except "Chronomaly" monsters.

10185.name: Chronomaly Pyramid Eye Tablet

10188.name: Spellbook of Power

10189.name: Spellbook of Life
10189.text: Banish 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your Graveyard and reveal 1 other "Spellbook" Spell Card in your hand to target 1 Spellcaster-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position and equip it with this card. The equipped monster's Level is increased by the Level of the monster that was banished for this card's activation. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Life" per turn.

10190.name: Spellbook of Wisdom

●You take no Battle Damage during this Battle Phase.

10198.name: Heroic Retribution Sword
10198.text: Target 1 face-up "Heroic" monster you control; equip this card to that target. All Battle Damage you take from battles involving the equipped monster is also inflicted to your opponent. After damage calculation: Destroy any opponent's monster that battles the equipped monster.

10199.name: Stonehenge Methods
10199.text: When a face-up "Chronomaly" monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Chronomaly" monster from your Deck in face-up Defense Position. It cannot change its battle position.

10201.name: Madolche Waltz
10201.text: Each time a "Madolche" monster you control attacks or is attacked, after damage calculation: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

10207.name: Three of a Kind
10207.text: If you control 3 or more monsters with the same name, except Tokens: Target 3 cards your opponent controls; destroy those targets.

10208.name: Soul Drain
10208.text: Activate by paying 1000 LP. Monsters that are banished, as well as monsters in the GY, cannot activate their effects.

10209.name: Rebound
10209.text: When your opponent activates a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect that returns a card(s) from the field to the hand: Negate that effect, and if you do, send 1 card from your opponent's hand (at random) or from their side of the field to the Graveyard. When this Set card is destroyed by your opponent's card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

10210.name: Lucky Punch
10210.text: Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can toss a coin 3 times. If the result is 3 heads, draw 3 cards, but if the result is 3 tails, destroy this card. If this face-up card on the field is destroyed: You lose 6000 Life Points.

10223.name: Gagaga Caesar
10223.text: Cannot attack unless you control another face-up "Gagaga" monster. Once per turn: You can banish 1 monster from your Graveyard that has a Level; the Levels of all face-up "Gagaga" monsters you currently control become the Level of that monster. This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster.

10224.name: Bull Blader
10224.text: When an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's monster: You can activate this effect; during this battle involving this monster, neither player takes any battle damage, also destroy the opponent's monster after damage calculation.

10225.name: Achacha Chanbara
10225.text: During either player's turn, when a card or effect is activated that will inflict damage when it resolves: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, inflict 400 damage to your opponent.

10226.name: Mogmole
10226.text: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon it from your Graveyard in face-up Defense Position. You can only use the effect of "Mogmole" once per Duel.

10227.name: Grandram
10227.text: If your opponent controls a face-up Xyz Monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in face-up Attack Position.

10228.name: Tripod Fish
10228.text: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua-Type monster on the field; increase its Level by 1.

10229.name: Deep Sweeper
10229.text: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap Card on the field; destroy that target.

10230.name: Heroic Challenger - Extra Sword
10230.text:
An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card as Xyz Material gains this effect.
●When it is Xyz Summoned: It gains 1000 ATK.

10231.name: Heroic Challenger - Night Watchman
10231.text: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster your opponent controls, before damage calculation: You can destroy that monster.

10232.name: Planet Pathfinder
10232.text: You can Tribute this card; add 1 Field Spell from your Deck to your hand.

10233.name: Solar Wind Jammer
10233.text: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand), but its original ATK and DEF become halved. During each of your Standby Phases: Increase the Level of this card by 1. There can only be 1 "Solar Wind Jammer" on the field.

10234.name: Heraldic Beast Aberconway
10234.text: If this card is in your GY: You can banish 1 other "Heraldic Beast Aberconway" from your GY, then target 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster in your GY; add that target to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Heraldic Beast Aberconway" once per turn.

10235.name: Heraldic Beast Berners Falcon
10235.text: When this card is Summoned: You can make all Level 5 or higher monsters you currently control become Level 4.

10236.name: Mermail Abysslinde
10236.text: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Mermail" monster from your Deck, except "Mermail Abysslinde". You can only use this effect of "Mermail Abysslinde" once per turn.

10237.name: Mermail Abyssgunde
10237.text: If this card is discarded to the GY: You can target 1 "Mermail" monster in your GY, except "Mermail Abyssgunde"; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Mermail Abyssgunde" once per turn.

10238.name: Mermail Abysshilde
10238.text: If this card is sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Mermail" monster from your hand, except "Mermail Abysshilde". You can only use the effect of "Mermail Abysshilde" once per turn.

10239.name: Mermail Abyssturge
10239.text: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard, then target 1 Level 3 or lower WATER monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Mermail Abyssturge" once per turn.

10240.name: Mermail Abysspike
10240.text: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the GY; add 1 Level 3 WATER monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mermail Abysspike" once per turn.

10241.name: Mermail Abysslung
10241.text: Your opponent cannot target face-up WATER monsters for attacks, except this one. All WATER monsters you control gain 300 ATK.

10242.name: Mermail Abyssmegalo
10242.text: You can discard 2 other WATER monsters to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. When Summoned this way: You can add 1 "Abyss-" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can Tribute 1 other Attack Position WATER monster; this card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

10243.name: Stoic of Prophecy
10243.text: When this card is sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 Level 3 "Prophecy" monster from your Deck to your hand.

10244.name: Hermit of Prophecy
10244.text: Each time a "Spellbook" Spell Card is activated, increase this card's Level by 2 and ATK by 300.

10245.name: Justice of Prophecy
10245.text: During your End Phase, if you have activated a "Spellbook" Spell Card previously this turn: You can banish this card from the field; add both 1 Level 5 or higher LIGHT or DARK Spellcaster-Type monster and 1 "Spellbook" Spell Card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Justice of Prophecy" once per turn.

10246.name: Emperor of Prophecy
10246.text: You can banish both 1 face-up Spellcaster-Type monster you control, except this card, and 1 "Spellbook" card from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase. You can only use the effect of "Emperor of Prophecy" once per turn. This card cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.

10247.name: Madolche Cruffssant
10247.text: When this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: Shuffle this card into the Deck. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up "Madolche" card you control, except this card; return it to the hand, and if you do, increase this card's Level by 1 and ATK by 300.

10248.name: Madolche Marmalmaide
10248.text: When this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect) and sent to your Graveyard: Shuffle this card into the Deck. When this card is flipped face-up: You can target 1 "Madolche" Spell/Trap Card in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

10249.name: Madolche Messengelato
10249.text: If this card in your possession is destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to your GY: Shuffle this card into the Deck. When this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Madolche" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You must control a face-up "Madolche" Beast monster to activate and to resolve this effect.

10250.name: Abyss Warrior
10250.text: Once per turn: You can discard 1 WATER monster to the Graveyard, then target 1 monster in either player's Graveyard; return that target to either the top or bottom of the Deck.

10251.name: Snowman Creator
10251.text: When this card is Summoned: You can create a number of Ice Counters equal to the number of WATER monsters you control, place them on a face-up monster(s) your opponent controls, then, if you placed 3 or more Ice Counters by this effect, you can destroy 1 card your opponent controls.

10252.name: Fishborg Planter
10252.text: Once, while this card is in the GY: You can send the top card of your Deck to the GY, then, if it is a WATER monster, Special Summon this card from the GY. You can only use this effect of "Fishborg Planter" once per turn.

10253.name: Nimble Angler
10253.text: If this card is sent from the hand or Deck to the GY: You can Special Summon up to 2 Level 3 or lower "Nimble" monsters from your Deck, except "Nimble Angler".

10254.name: Shore Knight
10254.text: Once per turn, if the battle position of this face-up card on the field is changed: Send 1 WATER monster from your Deck to the GY.

10255.name: Mecha Sea Dragon Plesion
10255.text: If you control a face-up Sea Serpent-Type monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 WATER monster to target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

10256.name: Metallizing Parasite - Soltite
10256.text: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. While equipped by this effect, the equipped monster cannot be targeted or destroyed by your opponent's monster effects. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead.)

10257.name: Moulinglacia the Elemental Lord
10257.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 5 WATER monsters in your GY. If this card is Special Summoned: Discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand (or their entire hand, if less than 2). You can only use this effect of "Moulinglacia the Elemental Lord" once per turn. If this face-up card leaves the field, skip the Battle Phase of your next turn.

10258.name: House Duston
10258.text: When this face-up card on the field is destroyed by your opponent's card (either by battle, and it was face-up at the start of the Damage Step, or by card effect) and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon any "Duston" monsters of your choice from your hand and/or Deck to anywhere on the field, but you must Special Summon an equal number of monsters on each side.

10259.name: Puny Penguin
10259.text: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard after being flipped face-up: Target 1 "Penguin" monster in your Graveyard, except "Puny Penguin"; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.

10260.name: Missing Force
10260.text: If you control no other monsters: You can Tribute this card to target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase. You cannot Special Summon or conduct your Battle Phase during the turn you activate this effect.

10261.name: Number C32: Shark Drake Veiss
10261.text:
4 Level 4 WATER monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using "Number 32: Shark Drake" you control as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) If your LP are 1000 or less (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 monster from your GY and detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; its ATK/DEF become 0 until the end of your turn.

10262.name: One-Eyed Skill Gainer
10262.text:
3 Level 4 monsters
You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card to target 1 face-up Xyz Monster your opponent controls; this card's name and original effect become the same as that monster. This effect can only be used once while this card is face-up on the field.

10263.name: Gagaga Cowboy
10263.text:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; apply this effect, depending on this card's current battle position.
●Attack Position: If this card attacks an opponent's monster this turn, it gains 1000 ATK, also the opponent's monster loses 500 ATK, during the Damage Step only.
●Defense Position: Inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

10264.name: Heroic Champion - Gandiva
10264.text:
2 Level 4 Warrior monsters
Once per turn, when a Level 4 or lower monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): You can detach 1 material from this card; destroy that Special Summoned monster(s).

10265.name: Heroic Champion - Kusanagi
10265.text:
3 Level 4 Warrior-Type monsters
Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a Trap Card is activated: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it, then this card gains 500 ATK.

10266.name: Number 9: Dyson Sphere
10266.text:
2 Level 9 monsters
During your Main Phase 1, if your opponent controls a monster with higher ATK than this card: You can detach 1 material from this card; this card can attack directly this turn. Once per Battle Step, if this card with material is attacked (Quick Effect): You can negate that attack. When this card is targeted for an attack while it has no material: You can target 2 monsters in your GY; attach those monsters to this card as material.

10267.name: Number 8: Heraldic King Genom-Heritage
10267.text:
2 Level 4 "Heraldic Beast" monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up Xyz Monster your opponent controls; this card's name and original ATK become that monster's original name and current ATK, also replace this effect with that monster's original effects, then that monster's ATK becomes 0, also its effects are negated. This effect applies until the End Phase.

10268.name: Mermail Abyssgaios
10268.text:
2 Level 7 WATER monsters
While this card has material, Level 5 or higher monsters cannot attack. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls with less ATK than this card, until the end of this turn.

10269.name: Empress of Prophecy
10269.text:
2 Level 5 Spellcaster-Type monsters
This card gains 300 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to a monster you control. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; shuffle your Deck, then excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, destroy monsters on the field up to the number of "Spellbook" cards excavated, also, after that, place the excavated cards on the top of the Deck in any order.

10270.name: Madolche Queen Tiaramisu
10270.text:
2 Level 4 "Madolche" monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target up to 2 "Madolche" card(s) in your GY; shuffle those cards into the Deck, also, after that, shuffle cards your opponent controls into the Deck, up to the number of "Madolche" cards returned.

10271.name: Snowdust Giant
10271.text:
2 Level 4 WATER monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; reveal any number of WATER monsters from your hand, and place that many Ice Counters on face-up monsters on the field. Non-WATER monsters on the field lose 200 ATK for each Ice Counter on the field.

10273.name: One-Shot Wand
10273.text: Equip only to a Spellcaster-Type monster. It gains 800 ATK. If the equipped monster attacks or is attacked, after damage calculation: You can destroy this card, and if you do, draw 1 card.

10274.name: Different Dimension Deepsea Trench
10274.text: When this card resolves: Banish 1 WATER monster from your hand, Graveyard, or face-up on your field. Then, when this face-up card on the field is destroyed: Special Summon that banished monster to your side of the field.

10275.name: Tannhauser Gate
10275.text: Target 2 monsters you control of the same Type with 1000 or less ATK; both monsters' Levels become the combined Levels of those 2 monsters.

10276.name: Gravity Blaster
10276.text: Equip only to a Machine-Type monster. Once per turn: You can activate this effect; it permanently gains 400 ATK. (This ATK gain remains even if this card leaves the field or the monster becomes unaffected by card effects.) If it battles an opponent's monster, that monster's effect is negated during the Battle Phase only.

10277.name: Advanced Heraldry Art
10277.text: Target 2 "Heraldic Beast" monsters in your GY; Special Summon both those targets, then immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Xyz Monster using those 2 monsters only.

10278.name: Abyss-scale of the Kraken
10278.text: Equip only to a "Mermail" monster. It gains 400 ATK. When a monster effect that was activated on your opponent's side of the field resolves, negate that effect, then send this card to the Graveyard.

10279.name: Lemuria, the Forgotten City
10279.text:
(This card is always treated as "Umi".)
All WATER monsters gain 200 ATK/DEF. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can have all WATER monsters you currently control gain Levels equal to the number of WATER monsters you currently control, until the end of this turn.

10280.name: Spellbook of Eternity
10280.text: Target 1 of your banished "Spellbook" Spell Cards, except "Spellbook of Eternity"; add that target to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Eternity" per turn.

10281.name: Spellbook of Fate
10281.text:
If you control a Spellcaster monster: You can banish up to 3 "Spellbook" Spells from your GY; apply this effect, depending on the number of Spells banished for this card's activation. You can only activate 1 "Spellbook of Fate" per turn.
●1: Return 1 Set Spell/Trap on the field to the hand.
●2: Change 1 monster on the field to face-down Defense Position or face-up Attack Position.
●3: Banish 1 card your opponent controls.

10282.name: The Grand Spellbook Tower
10282.text: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, if you have a Spellcaster-Type monster on your side of the field or in your Graveyard: You can place 1 "Spellbook" Spell Card from your Graveyard on the bottom of your Deck, except "The Grand Spellbook Tower", then draw 1 card. When this card in your possession is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster-Type monster from your hand or Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the number of "Spellbook" Spell Cards in your Graveyard.

10283.name: Madolche Ticket
10283.text: When a "Madolche" card(s) is returned from your side of the field or Graveyard to your hand or Main Deck by a card effect: Add 1 "Madolche" monster from your Deck to your hand. If you control a face-up Fairy-Type "Madolche" monster, you can Special Summon the monster from your Deck in face-up Attack Position instead of adding it to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Madolche Ticket" once per turn.

10284.name: Forbidden Dress
10284.text: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; until the end of this turn, that target loses 600 ATK, but cannot be targeted or destroyed by other card effects.

10285.name: Final Gesture
10285.text: Target 1 face-up Level 3 monster you control; Special Summon 1 monster with the same name as that monster from your hand or Graveyard. Its effects are negated. During the End Phase of this turn, destroy the face-up monster that was targeted by this card.

10286.name: Mind Pollutant
10286.text: Discard 1 monster to target 1 monster of that Level your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

10287.name: The Humble Sentry
10287.text: Reveal your hand, choose 1 card, and shuffle it into the Deck.

10288.name: Battle Break
10288.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Your opponent can reveal 1 monster in their hand to negate this card's effect, otherwise destroy the attacking monster, then end the Battle Phase.

10289.name: Bubble Bringer
10289.text: Level 4 or higher monsters cannot attack directly. During your turn: You can send this face-up card from the field to the Graveyard to target 2 Level 3 or lower WATER monsters with the same name in your Graveyard; Special Summon those targets. Their effects are negated.

10290.name: Heroic Gift
10290.text: If your opponent's Life Points are 2000 or less: Make their Life Points 8000, and if you do, draw 2 cards. You can only activate 1 "Heroic Gift" per turn.

10291.name: Heroic Advance
10291.text: When a face-up "Heroic" monster you control is targeted for an attack: Target another face-up Level 4 or lower "Heroic" monster you control; double its ATK during this Battle Phase, then switch the attack target to it and conduct damage calculation, but monsters cannot be destroyed by this battle.

10292.name: Xyz Xtreme !!
10292.text: When an Xyz Monster you control is destroyed by battle: Pay 1000 Life Points; you reveal 1 Xyz Monster from the Extra Deck with a Rank less than or equal to that destroyed monster's, and so can your opponent (simultaneously). The player who revealed the monster with lower ATK takes damage equal to the difference between the revealed monsters' ATK's. If the opponent doesn't reveal a monster, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of your revealed monster.

10293.name: Abyss-squall
10293.text: Target 3 "Mermail" monsters in your Graveyard; Special Summon those targets in face-up Defense Position. Their effects are negated and they cannot declare an attack. Destroy them during the End Phase.

10294.name: Abyss-sphere
10294.text: Special Summon 1 "Mermail" monster from your Deck. Its effects are negated. You cannot activate any Spell Cards. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. Destroy this card during your opponent's next End Phase after activation.

10295.name: Abyss-strom
10295.text: Send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the Graveyard; send all Spell and Trap Cards on the field to the Graveyard.

10296.name: Madolchepalooza
10296.text: Special Summon any number of "Madolche" monsters from your hand, but shuffle them into the Deck during the End Phase.

10297.name: Memory of an Adversary
10297.text: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You take damage equal to the attacking monster's ATK, and if you do, banish that monster. During the End Phase of your opponent's next turn, Special Summon that monster to your side of the field.

10298.name: Magic Deflector
10298.text: For the rest of this turn, negate all Equip, Field, Continuous and Quick-Play Spell Card effects on the field.

10299.name: That Wacky Alchemy!
10299.text: If a face-up Spell Card(s) in your opponent's Spell & Trap Card Zones is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target.

10300.name: Cash Back
10300.text: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, by paying their Life Points: Negate the activation, and if you do, return it to the Deck.

10301.name: Unification
10301.text: Once per turn, during each player's Standby Phase: The turn player declares a Level from among the face-up monsters they control, then sends all face-up monsters they control with a different Level to the Graveyard.

10302.name: Retort
10302.text: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card with the same name as one in your Graveyard: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. Then you can add 1 card with that name from your Graveyard to your hand.

10360.name: Dododo Bot
10360.text: Cannot be Normal Summoned (but can be Normal Set). If this card attacks, it is unaffected by other card effects until the end of the Damage Step.

10361.name: Gogogo Ghost
10361.text: If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 "Gogogo Golem" in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position, then change this card to Defense Position. You can only use the effect of "Gogogo Ghost" once per turn.

10362.name: Bacon Saver
10362.text: During either player's Battle Step, while an attack is occurring: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; negate the attack. You can only use the effect of "Bacon Saver" once per Duel.

10363.name: Amarylease
10363.text: During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your Graveyard; you can Normal Summon 1 monster this turn for 1 less Tribute. You can only use the effect of "Amarylease" once per turn.

10364.name: ZW - Lightning Blade
10364.text: You can target 1 "Utopia" monster you control; equip this monster from your hand or your side of the field to that target. It gains 1200 ATK. While this card is equipped to a monster, face-up "ZW -" cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. If a monster equipped with this card would be destroyed by a card effect, destroy this card instead. You can only control 1 face-up "ZW - Lightning Blade".

10365.name: ZW - Tornado Bringer
10365.text: You can target 1 "Utopia" monster you control; equip this monster from your hand or face-up field to that target. It gains 1300 ATK. While this card is equipped to a monster, your opponent cannot target that monster with card effects. If a monster equipped with this card would be destroyed by battle, destroy this card instead. You can only control 1 face-up "ZW - Tornado Bringer".

10366.name: ZW - Ultimate Shield
10366.text: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 of your banished Xyz Monsters; Special Summon that target in face-up Defense Position. You can target 1 "Utopia" monster you control; equip this monster on the field to that target. It gains 2000 DEF. You can only control 1 face-up "ZW - Ultimate Shield".

10367.name: Gagaga Clerk
10367.text: If you control a "Gagaga" monster other than "Gagaga Clerk", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

10368.name: Spear Shark
10368.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can increase the Levels of all Level 3 Fish-Type monsters you currently control by 1. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

10369.name: Double Shark
10369.text: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can reduce the Levels of all Level 4 Fish-Type monsters you currently control by 1. This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase.

10370.name: Xyz Remora
10370.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by detaching 2 materials from monster(s) you control. When Summoned this way: You can target 2 Level 4 Fish monsters in your GY; Special Summon those targets in Defense Position. Their effects are negated, they cannot attack or change their battle positions, and cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a WATER monster.

10371.name: Hyper-Ancient Shark Megalodon
10371.text: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that target.

10372.name: Heraldic Beast Basilisk
10372.text: After damage calculation: Destroy any opponent's monster that battles this card.

10373.name: Heraldic Beast Eale
10373.text: If you control 2 or more "Heraldic Beast" monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

10374.name: Heraldic Beast Twin-Headed Eagle
10374.text: You can banish this card from your Graveyard to target 1 face-up Xyz Monster you control with no Xyz Materials and 2 "Heraldic Beast" monsters in your Graveyard; attach those monsters from the Graveyard to that face-up Xyz Monster, as Xyz Materials. You can only use the effect of "Heraldic Beast Twin-Headed Eagle" once per turn.

10375.name: Heraldic Beast Unicorn
10375.text: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Psychic Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects. You can only use this effect of "Heraldic Beast Unicorn" once per turn.

10376.name: Heraldic Beast Leo
10376.text: During the End Phase of the turn this card was Normal Summoned: Destroy this card. When this card is sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 "Heraldic Beast" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Heraldic Beast Leo". You can only use this effect of "Heraldic Beast Leo" once per turn.

10377.name: Garbage Ogre
10377.text: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; add 1 "Garbage Lord" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use the effect of "Garbage Ogre" once per turn.

10378.name: Garbage Lord
10378.text: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by paying 2000 Life Points. This card cannot be used as an Xyz Material for an Xyz Summon, except for the Xyz Summon of a DARK monster.

10379.name: Orbital 7
10379.text: When this card is flipped face-up: Place 1 You Got It Boss! Counter on it. You can remove all You Got It Boss! Counters on this card; its ATK becomes 2000. After you change this card's ATK with this effect, it cannot attack your opponent directly for the rest of this turn, and is sent to the GY during the End Phase. You can Tribute this card to target 1 "Photon" or "Galaxy" monster in your GY; add that target to your hand.

10380.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Hawk
10380.text: If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card (either by battle or by card effect): You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell Card directly from your Deck. While you control a "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap Card, all "Fire Fist" monsters you control gain 500 ATK and DEF.

10381.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Raven
