You can only use each effect of "Twilight Specter Rayrage" once per turn.
22974.pendulum: If a Pendulum Monster(s) you control would be destroyed by an opponent's card effect, you can destroy this card instead of 1 of those Pendulum Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Twilight Specter Rayrage" once per turn.

22975.name: Gray Layer
22975.text: You can Tribute this card, then reveal 1 Machine monster in your hand; add 1 Machine monster with a different Attribute from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster with 1200 or less ATK, you can Special Summon 1 Machine monster from your hand. If a monster(s) in your possession is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; destroy 1 card on the field. You can only use each effect of "Gray Layer" once per turn.

22976.name: Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos
22976.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Light and Darkness Ritual". Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, unless they target this card, also Spells/Traps you control cannot be destroyed, or banished, by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell from your GY to your hand. You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it face-down.

22977.name: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness
22977.text: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Light and Darkness Ritual". Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, unless they target this card, also cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can make this card gain 1500 ATK, and if you do, it can make a second attack in a row.

22978.name: The Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts
22978.text: Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards you control to the GY. You can only Special Summon "The Chaotic Phantasmal Sacred Beasts" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. The first two times this card on the field would be destroyed by card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Once per Chain, up to thrice per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects (until the end of this turn), then you can gain LP equal to half that monster's ATK.

materials.rule: 3 Level 10 monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set

22979.name: Invoked Sorath
22979.text: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Level 6 or lower monster in either GY; Special Summon it to your field in Defense Position, but negate its effects. If this card is in your GY: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing this card from your GY and monsters from your field or GY as material. You can only use each effect of "Invoked Sorath" once per turn.

22980.name: Invoked Baybarron
22980.text: If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Virakam, the Divine Spirit of Artifice" or 1 "Gamma Summon" from your Deck to your hand, then you can banish 1 monster from either GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster you control; monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to the targeted monster's ATK, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Invoked Baybarron" once per turn.

22981.name: Invoked Oceanus
22981.text: While this card is in the Main Monster Zone, your opponent's monsters cannot target monsters for attacks, except this one. While this card is in the Extra Monster Zone, any monster sent to your opponent's GY is banished instead. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion Monster you control; it can attack directly this turn. You can only use this effect of "Invoked Oceanus" once per turn.

22982.name: Hyperinvoked Aeon
22982.text: If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can banish cards from the field and/or GYs, up to the number of monsters used as material, then if you used 3 or more materials, you can look at your opponent's Extra Deck and banish up to 3 cards from it. (Quick Effect): You can declare 1 Attribute; all other monsters on the field become that Attribute until the end of this turn. You can only use 1 "Hyperinvoked Aeon" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

22983.name: Melffys' Joyful Surprise
22983.text: If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can target an equal number of "Melffy" cards you control and cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step), or if an opponent's monster targets this card for an attack: You can target 1 Beast monster in your GY; reduce this card's Level by exactly 2, and if you do, Special Summon that target. You can only use each effect of "Melffys' Joyful Surprise" once per turn.

22984.name: Elfnote June Pride
22984.text:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner Spellcaster monster
While this card is in the center Main Monster Zone, neither player can declare attacks, except with monsters in their center Main Monster Zones. During the Main Phase, if this card is in the center Main Monster Zone (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon up to 1 "Elfnote" monster each from your hand, Deck, and GY. You can only use this effect of "Elfnote June Pride" once per turn.

22985.name: Glitch Clutch Nullgainer
22985.text:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 Level 8 or higher monster with 0 ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 monster with 0 ATK in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, also it cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon. You can only use each effect of "Glitch Clutch Nullgainer" once per turn.

22986.name: The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe
22986.text:
2 Level 3 DARK monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "The Phantom Knights" monster from your Deck. If you Xyz Summon an "Xyz Dragon" monster, while this card is in your Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Rank-Up-Magic" Spell from your Deck to your hand. If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 of your banished "The Phantom Knights" cards to your hand, except Xyz Monsters. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Malevolent Scythe" once per turn.

22987.name: Melffy Godmommy
22987.text:
3+ Level 2 Beast monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Melffy Godmommy" by using "Melffy Mommy" you control (transfer its materials). If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Melffy" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. Gains ATK equal to the combined ATK and DEF of "Melffy" monsters attached to it. You can detach 5 materials from this card; return all cards your opponent controls to the hand.

22988.name: Purification Power Patron
22988.text:
2 non-Link Monsters
If this card is Link Summoned, and you have a "Power Patron" monster in your GY: You can add 1 "Theorealize" card from your Deck to your hand. During the Main Phase, if you control another DARK Fairy monster, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 Link Monster using materials you control, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Purification Power Patron" once per turn.

22989.name: S-Force Nightcatcher
22989.text:
2 monsters, including an "S-Force" monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "S-Force" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control and 1 "S-Force" card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "S-Force" monster from your Deck/Extra Deck, except "S-Force Nightcatcher". You can only use each effect of "S-Force Nightcatcher" once per turn.

22990.name: S-Force Mystify
22990.text:
2+ monsters, including an "S-Force" monster
While your opponent controls a monster in this card's column, they cannot target this card with card effects, nor Special Summon by an activated monster effect. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster on the field; move it to another Main Monster Zone on its controller's field. You can only use this effect of "S-Force Mystify" once per turn.

22991.name: Clown Crew Dristy
22991.text:
2 Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and/or Pendulum Monsters
Your Tribute Summoned monsters can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. If this card is Tributed: You can activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Clown Crew Dristy" once per turn);
●Return all Link Monsters from the field and the GYs to the Extra Deck.
●Each player with a hand shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards they shuffled into the Deck.

22992.name: Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens
22992.text:
2+ Effect Monsters
You can also use 1 monster in your hand as material to Link Summon this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenna's Deceiving Doll Maidens" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY, or if all materials used for its Link Summon were monsters you controlled, you can send 1 monster from your Extra Deck instead. During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 monster from your GY to your hand.

22993.name: Light and Darkness Ritual
22993.text: This card can be used to Ritual Summon "Magician of Dark Chaos - Black Chaos" or "Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness". You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field, and/or banish monsters from your GY, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. If this card is in your GY: You can add this card and 1 card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your GY to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Light and Darkness Ritual" once per turn.

22994.name: Chaos Mystic Box
22994.text: When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets another card(s) you control: Return 1 of your targeted cards to the hand (if face-down, reveal it), and if you do, destroy 1 card on the field, then you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" with a different name than the card returned to the hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 Ritual Monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand or Deck.

22995.name: Chaos Magical Hats
22995.text: When your opponent activates a monster effect, or a Normal Spell/Trap Card: Choose 3 Spells/Traps with different names from your Deck and 1 monster in your Main Monster Zone that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual". Special Summon the Spells/Traps as Normal Monsters (Spellcaster/DARK/Level 8/ATK 0/DEF 0) in face-down Defense Position (their names become "Chaos Magical Hats" even while face-down), Set the chosen monster if it is face-up, and shuffle them on the field. Then your opponent's activated effect becomes "Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls in face-down Defense Position".

22996.name: Sacred Beasts Released
22996.text: Add 3 "Sacred Beast" monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, then discard 2 cards. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; add 1 Level 10 Pyro, Thunder, or Fiend monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Sacred Beasts Released" once per turn.

22997.name: Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts
22997.text: Up to thrice per turn, during your Main Phase: You can send 3 other cards of the same type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your hand and/or face-up field to the GY, then you can Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your hand, Deck, GY, or banishment, and if you do, it is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell/Trap effects. If you control a "Sacred Beast" monster whose original Level is 10: You can draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn.

22998.name: Sacred Beasts Thunderclap
22998.text: During your Main Phase: You can place 2 "Sacred Beasts Thunderclap" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, face-up on your field, then you can reveal 1 Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand, then place 1 "Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts" from your Deck, face-up in your Field Zone. During your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Sacred Beasts Thunderclap" once per turn.

22999.name: Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb
22999.text: Monsters you control that were Normal or Special Summoned from the hand gain 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each of the following effects of "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Mech Beast Token" (Machine/EARTH/Level 6/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) to your opponent's field, and if you do, add 1 "Blitzclique" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand.

23000.name: Blitzclique - Breakaway
23000.text:
Activate 1 of these effects;
●Place 1 "Blitzclique" Continuous Trap from your Deck, face-up on your field.
●Return 1 Thunder monster you control to the hand, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Breakaway" once per turn.

23001.name: Blitzclique - Steppleader
23001.text: If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Thunder monster in your GY; add it to your hand. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, then destroy this card. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Steppleader" once per turn.

23002.name: Invocation - "Sword"
23002.text: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control. If Summoning an "Invoked" Fusion Monster this way, you can also return monsters from any banishment to the GY as material. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can target 1 "Aleister" monster or "Invocation" in your GY; shuffle this card into the Deck, and if you do, add that target to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Invocation - "Sword"" once per turn.

23003.name: Sacred Spirit Sword Aiwass
23003.text:
Activate 1 of these effects, but you cannot declare attacks for the rest of this turn, except with Fusion Monsters;
●Special Summon 1 "Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law" from your Deck or GY.
●Take 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck, and either send it to the GY or banish it.
●Look at 3 random face-down cards in your opponent's Extra Deck, and if you do, banish 1 of them.
You can only activate 1 "Sacred Spirit Sword Aiwass" per turn.

23004.name: Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea
23004.text: Show 1 "Nerva the Power Patron of Creation", 1 "Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction", and 1 "Junora the Power Patron of Tuning" from your Extra Deck, face-up Monster Zone, and/or GY, and if you do, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to the activation of your "Power Patron" monster effects this turn. If you would banish the top card(s) of your Deck to activate the effect of a "Power Patron" monster you control, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea" once per turn.

23005.name: Theorealize Past Lull
23005.text: If you control an "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" card: You can Special Summon 1 "Medius the Pure" from your hand or Deck. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when that monster is Special Summoned. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster in your GY; Special Summon it to your zone a Link Monster points to. You can only use 1 "Theorealize Past Lull" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

23006.name: The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem
23006.text:
Target 1 "The Phantom Knights" or "Xyz Dragon" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, then apply the following effect.
●Choose 1 DARK Xyz Monster you control, and Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "The Phantom Knights" or "Xyz Dragon" Xyz Monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials).
You can only activate 1 "The Phantom Knights' Rank-Up-Magic Requiem" per turn.

23007.name: S-Force Origin
23007.text: Special Summon 1 "S-Force" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment, but banish it when it leaves the field. If another card is banished, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; take 2 "S-Force" cards from your Deck, except "S-Force Origin", banish 1 of them, and send the other to the GY. You can only use each effect of "S-Force Origin" once per turn.

23008.name: Melffy Footsteps
23008.text: Add up to 4 "Melffy" monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, then it becomes the End Phase of this turn. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 2 "Melffy" cards in your GY, except "Melffy Footsteps"; add 1 of them to your hand, and if you do, place the other on the bottom of your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Melffy Footsteps" once per turn. You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this card, except "Melffy" monsters.

23009.name: Spiritual Power Recovery Potion
23009.text:
(This card is always treated as a "Possessed" card.)
Banish any number of Spellcaster monsters and/or Spells from your GY; monsters you control gain 200 ATK x the number banished, and if they do, you gain 400 LP x the number banished. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon any number of Spellcaster monsters with different Attributes from your hand. You can only use 1 "Spiritual Power Recovery Potion" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

23010.name: Pot of Sloth
23010.text: Draw cards equal to the number of cards your opponent controls, then if you drew 2 or more cards, place cards from your hand on the bottom of the Deck in any order, equal to the number you drew -1. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot activate "Pot of Sloth".

23011.name: Ragged Records of Rites
23011.text: Reveal 1 Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck, and if you do, add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand that mentions that Spell's name. If a face-up Ritual Monster(s) you control leaves the field by card effect while this card is in your GY, and you do not control any face-up monsters, other than Ritual Monsters (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Ragged Records of Rites" once per turn.

23012.name: Superconductive Plasma Blast
23012.text:
Activate the following effect depending on whose turn it is;
●Yours: Place 1 Thunder or Rock monster from your Deck on top of your Deck, then if you have a Thunder or Rock monster in your field or GY, you can destroy 1 card on the field.
●Opponent's: Add 1 Thunder or Rock monster from your field, GY or banishment to your hand, or if a monster(s) was destroyed by battle or card effect this turn, you can add 1 such monster from your Deck instead.
You can only activate 1 "Superconductive Plasma Blast" per turn.

23013.name: Summer
23013.text: Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of your opponent's unused Main Monster Zones. Once per turn, when your monster declares an attack: You can inflict damage to your opponent equal to the total number of Season Counters on this card and "Spring" in your GY x 400. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand or Deck that you can place a Season Counter on, and place it face-up on your field (but neither player can activate its effects this turn), and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card.

23014.name: Mind Shuffle
23014.text: During either player's turn: You can add 1 monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Mind Shuffle" once per turn. When your opponent activates a card or effect: You can return 1 Level 7 or higher monster you control to the hand; Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand, with a different name than the returned monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You cannot activate these effects of "Mind Shuffle" in the same Chain.

23015.name: Sacred Beasts Combined Assault
23015.text: Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position, then if you control 2 or more "Sacred Beast" monsters whose original Levels are 10, you can negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls, and if you do, destroy it. You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 "Phantasm" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Sacred Beasts Combined Assault" once per turn.

23016.name: Abyss of the Sacred Beasts
23016.text: You can send 3 face-up "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" you control to the GY, including this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position. You can only use each of the following effects of "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn. During the Main Phase: You can place 2 "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, face-up on your field. During your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can place this card on the bottom of the Deck.

23017.name: Blitzclique Return Stroke
23017.text: "Blitzclique" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Return Stroke" once per turn. When your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect: You can return 1 "Blitzclique" monster you control to the hand; negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Blitzclique" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand.

23018.name: Blitzclique Alternator
23018.text: Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder monster you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Alternator" once per turn. You can shuffle 1 other "Blitzclique" card from your hand or face-up field into the Deck; add 1 Thunder monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" from your Deck to your hand.

23019.name: Gamma Summon
23019.text: Banish 1 "Aleister" monster or 1 Fusion Monster from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but banish it during the End Phase. If a monster is banished face-up, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of your banished "Invoked" monsters; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Gamma Summon" once per turn.

23020.name: Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour
23020.text:
Special Summon 1 "Power Patron" monster from your hand, face-up Extra Deck, or GY, then you can apply these effects in sequence, based on the number of different card types (Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz) you control.
●1+: Banish (face-down) 3 cards from the top of your opponent's Deck.
●2+: Banish (face-down) 1 card your opponent controls.
●3: Banish (face-down) 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
You can only activate 1 "Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour" per turn.

23021.name: Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession
23021.text: The monster in your center Main Monster Zone cannot be banished by your opponent's card effects. You can send 1 other Spell/Trap from your hand or field to the GY, then declare a Level from 1 to 4; Special Summon 1 "Elfnote Seraphim Token" (Plant/Tuner/FIRE/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the declared Level. While that Token is in the Monster Zone, the player who Summoned it cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Elfnote" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession" once per turn.

23022.name: The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil
23022.text: If you have a "The Phantom Knights" monster in your field or GY, you can activate this card the turn it was Set. Special Summon this card in Defense Position as a Normal Monster (Warrior/DARK/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 300) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then you can change 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls to Defense Position. You can banish this card from your GY; immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 DARK Xyz Monster. You can only use each effect of "The Phantom Knights of Umbrage Veil" once per turn.

23023.name: S-Force World Sorting
23023.text: If an "S-Force" monster you control would banish a card(s) from your hand to activate its effect, you can send 1 "S-Force" card from your Deck to the GY instead, except "S-Force World Sorting". If another card(s) is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card in your opponent's field or GY; banish it, then you can move 1 "S-Force" monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. You can only use each effect of "S-Force World Sorting" once per turn.

23024.name: Melffy Playtime Surprise
23024.text: Target 1 "Melffy" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Beast Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. If you control a "Melffy" Xyz Monster: You can banish this card from your GY; for the rest of this turn, "Melffy" monsters you control that are Special Summoned from the Extra Deck are unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can only use each effect of "Melffy Playtime Surprise" once per turn.

23025.name: Clown Crew Finale
23025.text: If you control a Tribute Summoned monster: Discard any number of cards, then target that many face-up cards on the field; destroy them. You can banish this card from your GY, and Tribute 1 Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum, or Link Monster from your hand or field; add 1 "Clown Crew" monster with a different original Level/Rank/Link Rating from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Clown Crew Finale" once per turn.

23026.name: Foolish Trap Hole
23026.text: When a monster effect is activated on your opponent's field, during a turn your opponent has Special Summoned: Destroy the monster that activated its effect, then if your opponent controls a card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, destroy them.

23027.name: Lane Restriction
23027.text: When this card is activated: You can Special Summon 1 of your banished monsters to your rightmost Main Monster Zone. If your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s) in their Main Monster Zone, they must use their leftmost zone(s) that can be used.

23028.name: Annihilate Retroglight
23028.text: When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field, except monsters that were Summoned this turn: Negate that activation, then you can banish (face-down) all face-up monsters your opponent controls, except monsters Summoned this turn. If this Set card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Set 1 Trap from your Deck.

23029.name: Garden of Talistones
23029.text: While you control 5 cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, any battle damage a player takes is halved, also once per turn, you can activate 1 Continuous Trap Card the turn it was Set. During the Standby Phase: You can reveal 5 Continuous Traps from your Deck with different names, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Set, and shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Garden of Talistones" once per turn.
